English: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Abna, “Aimira iyie olee? Kaing'ae likinyaanyukie iyie ti atua Israel? Kainyoo naa pee eitu iyie irrip olkitok lino olaiguanani? Amu eewuo obo loo ltung'ana atua pee eidaikie olaiguanani olkitok lino.

English: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
Masaai: Neibelekenya ninche nepuo, nepik nkera kutiti o nchoo o masaa dukuya ninche.

English: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Eyau naa endaa.” Nenang'aki atua ina moti, nejo, “Entooriki iltung'ana, pee etum aainosa.” Neitu eitoki atii entoki torrono atua ina moti.

English: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
Masaai: naa ematadamu enikinkunakino olikae olikae enkisusunkat o enyorrata o siaaitin sidain,

English: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani: ‘Enchoo emborei e moti oo nkulukuok naji omer eshumi ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, pee etum aatodol ina mukate naitotiyie nanu intae to lpurkel, inakata apa pee aitupuku intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’ ”

English: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
Masaai: Etediaki ilo oas esiaai Olaitoriani emereriana; netediaaki ilo oibooyo olalem lenye meibukoo osarge.

English: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Ore apa naa keji, ‘Nchoo ninche eikilikuanu enkoo te Abel’; neidip ninche olomoni.

English: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
Masaai: “Naa tudumunye taata, Olaitoriani Enkai, shomo ewueji ino enkiyeng'iyeng, iyie oilo sanduku lino le magilanisho. Nchoo ilapolosak linono Olaitoriani Enkai meishopokini enjeunoto ino. Nchoo isinyat linono eshipakino esupatisho ino.

English: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
Masaai: Neyam Daudi nkituaak kumok te Yerusalem, netum Daudi ilayiok kumok o ntoyie.

English: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
Masaai: Ore olkerreti laishoo intae to Laitoriani atang'amua: ore te ina kewarie naitarasarieki, etudumua Olaitoriani Yesu emukate,

English: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu osinka lino, o Sadok olapolosani o Benaia, olayioni le Yehoida, o sinka lino Solomon, neitu ninye eitoomon.

English: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.
Masaai: Neaku ore Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin o ltung'ana pooki neitu eiruk oltoilo lo Laitoriani, pee ebik tiatua enkop e Yuda.

English: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
Masaai: Nepuonu Yoab o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninye aaigutaki ile Siria to larrabal; neilanyisho ninche te dukuya ninye.

English: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
Masaai: nchoo naa aaku oloun, neinos likae; naa inchoo ina nabulu aaku enaai eturuni aaitayu.

English: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
Masaai: Eirriwaka ninye enjeunoto iltung'ana lenyena; neitanapisho ninye to sotua lenye ntarasi. Eisinyati neitureisho enkarna enye!

English: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.
Masaai: pee etum ninye ailepie intae te shumata lelo oshon pooki ooitobira, te nkisisa, o to lning'o o te nkanyit naa iakuku sii olorere osinya to Laitoriani Enkai inyi anaa enairoro ninye.”

English: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
Masaai: Naa ore apa pee ening enkaiguanani e Sheba enkishoroto e Solomon tialo enkarna o Laitoriani, nelotu atem ninye too nkikilikuanat naagol.

English: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
Masaai: “Intobira sii nkilani oo lpapit loo nkineji naaitushur olng'obor; ntobira nkilani tomon o obo.

English: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.
Masaai: Neaku etobiko Absalom ilarin oare oolulung'a te Yerusalem, eitu elotu enetii olaiguanani.

English: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Nelo Ananias nejing ina aji, neiteleiki ninye nkaik nejoki, “Olalashe lai Saulo, ilo likimpang'aka te nkoitoi niimua, Yesu kewan laairriwua pee ngil adolishoyu, nikingany Enkiyang'et Sinyati.”

English: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
Masaai: Metaa emining iloibonok linyi, o ilaitumusumusok linyi, o ilaidetidetak linyi, o lalimunok linyi arashu ilasakutok linyi, lelo oojoki intae, ‘Misiaayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon.’

English: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
Masaai: Elimu enkutuk ai enkisisa ino amu kinteng'en nanu nkiteng'enat inono.

English: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
Masaai: Nelo sii Yosef te Galilaya aing'uaa enkang e Nasaret, ailep alo enkang e Daudi naji Betlehem amu ole nkaji e Daudi te ntalipa,

English: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
Masaai: Ainyoo pee mining'ung'u intae enajo? Enkaraki nimindimidimi aatoning ororei lai.

English: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
Masaai: Nelotu Gad enetii Daudi nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Iwa ina niyieu:

English: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
Masaai: Ore enkiyang'et enye neinok inkuk enkima, nepuku olang'at le nkima te nkutuk enye.

English: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
Masaai: Amu esipa nchere tiatua ena anasa apa esotokinoi Osinka lino Yesu, osinka lino sinyati laa ninye itubukoko eilata aput, ninye etasotokinote Herode o Pontio Pilato o Loreren leme Lyahudi o ltung'ana le Israel,

English: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
Masaai: Ninchopo enkewan ng'ejuk, naitang'ejuki te ng'eno metanyaanyukie ilo oitayio ninye.

English: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
Masaai: Ena intae enchom entaas. Ore pooki lee o pooki ngoruoi naatayiolounote endaikie ninche tukul.”

English: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
Masaai: Neitobir olgoriet loo lapolosak, o lgoriet kitok enejing'ieki olgoriet,

English: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
Masaai: Iyie oitadowuo ninye te nkiti rishata meeu abori lmalaika, naa iyie oishoo olmarisian le nkitoo o enkanyit,

English: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
Masaai: Neiturrurro lelo kituaak, o laitasheikinok sunash ogelema, o lbalusuni, o lautarok o lashumak loo mpisai, o ilkituaak loo nkitanapat, o iladung'ok loo nkiguanat o lelo kituaak loo lkerenket, tenkaraki enkitisinyata e ina kitanyaanyukoto natesheta olaiguanani Nebukadnesa; neitashe ninche te dukuya ina kitanyaanyukoto natesheta Nebukadnesa.

English: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
Masaai: Aibatisa sii enkaji e Stefana; ore metii lelo majo kaata likae laibatisa nanu.

English: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
Masaai: “Eyiolo Enkai enkoitoi nalo ine, neyiolo ewueji enye.

English: At that time Berodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata, neirriwaa Merodak-baladan olayioni le Bat-adam, ilo aiguanani le Babilon ilkiliku ooyautua mpala o enkishoroto enetii Hesekia, amu etoning'o apa ninye ajo etamuoyia Hesekia.

English: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
Masaai: Keitomisimisi enkolong, neitotiuni olapa anaa osarge, eng'or ina olong kitok o Laitoriani naitureisho.

English: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing Abram Misiri, nedol Ilmisiri aajo aisidai ina kitok oleng.

English: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
Masaai: inchoo kisiaai iyie iloreren, nikigilaki kung iyie iloshon. Taa olkitok too lalashera linono, naa inchoo ilayiok le ng'utunyi kirrugokino iyie. Metedeki pooki ng'ae likidek, nemayiani pooki ng'ae likimayian iyie!”

English: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
Masaai: neimaki pokira aare nena baa naatotiwuo.

English: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
Masaai: Neibung'are intemat e nkaina tikitam naatii atua olodung'oro liatua, neipirare enkiyopata naimi enkaji e oriong olodung'oro. Oltapeet le nkaji oipirare olikae too nkajijik uni naakedo aaidikidiko.

English: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim ayau entoki naiduruk tiatua enemeiduruk?

English: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
Masaai: Naa aimikintieu iyiook aaitorisioki aashu kintanyaanyukie ate likae le lelo ooipang'u taata eisis ate. Ore oltung'ani laa ate etemie ilkulikae, naa ate eitorisioki ate, neidang'a oleng.

English: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
Masaai: “Najoki intae entaiki ate lchoreta te kuna masaa enkop nemesinya, paa kore pee emuta neng'amari intae te nenen neebikieki ntarasi.

English: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
Masaai: Ore ilo otoduaa neishakenoko, naa kesipa shakenisho enye, neyiolo ninye ajo esipata ejoito, pee irukuruku sii intae.

English: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninche, “Erridutu pooki tung'ani, neibatisai pooki te intae te nkarna e Yesu Kristo, pee epalakini intae ng'ok inyi; naa ing'amumu enkishorunoto e Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
Masaai: Ore ilo pisiai oleku le nkaji e Yuda neitoki aibung ntona, neiu ilng'anayio.

English: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
Masaai: Nelotu oltung'ani obo nejoki ninche, “Ng'ura! Ore lang'ole tung'ana litipika korokoroni, etii enkaji e Nkai eitashe aaiteng'en olorere.”

English: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
Masaai: Metobikoi enkarna enye ntarasi, metaa ning'oti enkarna enye anaa enkolong! nchoo metamayiana iltung'ana ate te ninye, neipot iloshon pooki ninye aajo olomayiana!

English: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ajing eoro atua. Lyahudi te nkaraki kulo rorei.

English: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo tung'ani oiduruk nemetii elototo, kake nekepari aany eibung pasaka, ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenyena amu eitu eishoru olasar lo Laitoriani te rishata enye nageluno; nenap ilo tung'ani engoki enye.

English: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
Masaai: Yoktin apa menye le Almodad, o Shelaf o Hasamafet, o Yera.

English: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
Masaai: Etoikioki apa ninye kulo pokira ile te Hebron, teine apa neitoreisho ilarin oopishana o lapaitin ile. Neitoreisho ninye te Yerusalem ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni.

English: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia kaairriwaki nanu isinkan laainei taisere tena saa, naa kepuonu aajur enkaji ino o nkajijik oo sinkan linono, neya pooki toki naitiship ninche.’ ”

English: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ining oltoilo le nkiyukoto te nchumata oo lkeek le basasam, shomo taa tarasaki ninche; amu eshomo Enkai te dukuya iyie pee eosh enjore oo lfilisti.”

English: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:
Masaai: Neaku ore naa taata amu meitameisho engoro enye, nemeinining'u ninye oleng intorrok.

English: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
Masaai: Neaku entadamu niasiasa nkitanapat aainei pooki niakuku sinyat to Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie ilarin okuni, neisik irrindiki oare le Shimei aapuo enetii Akish olayioni le Maaka, olaiguanani le Gaat. Ore pee elikini Shimei aajoki, “Ng'ura etii irrindiki linono Gaat.”

English: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
Masaai: Ore pee edung'i aajo kiked emeli aapuo Italia, neitarasakini Paulo o kulikae ooteenaki olkitok loo sikarini oji Yulio, lo ltim le Augusto.

English: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
Masaai: iyie enabore enkilepilep, na anasa ena nailugo, na ang ena nabore eng'ida? Ore lelo tung'ana linono ootaraki neme to lalem, neme to larrabal etuata.

English: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
Masaai: Nejoito ake enkaji e Israel, ‘Ore enkoitoi o Laitoriani nemesipa!’ Iyie na aji e Israel, amaa nkoitoi aainei aimesipa? Aime nkoitoi inono nemesipa?

English: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
Masaai: kake ore te kuna olong'i naabayie neirorie iyiook to Inoti otegelua ninye metaa olajung'oni loo ntokitin pooki, olaa te ninye eitayioki enkop.

English: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
Masaai: Nkariak e Meriba kuna, naa te ine eishankarrare iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, neitodolu ninye esinyatisho enye te ninche.

English: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: Naa ore tiatua ene wueji kainyal nanu nkitobirat e Yuda o Yerusalem, naisho ene metabatatayu to lalem te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, o te nkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye kaisho nanu mpopoki enye metaa endaa oo motonyi oloing'ang'e o ng'uesi enkop.

English: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enyaaki wootu enatii nanu te rishata oo nkolong'i uni.” Neaku etorrinyote iltung'ana aapuo.

English: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
Masaai: Kake te nelo neaku keitiship papaai lai pee kintaas iyie entorrono, metaasa sii Olaitoriani ina te Yonatan, neitulusoo sii te nemaaitayiolo nanu, areu iyie shomo, pee itum ashomo te seriani. Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo iyie, anaa enataa te nebo papaai lai.

English: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
Masaai: Itoduaa intae enaikuna Ilmisiri, ina natanapa nanu intae too naipuko o lkurragos nayaki intae kewan ai.

English: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas pooki e lelo aiguanak, o laiguanak lenye pooki, neya Yoshua ninche near ninche te nepi o lalem, aidaikie ninche tukul, anaa apa enaitanapishe Musa osinka lo Laitoriani.

English: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
Masaai: Intijing'u iyie ninche atua, niun ninche te nchumata o ldoinyo lino, ine wueji, Olaitoriani, nintobira te nkaraki emanyisho ino, ine nesinya, Olaitoriani, nintobira iyie te nkaina ino.

English: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
Masaai: Ore apa too nkolong'i e Artaserses, o Bishlam o Mitredat, o Tabeel o lkulikae le ncholuek enye, neigeroki empalai Artaserser olaiguanani le Parsia. Eigeroki apa ina palai te nkutuk e Aramea neibelekenyi.

English: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
Masaai: naa kapik nanu olmonekie atua ninche. Naa ore te ninche naa kairriwaa nanu ilo pisiai oleku meshomo iloreren, meshomo Tarshish o Puti, o Ludi, lelo tung'ana oyietu nkai, nepuo Tubal o Yafan, nepuo iloomanaa le naiposha oolakua, lelo leitu ening enkisisa ai o enkitoo ai ti atua iloshon.

English: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
Masaai: Naa Ore naa taata, teneiteleikia apa papaai intae enchata oo murto nairoishi, naa kaponaa nanu enkiroishi eina shata inyi oo murto. Eitamio intae papaai too nkibokoni, kake kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.’ ”

English: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
Masaai: Eikiosh iyie Olaitoriani te njipai o lgoo, o to lkirobi o te ng'ion o te nkiyupuyup enkima o to lameyu, o too oshot o too mpaldakani, nikisuj iyie kulo meita, o metaba anaa nindaaya.

English: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
Masaai: Nenang'uni ilo asurai kitok enkop, ilo asurai musana, laa ninye eji oloirirua o shetani, ilo alejani le nkop pooki, nenang'uni ninye enkop, ore ilmalaika lenyena nenang'akini enkop te nebo ninye.

English: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
Masaai: nelo ninye ayuk ilo rridati te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee itumutumu aanoto eng'amaroto, ore pee ekenyu etulusoyie sabato neyuk olapolosani ilo rridati.

English: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkisisa intae ntokitin pooki e shumata, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon.

English: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
Masaai: Too mbat oo lkejek le Babilon iyiook kitotoni, te ine iyiook kinchira kidamu Sion.

English: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
Masaai: etalang'a ninche te lang'ata, neirrag Geba enkewarie nabo, neikirikira Rama, ore Gibea e Saul neilanyisho.

English: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoab olkilikuai aliki Daudi ilomon pooki lo larrabal.

English: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki oogiroo nepur ninye, etaa ninye entoki nakueniyie ile latia enye.

English: I have hated the congregation of evildoers; and will not sit with the wicked.
Masaai: Kaiba nanu encholiek o laasak loo ntorrok, nematon nanu te nebo ilarruok.

English: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
Masaai: Nipik ilkererin oong'uan loo soito, olkereri lo ltotoi barrikoi, oltotoi onyori o oltotoi onyokie oleng oaku olkereri le dukuya.

English: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
Masaai: Amu etubukoko intae Olaitoriani oltau loo njio naairoishi, neikeno ninye nkonyek inyi intae iloibonok, neikeno lukuny inyi lelo aduaak.

English: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
Masaai: Neitobir sii nkitasheta neiteleiki lelo motioo nena kitasheta.

English: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel ninye, “Etopolosayie Olaitoriani enkitoria e Israel te iyie ena olong, neishoo ninye olelatia ino, laa ninye supat likilang iyie.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Shomo topolosa enkanasa turuko Yerusalem, nipik olmishire shumata oo nkomomi e lelo tung'ana pooki ootanyamala te nkishirata osina te nkaraki olminong otaasaki tiatua.”

English: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
Masaai: Kepuo lelo torrok aajing enemeneng'a, lelo oshon pooki lemedamu Enkai.

English: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
Masaai: Metaa nalo atua nadol; ore teine, etisiraki te suntai aaitaman ing'uesi pooki naaiserpepiari, o ng'uesi pooki torrok o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin pooki nemeishu enkaji e Israel.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, inosa ele piyayati le mbuku laaisho iyie nimput enkoshoke ino ninye.” Metaa ainosa ninye; naa ore etii enkutuk nemelok anaa olkenkei le naisho.

English: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
Masaai: Ore einosita endaa, neidipa oloirirua atijing'a oltau le Yudas Iskariot, enkerai e Simon, nchere pee ekaldaa.

English: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
Masaai: Ore oltalet ogol loo ltorrok naa kelotu amuta, kake ore intona oo supati neitashe aauno.

English: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Masaai: nelo apa Yohosadak eyararoto ina kata pee eirriwaa Olaitoriani Yuda o Yerusalem meshomo eyararoto te nkaina e Nebukadnesa.

English: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: Amu ore oltung'ani lemeen kewan aitupukoo teina olong neitayuni aaiwuang'ie too ltung'ana lenyena.

English: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita pooki loo le Shuham, te risioroto e siana enye, naa nkalifuni ntomoni ile o ong'uan o iip ong'uan.

English: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
Masaai: Ore te lelo le Gershon, lo olmarei obo loo lmareita le Lawi, neishori olpisiai le nkop e Manase, Golan te Bashan te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas are;

English: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
Masaai: Ore ilo otur engumoto naa kesulakino naa keibeleleng'okino osoit shumata ilo oitera aibeleleng'oo.

English: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
Masaai: Wootu taata, emataar ninye metua nikinang'aki ninye engumoto nabo te kuna, nikipuo aajo eng'ues entim ninye nainosa ninye, nikianyu aadol enaaku inkidetidetat enyena.”

English: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi nalala eilo oitashe too sipat nepaash entorroni; ore ilo orrip enkoitoi enye, negolie enkishui enye.

English: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
Masaai: Kake te neton iasiasa ine suujisho, nejutori, intae o laiguanani linyi.

English: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Masaai: “Ore kuna baa naa keaku enkitanapata o endung'oto e nkiguana te intae, too iishoritin inyi pooki o ti atua imanyishoreitin inyi pooki.

English: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
Masaai: ore eishoi enye naa kepuo aaya ina kop. Ore taata amu emanya Ilmaleki o le Kanaan iyerat, tayooki mbelekenyayu shomo ong'ata aim enkoitoi Enaiposha Nanyokie.”

English: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ina peyie ajoki ninche, “Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
Masaai: Neitiship ina walata ilo turrur pooki; negelu Stefano, oltung'ani naa obore enkirukoto o Enkiyang'et Sinyati, Filipo, Prokorus, o Nikanor, o Timos, o Parmenas o Nikolaus, oltung'ani leme oloo Lyahudi laa Antiok eing'uaa, oibelekenye apa ninye ang'amu enkirukoto oo Lyahudi.

English: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
Masaai: Neitasheyie ninye nabo te Betel nepik enkae Dan.

English: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
Masaai: olaa ore pee eibung, nenang'ie enkop; neitayu ilabur, nenya lala neikaolo; najo ajoki ilooiteng'eni linono metaarai, nelaikino.”

English: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Daudi entopij o ldoinyo ine apa neseremieki Enkai, ng'ura, nelotu Hushai ilo Akiti anang'are ninye epolosa olkila lenye lioriong netii enterit endukuya enye.

English: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
Masaai: Kake ore pee edol lelo ooisilenoitie ninye, nejokino maate, ‘Ele doi olajung'oni, mataar pee eaku enaang enjung'ore.’

English: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
Masaai: Iyie obol nkonyek aainei pee meikeno; atanyamala nanu neaku maidim airoro.

English: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
Masaai: Etaranyishote apa ninche te dukuya ilo ng'obor le wueji sinyati, ometaba anaa neshetu Solomon enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem; neas ninche ina siaai enye anaa enaishiakino.

English: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
Masaai: Nejokino, “Keitu eyupuyup iltauja lang eirorie iyiook te nkoitoi, eboloki iyiook, ilkigerot?”

English: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
Masaai: Olpisiai olo arrinyunye, ilo pisiai le Yakobo orrinyokino Enkai magilani.

English: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Ruben ilo kikau le Israel, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, o lukuny pooki, o pooki lee ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom enjore:

English: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
Masaai: Alo nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani ti atua enkop oo looishu.

English: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore te ine, etii iltung'ana le Israel, neiger te nchumata oo soito enkigilata e nkitanapata e Musa, apa naigero ninye.

English: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
Masaai: Etiu anaa enkisuijoi natudumua enkitok neitushulaki mboreitin uni e nkano, o metaba anaa neisuijoyu pooki.”

English: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
Masaai: neitanapa ninye tialo ena bae pee melo arubare kulie aitin; kake eitu ninye eibung ina naitanapa Olaitoriani.

English: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
Masaai: Kake ore te pooki, ore olaiguanani neisilig sii ninye inkurman naaturi.

English: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
Masaai: Ore epuoito naning oltoilo loo naipuko enye, netiu anaa oltoilo loo nkariak kumok, netiu anaa endarata Olmagilani, oltoilo lo larrabal anaa oltoilo lo lorora; ore ake peyie eitashe inaipuko enye;

English: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o laiguanani Yeroboam, neiteru Abija aitoreisho te Yuda.

English: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
Masaai: Ore pee ekurraki aaikilikuan neapunye, nejoki ninche, “Enchoo eng'as olinyi lemeeta ng'ok, anang ninye to soit.”

English: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
Masaai: Ore eton aa entapukai eitu edung'i, netoyu ninche engor ae aitubului ake.

English: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
Masaai: “Ainyoo peyie kiyaua nanu aitupuku te ng'uset? Enaikash apa tenatua eitu aadol toki,

English: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
Masaai: Nejoki oltung'ani obo loo layiok loo loibonok olikae te nkitanapata Olaitoriani, “Tooshoki nanu, aatoomono” kake etanya ilo tung'ani eosh ninye.

English: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore too le Efraim naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam o iip isiet, iltung'ana magil oopi, iltung'ana ooning'o too nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
Masaai: Aimodook ilarripok lenyena naa ilmoda pooki; ildiein oomoda ninche pooki, meidim aatabuak, ooidetidet eirrag oonyor aaimugo.

English: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
Masaai: kake ore ina naa enoo ng'uarrat ake, netua hoo neishu.

English: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
Masaai: “Ore eing'uaa ine, neiteru lasirak o Lfarisayo aaitirrishaki oleng, nerrumoki meimaki imbaa kumok

English: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, enkata namuei ninche - naishop ilkuniyiani, naitame kewan te enata e mpukoroto naomon nanu eirruge elukunya ai abaiki olgoo

English: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
Masaai: Ore olorikito esiankiki e nkiyama, ninye oyamisho; kake ore olchore lo loyamisho, oitashe ainining, neshipakino oleng oltoilo lo loyamisho. Etaboreyia naa ena shipai ai.

English: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
Masaai: Kake etejo Rusi, “Mikisai nanu maatung'uai iyie arashu pee arrinyo eitu aasuj iyie; amu ore ewueji nilo ninye nanu alo, ore ewueji nirrag naa ninye nanu airrag; ore iltung'ana linono naa keaku iltung'ana laainei, neaku Enkai ino Enkai ai;

English: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
Masaai: Ninche etegelua Enkai aitayiolo eneba ti atua iloreren enkarsisisho e nkitoo ena kisudoroto, naa Kristo ti atua intae olora osiligi le nkitoo.

English: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
Masaai: Ore naa Olaitoriani makewan oisho intae olmonekie. Ng'ura, kenutayu eselenkei neiu enkayioni naa keisho ninye enkarna aajo Emanuel.

English: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
Masaai: Amu te nemeitopiuni ilootuata, netaa naa eitu sii ninye eitopiuni Kristo;

English: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
Masaai: “Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil, ore imasaa o larrabal nerruoyo!”

English: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
Masaai: “Kake inkilikuana ing'uesi, naa aikinteng'en ninche iyie, ore nena motonyi o loing'ang'e, naa aikiliki ninche iyie;

English: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
Masaai: O teina golon pooki magilani o nena kiaasin kituaak naaitureisho naataasa Musa te dukuya Israel pooki.

English: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
Masaai: ometaba anaa neing'or Olaitoriani te keper nedol asipu;

English: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
Masaai: Intanapa ake sii ninche tiaki, ‘Entaas ena: entereu ingarrin tena kop e Misiri pee enapunyeki inkera inyi o nkituaak inyi, niyauu papaai linyi nipuonunu.

English: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Masaai: Kaing'ae Olaiguanani le nkitoo? Olaitoriani ogol magilani, Olaitoriani magilani to larrabal!

English: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki irriwayie ilkiliku meshomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron, kenkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israel, pee inkilikuanishore too rorei lenyena? Ore enkaraki ina midou iyie teina dapash nishomo, ajing', kake meeta nchere pee miye iyie.’ ”

English: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
Masaai: nearaa auluo e ina anasa neirrui too soito: ore lelo ootaa shakeni neirragie nkilani enye te nkalo oo nkejek o lbarnoti oji Saulo.

English: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Yoram Yehu, nejoki ninye, “Ke seriani ake Yehu?” Newaliki ajoki, “Kaa seriani etumi, eba nji enkiborra oo nkonyek o esakutore e ng'utunyi Yesebel te nkumoi?”

English: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
Masaai: Aisho nanu enkoriong lelo ooshisho, naisho isederi lelo laayiet olmunyei; eitu nanu aisudoo enkomom ai pee maasuli anaa aanotakini.

English: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
Masaai: Ore etubulua ina kerai nelo nabo olong enetii papaai lenye tiatua ilaisampuak.

English: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
Masaai: Nataa taata osinkolio lenye meekure aata tipat te ninche.

English: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.
Masaai: Neitoki Abishai olayioni le Seruiya ajoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee edek ele dia otua olkitok lai olaiguanani? Nchooki nanu mashomo adungu endukuya enye.”

English: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ajo eishoo Papa enkaina enye pooki toki, neyiolo ajo enetii Enkai eing'uaa naa enetii Enkai eito.

English: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
Masaai: Ore lelo ootoni aadaa te nebo ninye neiter aajo maate, “Ai ng'ae ele eji opalaki oltung'ani ng'ok?”

English: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ayau intae enkop oo Lamori, laa ninche apa ootii lido likae kekun le Yordan; nearare ninche intae, naishoru nanu ninche apik atua nkaik inyi, niyaya intae enkop enye aaitaa eninyi, naidaikie nanu ninche te dukuya intae.

English: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae atua lkiku, neiriamunore lkiku, negor ninche.

English: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
Masaai: Ore ena anasa o pooki natii atua ninye neidaikieki tukul te nkaraki Olaitoriani; Rahabu ina mulayoi ake o lelo pooki ootii te nebo ninye ti atua enkaji enye naapok, enkaraki apa naisudoyie ninye lelo aikitalak likirriwaitie.

English: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
Masaai: “Meetae olotaluno ojing atua eumata o Laitoriani; ometabaiki eishoi e tomon meetae obo leishoi enye olo ajing ina umata Olaitoriani.

English: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Ele ninye olmonekie lo sotua lo lning'o laitayu te rishata ai intae, o pooki toki naishu natii tenebo intae o too lporori oosuju.

English: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
Masaai: Ore eyia nanu apa oitamoo Efraim meshomo, atudumua nanu ninche too nkaik aainei; Kake eitu ninche eyiolou nchere aishiunye nanu ninche.

English: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
Masaai: Miarare oltung'ani metii esipata, eitu kintaas iyie entorroni.

English: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitanap ninye lelo tung'ana apa oomanya Yerusalem, pee eishooyo erubata oo lapolosak o Lawi, pee etum ninche aaishoo ate enkitanapata o Laitoriani.

English: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootaana o lelo oo lakua te iyie naa aikisurdaany iyie, iyie leme toki, obore enkingolingol.

English: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
Masaai: neosh Yoshua enkukuo te nkaraki ninche te Shilo te dukuya Olaitoriani; neoriki Yoshua enkop te ine iltung'ana le Israel, olosho ake erubata enye.

English: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
Masaai: Kake kekordu Enkai enkishui ai aitung'uaa engolon e Nemeneng'a, amu kaang'amu ninye nanu.

English: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
Masaai: Ore enajoito, lalashera laainei, naa ena; meidim nkiri o sarge aatujung enkitoria e Nkai, nemeidim entoki naidaaya atujung'o enkitoria e Nkai, nemeidim entoki naidaaya atujung'o enemeidaaya.

English: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
Masaai: Ore eng'udi tenebo enkisikong'a e nkikoo naa keyau eng'eno nagut, kake ore enkerai natapalayioki naa keyaki ng'otonye enkurruna.

English: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
Masaai: Eewuo ena bae shumata Yuda te nkitanapata o Laitoriani, pee eiwuang'ie ninche too nkonyek enyena, tenkaraki ing'ok e Manase, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa ninye.

English: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua o Israel pooki neitaakuno ketaraki te dukuya ninche, neisik aapuo enkalo e ong'ata.

English: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
Masaai: Keaku te intae enkolong naeng'ieng'ae aaitirring'a nieniene ate aaitupukoo. Ore te nkolong e naaudo o lapa eiteru teipa, eiteru te nteipa ometabaiki teipa imbung'ubung'u intae sabato inyi.”

English: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
Masaai: Naa omaa te naa pooki ake olisilen naa elde ake liyiolo ajo kilaaki, ainyoo eret ina te iyie? Keisilenokino sii ninche larruok eyiolo aajo kelaakini aaiputaki.

English: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
Masaai: “Iyanyita papaai lino o yieyio lino.” (ena kitanapata naituruk neeta enkisiligata),

English: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore nena masaa pooki e nkaji e Nkai nkutiti o sapuki, o lchumat pooki le nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat lo laiguanani o lkituaak lenyena, neyai nena pooki Babilon.

English: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
Masaai: Nejo Paulo, “Te naa ai te nkiti aashu te naado, kayieu napaji te Nkai neme iyie ake kake o kulo pooki laaning'ito te na olong netiu anaa enatiu nanu metii taa kulo pisia.”

English: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Oi naaji tenaa kaata inaipuko anaa enturkulu, anaata aipirri enelakua ayeng'iyeng'a;

English: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
Masaai: o erubata nauno e ilata, ematua nabo e tomon bati te pooki Kori (ore kori netiu anaa homa, eeta bati tomon);

English: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
Masaai: Nelo olning'o le Daudi aibulaa too nkuapi pooki neyau Olaitoriani euriata enye shumata nkuapi pooki.

English: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
Masaai: Ore ing'apeta enye naa tikitam, ore nkitotoneta enye naa tikitam, lo suyai, kake ore ilala oololo loo ng'apeta, o olgoso lenye naa ine nkosholai.

English: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
Masaai: Ore olbitir enkaraki narisha iloisotok kake meinyaku ng'amura, naa olminong te intae. Eminosinoso intae nkiri enye ore mpopong'i enye emiseyie.

English: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
Masaai: Ore ake pee itaaniki enkop oo layiok le Amon, nimintanyamal ninche aashu iarare ninche, amu maaisho nanu iyie erubata ninye nabo enkop oo layiok le Amon metaa enino, amu aishoo nanu layiok le Lutu meitaa enenye.’

English: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu ninye mijooni; meisampuni ae kata te ninye nemeturi naa kebulunye endiati o lkiku; naa kaitanap sii nkatampo pee meshaiki enchan ninye.

English: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
Masaai: Iorore iyie enjung'ore ino apa naaishoo, naa kaaisho nanu iyie isiaayia ilmang'ati linono tiatua enkop nimiyiolo, amu ore te ngoro ai, neinuaaki enkima nayupuyup ntarasi.”

English: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
Masaai: Neipot Enkai oloing'ang'e ajo Keper. Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e are.

English: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
Masaai: Nipik ninye dukuya ilo liatua otii embata o sanduku le nchakenisho, otii dukuya olorika lo lng'ur, te nchumata shakenisho, te ine natumore nanu ntae.

English: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
Masaai: Mputaki nanu eng'ida o enchipai, nchoo lelo oik apa litigila iyie meting'idata.

English: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
Masaai: ore nkejek enyena naa ine sekenkei, ore ndapi enyena oo nkejek naa olkuroti oshula esekenkei o enterit.

English: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
Masaai: Meeta ninye eishoi arashu iishoritin tiatua olorere, nemeetae oloishu teine apa nemanya.

English: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keishir oltau lai anaa olwulul loo usin aishiraki Moab, neishiraki oltau lai Kir-heres.

English: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
Masaai: Taretu iyiook, Olaitoriani: amu meekure eetae hoo obo oata euriata e Nkai; amu eishunye ilooisiligayu tiatua nkera e tung'ana.

English: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
Masaai: Naairriwaki ninche nanu ilkiliku katitin ong'uan aaiko nji, nawaliki ninche aiko nji.

English: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aaigil aashet iwuejitin apa neeidaaitie neshetu ninche nene wuejitin apa neetomijoonito, neram ninche nena anas apa naaidaitie, ina mijoonisho oo ishoritin kumok.

English: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
Masaai: Naa kasul nanu kewan oleng aitalang ena, naaitadouni too nkonyek inono; kake ore te nena sinkan naa ninche iimaka, ore ninche naa kaayanyit nanu oleng.”

English: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
Masaai: anaa eneitu elotu e nkerai e Tung'ani meisiaai kake eewuo aisiaaisho neitayu enkishui enye metaa elakunoto oo lkumok.”

English: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
Masaai: kake ore eton eitu ebau nena pooki keibung'i intae, neinyali, neitarasakini intae nkajijik e ntumo e korokoroni, nerikokini intae laiguanak o lbalusuni te nkaraki enkarna ai.

English: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
Masaai: Nelotu naa olapolosani ajur ninye naa tenenyokie neibor ine neteijia tenkurrunoto enye e ndukuya anaa te nelio etiu anaa empukunoto enkeeya oo lbolot to lchoni lo sesen,

English: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
Masaai: Nepuku Lot aing'uaa Soar, amany ildoinyo tenebo ntoyie enyena pokira are amu ekeure apa atotona te Soar, metaa etamanya enkapune tenebo ntoyie enyena pokira are.

English: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
Masaai: Eshomo apa ilkeek aagelaki ate olaiguanani, nejoki ninche oltamiyoi, ‘Ntoria iyiook.’

English: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
Masaai: neing'uaa Yesu Kristo olchakeni osipa, laa ninye olkikau loo lootuata, naa Olaitoriani loo laiguanak ootii enkop. Metaa ene ilo otonyorra iyiook nelaku iyiook too ng'ok ang to sarge lenye,

English: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
Masaai: eikimutan iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani te ndarata, o te nkikirikirata e nkop, o to ltoilo kitok, o to siuo o to lkutati o te nkima nanyaisho.

English: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoab Amasa, “Iserian iyie, olalashe lai?” Neibung Yoab Amasa olmunyei lenye te nkaina enye e tatene pee eng'utut ninye.

English: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
Masaai: Teneme naaji ilmang'ati lenye medamu ake embae nemesipa pee melo ake nejo, “Enkaina ang natimirishe, mme Olaitoriani oyaua ena pooki.” ’

English: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
Masaai: Kake ore oltung'ani omoda naa ketum ening'unoto; oo teneini olkurrarru le ntim aa tung'ani.

English: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
Masaai: Ore ti alo olalashe lang Apolo, aitirrishaka oleng pee elotu ine nitii te nebo lelo alashera; kake meyieu ninye nelotu te taata, kake kelotu te nkata naatae erishata.

English: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
Masaai: Netii oltung'ani oji Sakayo; naa olkitok loo lasotok le kodi, naa karsis.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha, pee eshukunye enkare shumata Ilmisiri, o shumata ingarrin enye oo mbartan o shumata ilakedok lenye loo mbartan.”

English: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaputu nanu lelo le Amedi metarasaki ninche, lelo lemeshilaa enkosholai; nemeshipakino sahabu.

English: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
Masaai: Amu keitamei te mutata oo ntarasi nekepari aaitalam enetii Olaitoriani o enetii enkitoo e nkidimata enye.

English: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
Masaai: Amu elotu enkiyang'ata anaa emukate ai, ore inkishirat aainei nebukunye anaa enkare.

English: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Peka, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, ng'ura, eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani laa ninye oitobira enkop, Olaitoriani oipirua ninye neitobiru ninye, Olaitoriani enkarna enye:

English: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.
Masaai: Nenyorraa ilo Lawi abik te nebo ilo tung'ani; netiu ilo barnoti te ninye anaa obo loo layiok lenyena.

English: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
Masaai: “Ore te rishata enye neitoki adumunye olomeni leitu eishori enkanyit anaa olaiguanani; kelotu ninye aluamisho neya enkitoria to losek.

English: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
Masaai: Ena ninye ina yieunoto natuutuaki eipirta enkop pooki; naa ena ninye ina aina naitorioyioki te shumata iloshon pooki.

English: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
Masaai: Neitoki ajo, “Aata embae naaliki iyie.” Nejoki ninye, “Tolimu.”

English: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
Masaai: kajo ake, keetae mpukunot kumok e nkorui te nkop, nemeetae hoo enemeeta ake enajo.

English: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie ainos eishoi o sesen lino makewan, nkiri oo layiok linono o ntoyie, nena nikinchoo Olaitoriani Enkai ino, teina nikimani aamuat, o to sina likipik ilmang'ati linono.

English: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
Masaai: Ore sii, “Iyie, Olaitoriani, oitobira enkop te nkiterunoto, ore shumata naa esiaai oo nkaik inono.

English: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
Masaai: ore enkurriny eilo kiteng o eno lmeregesh, o eilata o lkidong'oe leilo meregesh, oina kurriny naimulumul isorri enkoshoke, o lairakuj, o lkina le moinyua;

English: And there they preached the gospel.
Masaai: nelikioo ororei le Nkai te nene wuejitin.

English: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
Masaai: Esipa itoosho iyie Edom, nikinting'ida iyie oltau lino. Ndipakinoyu naa iyie te nkitoo ino nintirring'a tiang. Amu kainyoo iyie pee ing'oru enyamali ijo pee ibatata iyie tenebo Yuda.”

English: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitashe enkitoria e Rehoboam negolu, neiturraa ninye enkitanapata o Laitoriani o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye.

English: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
Masaai: iyie apa layaua nanu aitung'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop, naaipotu too neelakua oleng, aajoki nanu iyie, “Ira iyie osinka lai, aategelua nanu iyie, nemaanang'aa nanu aiturraa;”

English: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
Masaai: Teng'ena enkerai ai nintiship oltau lai pee atum atawalaki ilo laaing'oru nanu aitukurru.

English: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
Masaai: Tiaki nkituaak moruak neijia, metaa inaayanyitayu to lkuaak, nepal olmarenke nemeaku rrindiki e merai; nchoo eiteng'enisho nena sidain;

English: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
Masaai: Ore te nchoto e are e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, te nkalo e moikuape, neitayu ninye irubat tikitam

English: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
Masaai: ore te nkaraki natoduaa Enkai inchere esipata te nelaaki te nkisilisiloto lelo ooisilisilito intae,

English: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu isinkan le Daudi enetii Abigail te Karmel, nejoki ninche ninye, “Eirriua Daudi iyiook enitii pee kintaa iyie te ninye anaa enkitok enye.”

English: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
Masaai: Eting'iria kulikae imorot o oshot, o metabaiki ilpisia o korokoroni.

English: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia neyang'aki ninche nejoki, “Entang'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
Masaai: Nkolong'i tomon oobo elototo ebaiki Horeb te nkoitoi o ldoinyo le Seir o metabaiki Kadesh-Barnea,

English: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
Masaai: Netem sii kulikae eing'oru osapiipiyiet oing'uaa keper.

English: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
Masaai: Neibung Daudi ingarrin enyena oo mbartan enkalifu nabo, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni naapishana, o sikarini nkalifuni tikitam oopuo too nkejek. Nemut Daudi mbartan pooki oo ngarrin, neing'uaa ake inaaidip ngarrin iip nabo.

English: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
Masaai: Kaakordu nanu iyie aitung'uaa enkaina eilo torrono, naalaku iyie aitung'uaa enkibung'ata eilo lemeeta olng'ur.”

English: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
Masaai: Ira iyie Enkai, iyie Enkai ai, iyie nanu aing'oru, iyie eetayie oltau lai enkure; kaiterre nanu te yieunoto ino, atiu anaa oltung'ani te nkop natoyio nemetii enkare.

English: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Simon naa: Yemuel, o Yamin, o Ohal, o Yakin, o Sohar o Saul, aa layiok le nkitok oo Lkanaani.

English: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
Masaai: ilo apa oitudupayie te Yakobo pee eaku enkikoo, te Israel neaku olning'o loo ntarasi,

English: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
Masaai: Kake Oldoinyo le Sion ietuo intae o enkanasa e Enkai naishu, Yerusalem e keper, o enetii ilmalaika lemeikenayu ooiturrurro eikodoki,

English: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
Masaai: Te ina eitu eidim ninche aairuko amu enyaaka sii Isaya ajo,

English: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
Masaai: Neitutum ninche ina kila o lgoo too lgiso lenyena o lgisoi le ina kila dorrop te nkeene pus, pee eirrag te ina kimeita e nkila dorrop naripuno te nkarriyiano, pee melolong'u ina kila o lgoo teina kila dorrop.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena olong'i nemuoyu enkayioni eina oliai. Neitirrishaki emuoyian oleng o metaa meekure eyang.

English: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aisho osiriua sapuk ilkituaak lenyena pooki o sinkan; osirua le Esta. Neitoki sii aishoru empalakinoto e kodi too lkerenketi neishori nkishorot te risioroto e nkarsisisho e nkitoria.

English: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
Masaai: Toning'o, embuakunoto too ldoinyo eba anaa eno lorora kitok! Toning'o, embuakunoto oo nkitoriat, e lelo oshon oosoto te nebo! Olaitoriani loo lororani oitobirita olarrabal.

English: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
Masaai: Teneinosi ninye penyo te nkolong e uni, naa olminong; meitokini aang'amaa,

English: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
Masaai: Ore aa ina aasita, naainepu aaitisinyaki te nkaji e Nkai, neitu adumu aashu aliman. Kake eetae Lyahudi le Asia

English: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani le Israel otasesekuanaki te nebo enkitok e Midian, naa Simri olayioni le Salu, laa endukuya enkaji oo loo menye le nkaji oo le Simeon.

English: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.
Masaai: Neitoki Delila ajoki Samson, “Ng'ura, kitusukenya nanu, nikiteleja nanu; tolikioki sii ake enikinkoni pee kimbung'i.”

English: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
Masaai: Nelo Olaitoriani aing'uaa ine, eidipa airorie Abraham. Nerrinyo Abraham alo ewueji enye.

English: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore ilo opejoo ina ashe neituku ilkilani lenyena te nkare neituku osesen lenye te nkare, neton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa.

English: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
Masaai: Metoponikini intae olng'ur o eseriani o enyorrata.

English: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
Masaai: Naa, ti nimincho iltung'ana laainei epuo, ng'ura, naaitame airriwaki iyie emus oo lojong'a o laisiaayiak linono, o ltung'ana linono, o atua nkajijik inono, neiput inkajijik oo le Misiri emus oo lojong'a, o ina kop naitasheyie ninche.

English: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
Masaai: Naa teneitu elakuni ninye te kuna oitoi; nepuoi naa aalaaya ninye to lari le Yubilii, ninye o nkera enyena naatii tenebo ninye.

English: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
Masaai: ore lelo aduaak netusulaki, neitukurruni lelo aitumusumusok; kepuo pooki aaiken nkutukie enye, amu metii ewalata naing'uaa Enkai.

English: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya tesheta iyie olng'obor le Nkai o ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
Masaai: Neitanap ajoki, “Emishoroo toki te lototo inyi, eng'udi ake; naa emiya mukateni, aashu olbene, aashu mpesai too nkimeitani inyi.

English: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
