English: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
Masaai: Kake etanya menye tukul nejo, “Ekayiolo olayioni lai, ekayiolo; ekeaku sii ninye kitok; kake ore ake eyia, ekeaku olalashe lenye oti kitok te ninye, ore eishoi enye naa keaku olorere kumok.”

English: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
Masaai: Te nkaraki enkisiligata ino, naa te risioroto oltau lino, itaasa iyie ena enkitoo aidimie osinka lino metayiolo ina.

English: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
Masaai: Naa kaisho nanu intae ilchekuti laaitiship oltau lai, ooitoti intae te ng'eno o te yiolounoto.

English: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
Masaai: Teneaku etaasa oltung'ani eng'oki neaku oloitarruoyie nerrinyu ninye ina toki nawa te nkikonyare, aashu ina nanoto te nkitorogonyata, aashu ina naishooki ninye meiteng'ela, aashu ina toki apa naimina natudumua ninye,

English: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
Masaai: Nedumunye Eliashib ilo apolosani kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena, lelo apolosak, neshet ninche kishomi oo nkerra. Neitisiny ninche ina kishomi, nepik nkikeneta enyena. Neitisiny ninche ina kishomi o meitabaiki oltalet le iip nelo abaiki oltalet le Hananel.

English: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
Masaai: Neing'or ninye enkalo e Sodom o Gomorra o enkalo enkop pooki o yerata, naa ng'ura, upe eilepita empuruo eina kop anaa empuruo olkokuet.

English: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
Masaai: neipid olmaima anaa enkoilii, neranyisho olng'ejep lo lemeyiolo airoro te ng'ida. Amu keijirrijirru nkariak to lpurkel, neiput nkonyek oo nkariak enkop natoyio.

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lelo asarri ooki te lelo oing'ok o te lelo meregeshi, o lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
Masaai: Ore apa ilapolosak neigeroki tenebo nkera enye pooki, o nkituaak enye o layiok lenye, o ntoyie enye, o eumata pooki. Amu keisiligayu apa ninche egolie ate aaitaa sinyat.

English: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
Masaai: Kake ore taata eewuo Timoteo enikitii eing'uaa enitii intae, neinosaki iyiook ilomon sidain le nkirukoto o enyorrata inyi, nelimu inchere idamumu oshiaake iyiook too sidain niyieuwu oleng nidolidolo iyiook anaa enikiyieu sii iyiook nikidol intae.

English: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
Masaai: Nchoo meisisa loreren ina arna ino kitok naitureisho! Ninye osinyati!

English: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore apa ntokitin pooki naaokishoreki o laiguanani naa ine sahabu, ore imasaa pooki enkaji natii entim e Lebanon naa ine sahabu nasila. Meetae ine nkosholai, meshilari apa nena aaitaa toki toonkolong'i e Solomon.

English: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
Masaai: Nejokino Lfarisayo maate, “Idolitata taa aajo mitumutumu toki. Eng'urai, eirukurukore enkop pooki ninye.”

English: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
Masaai: Ore kulikae netapaashari aapong kuna neidapashakino enchankar e pesho,

English: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Arpakashad ilarin tomoni uni o miet, neaku menye le Shela.

English: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
Masaai: Te nemeoshi intae aarere, anaa enaitaasaki ilkulikae pooki, nitaa nkera naadumuni nimirara inot.

English: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
Masaai: Ejo ilo toilo, “Nchira!” Najo nanu, “Kaaishir ajo aa?” Ore pooki naata osesen netiu anaa nkujit, ore ina kishiaa enye pooki etiu anaa entapukai e ong'ata.

English: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
Masaai: (Ina apa enkisiligata naishoo Olaitoriani Yehu, ajoki, “Ketonie ilayiok linono olorika le nkitoo le Israel ometabaiki e ishoi e ong'uan,” nelotu aaku ina.)

English: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
Masaai: Esipa keisho ilo supat enkarna ino enashe; ore ilo supat nebik ninye te dukuya iyie.

English: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo tung'ana le Dan aaibung enkoitoi enye; ore ake pee edol Mika nchere kegol ninche oleng aalang ninye, neibelekenya neshuko alo enkang enye.

English: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa Amasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam te Yerusalem. Ore enkarna e ng'otonye naa Yehodan e Yerusalem.

English: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ainyoo iyieuu naitaas intae?”

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok, inchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho nemeitame ninye ina keeya e are.’

English: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
Masaai: ile Shefufam, olmarei loo le Shefufam; ile Hufam, olmareita loo le Hufam.

English: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
Masaai: Aaitaasa ninche terisioroto olduruk o nkitarruorrot enye, naisudoo enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche.

English: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ilalashera laainei, meeta kata apake nemeitabari ilkigerot anaa enatejo Enkiyang'et Sinyati, alimunye Daudi, eimaki Yudas, laa ninye otorikuo ltung'ana ooetuo aaibung Yesu.

English: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
Masaai: “Keaku ena olong te ntae enitumutumu aadamu, nimbung'ubung'u aitaa osirua to Laitoriani; ore ti atua ishoritin inyi pooki embung'a anaa enkitanapata oo ntarasi.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kaitoti nanu kulo tung'ana te sayiet, naisho ninche enkare natii esayiet metooko.

English: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina atemenayie nanu kewan tukul, nairridu te nterit o too nkuruon.”

English: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
Masaai: Neaku ninye oing'urrie oloyieu neing'urrie, neitagol oltau lo loyieu neitagol.

English: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
Masaai: “Kulikae ake eitajeu nemeidim aitejeu kewan, olaa ninye olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Inchoo taata edou to salaba pee kiruk ninye.”

English: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
Masaai: Ekueniyie ninye enkuretisho, nemeirut ninye; nemeibelekenya ninye apaashare olalem.

English: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu erubata e naapishana te nkaraki olosho le Dan, te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
Masaai: Neitakedi ilo moti shumata iloing'ok tomon oare lo suyai, neing'orita okuni lenye enkalo e moikuape, neing'orita okuni endoyioroto e nkolong, neing'orita okuni kopikop, neing'orita okuni enkalo o loo ntoluo; ore apa ilo moti naa shumata ninche eiteleikino. Ore enkalo enye pooki e siadi naa atua etii.

English: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
Masaai: nedoyio ilo polosie alo ebaiki te Shefam o metabaiki Ribla te nkalo o loo saen le Aim; nedoyio ilo polosie alo o metabaiki olmanie le naiposha e Kineret te nkalo oloosaen;

English: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aawal te dukuya olaiguanani ejo, “Ore lido Daniel ora obo loo yarunot ooitung'uari Yuda, mikishilaa ninye iyie, laaiguanani, aashu ina naimieki nitipika olmishire, kake keomon ninye asaisho katitin uni te nkolong.”

English: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
Masaai: Neitanyamal Daudi oltau lenye ena kata eidipa aikena iltung'ana. Nejoki Daudi Olaitoriani, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki sapuk tena nataasa. Kake ore taata, Olaitoriani, aatoomono nanu iyie, iwuang'ie entorroni to sinka lino; amu ataasa nanu te modai.”

English: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
Masaai: Ore ngirran naaitobiruaki too nkulupuok naaiseyie ilo oata osupetai nepuoi aabel; ore engirra pooki naguetuno te nchata neisuji te nkare.

English: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Te neitu idolidolo ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia nimirukuruku.”

English: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye egira aitirring'a openy teneiteleikini ninye;

English: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
Masaai: Ketumi kule nikibaiki too nkineji inono, neaku endaa olmarei lino pooki, o enintotiyie nkaisiaayiak inono.

English: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
Masaai: neibung enyorrata nauno too ltung'ana iip tomon, epalaki entorroni, o enkitarruoroto o eng'oki, kake mme oloikenaki oltung'ana loo ng'ok esipata tukul, naasujaki nkera ing'ok oo loo menye, o nkera oo nkera enye, o metabaiki eishoi e uni o eni ong'uan.”

English: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
Masaai: Naa ore tiatua ena aji, naailepieki oleng, ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo neing'asia, nejo, ‘Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena kop o tena aji?’

English: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
Masaai: Olminong torrono too laiguanak te neas ing'ok, amu ore olorika le nkitoo neitasheyieki too sipat.

English: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo tung'ani oas pooki toki te otikinoto, aa oinoti aasho olomoni neinyala Olaitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani naa keiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa iltung'ana lenye.

English: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.
Masaai: Neitoki Mordekai aisho emboitati e mpalai e ina kitanapata naitayioki te Susa te nkaraki emutata enye, pee elo aitodol Esta, neinosaki ninye ilomon, neitanap meshomo enetii olaiguanani pee eomon nesai te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena.

English: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
Masaai: Etiu anaa eilata nagol enkinyang'a te ndukuya, eruko ajing olmunyei, ajing olmunyei le Aron, eruko adoiki emurt olkila lenye!

English: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entusujuaki pee aitaa intae ilarreshok loo ltung'ana.”

English: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues nitoduaa keetae apa, nemeekure eetae. Naa kepuku ailepu te ngumoto nemeeta enkiting'oto nelo atua enkidaaroto. Ore lelo oomanya enkop leitu esiri inkarn enye te mbuku e mpuaan ebaiki apa pee eitamanyuni enkop naa keing'asia te nedol ina ng'ues, amu etii apa, nemeetii taata, naa kelotu.

English: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
Masaai: “Ore ilayiok le Aron nintaiki ilkilani, o nkimeitani o imaupen. Nintayu ninche te nkitoo o te nkishiaa.

English: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
Masaai: Kulo ninche irorei apa ooirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel pooki te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan ti ong'ata, te Araba te nkipirakinoto e Sufu, te rishata e Paran o Tofel, o Laban, o Heserot o Disahab.

English: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
Masaai: Neaku keji apa enkarna ene wueji Tabera enkaraki natapejo enkima o Laitoriani atua ninche.

English: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
Masaai: Nejo likae, ‘Ainyang'ua nanu lmong'i tomon naa kalo pee alo asipu; aatasayia tung'ueikiaki nanu.’

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
Masaai: Meisisi Enkai Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, olaa ninye otamayiana iyiook ti atua Kristo too mayianat pooki e nkiyang'et naaing'uaa iwuejitin e shumata.

English: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
Masaai: neitu eshukoki emorisho, ore pee e isilisili neitu ejo aarisho, kake eitarasaka imbaa enyena pooki ilo oiguenare te sipata.

English: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
Masaai: Ore taata, ng'ura, ayiolo nanu ajo esipa iaku iyie olaiguanani, neitubulari enkitoria e Israel te nkaina ino.

English: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kaiwuang'ie nanu lelo oomanya Ashdod, o ilo oibung'ita eng'udi e nkitoo aitung'uaa Ashkelon; kaibelekeny nanu enkaina ai aarare Ekron ore ilo pisiai loo Lfilisti neidaaya.” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

English: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Loyie ooti, iatata isinkir?” Newaliki aajoki, “Mikiaata.”

English: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
Masaai: Kake ilbenia ng'ejuko epiki enaisho ng'ejuk.

English: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
Masaai: Neye Husham neitoreisho Hadad olayioni le Bedad, laa ninye apa otimira ile Midian te nkop e Moab te rishata enye, neji enkarna e nkanasa enye Afiti.

English: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
Masaai: Nelo ilo tung'ani enkop oo Lhiti nelo ashet enkanasa nejo enkarna enye Lus; ina enkarna enye o metabaiki ena olong.

English: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
Masaai: Tinitum eng'eno, neikash alang sahabu, tinitum ening'unoto naa keisul alang enkosholai.

English: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eyae aaitung'uaa enkoitoi, nepuo iltung'ana pooki aasuj Yoab esujaa olayioni le Bikiri.

English: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

English: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neyau ilo turrur pooki ninye auluo nenang' ninye o metua too soito, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
Masaai: Nibukoki aitisiny ilo ng'obor le ntumo o ilo sanduku le nchakenisho,

English: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
Masaai: Neitarasaki ninye enkaina neitasheyie. Neitoki taa aipot lelo sinyat o nena olia neitarasaki ninche eishu.

English: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
Masaai: Naas nena pooki te nkaraki kulo Omon Supati, peyie eaku katii atua lelo oong'ar ina mayianata.

English: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye endapidapoi ai, o sempewuaet lai, naa olakordunoni, Enkai ai, endapidapoi ai naa ninye asaru, elong'o ai, naa emowuo e njeunoto ai, naa ninye osempewuet lai.

English: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
Masaai: Inchoo inkonyek enye metoduaa enkidaata enye, naa nchoo ninche metooko ina goro e ilo Magilani.

English: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
Masaai: Emanita nkatampo o emisimisi nagut ninye; esupatisho o esipata ninche olkitamanyunoto lo lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
Masaai: Ore pee kibau Roma, neishori Paulo eton openy, te nebo ilo sikari oirrita ninye.

English: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, neetae osirua loo Lyahudi neilep Yesu alo Yerusalem.

English: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana leina kop neitashal iltung'ana le Yuda, neitukuret ninche te nchetata,

English: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
Masaai: Kapik nanu ilmang'ati linono enkuretisho, naaraa Ilhifi, o Ilkanaani o Ilhiti mikishomo aaing'uaa.

English: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
Masaai: Meidip ilkeek le Lebanon enkima, nemeidip ing'uesi e enyena pooki olasar opejori.

English: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-Bethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
Masaai: Nening Benhadad enatejo olaiguanani Asa, neirriwaa ilarikok lenyena le njore meshomo aagilunore nkanas oo Siraeli, nemir Ljion, o Dan, o Abelbet-Maaka o Kinerut pooki tenebo enkop pooki e Naftali.

English: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie esulare ai, o esulare ai o enkurruna ai; iyiolo iyie ilmang'ati laainei pooki.

English: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
Masaai: Eteenikinote iltung'ana laainei enkibelekenyakinoto pee aapuo aaing'uaa nanu; neaku etegelakaki ninche enchata e murt nemeetae ololaku.

English: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
Masaai: kake ore ina kop nilang'itata aapuo aaya naa enkop oo ldoinyo o nong'ot ine neshaiki ninche enchan naing'uaa keper,

English: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina ilalashera, te nalotu naaji enitii nairo too lng'ejepa, ainyoo eret ina te intae aime enaikash te naa kairo irorei le mbolunoto aashu le ng'eno aashu le naibon aashu le nkiteng'enare ina kata airorie intae?

English: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
Masaai: Keaku entolu kitok alang ilo oasishore, arashu keisis emusumeno kewan te ilo odung'ishore? Eji netiu anaa eng'udi nadumu oltung'ani! Anaa netiu anaa eng'udi nadumu ilo leme enchata.

English: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe Olaitoriani, ti atua olorere, kaaranyaki nanu iyie enkisisa ti atua nkuapi.

English: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
Masaai: Metaa kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aosh Misiri too mbaa pooki e nkingasia nalo nanu aas teine, ore te siadi ina naa kaisho intae enchom.

English: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neya Daudi ilong'oi e sahabu apa naanapita isinkan le Hadadesa, neyau ninche Yerusalem.

English: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata lo apolosak, eninyi ena kitanapata.

English: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
Masaai: Atadoyie alo ine netii enkurma oo lng'anayio aing'or nena tapuka naatii oerata, aing'uraa tenaa keimarrimar ilkeek loo sabibu, tenaa keitapuka ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka.

English: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
Masaai: Amaa naa te naa kejo Daudi ninye Olaitoriani, kaji eiko pee eitoki ninye aaku enkerai enye?”

English: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana laainei, nkera naaitorogony ninche, naa nkituaak naaitore ninche. Lo tung'ana laainei, eitapong'oitie intae ilarikok linyi, nemil enkoitoi inyi.

English: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
Masaai: Nelo ninye aliki lelo apa ooiriamariyie ninye, eishirita ninche neilisho.

English: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
Masaai: Nelo Abram enetii Haga, neiroshiu. Ore peyie edol enkaisiaayiani ajo eiroshiwuo, nemenu Sarai.

English: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
Masaai: Ore enkop e Asheri naa keiu endaa sapuk, Naa keitayu ninye endaa nanya olkitok.

English: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
Masaai: Meekure iyiook kiaata ilmonek lang, meekure eetae oloiboni hoo obo, nemeetae hoo obo ti atua iyiook oyiolo ajo kenkata nabaa.

English: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, naa iyie airriwaki enkomono ai, Olaitoriani. Ore te nkata nang'amaroyu, iyie Enkai, tang'amayioki nanu te ina nyorrata ino nauno.

English: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
Masaai: enkiba neeta likae toki, emerai, enkului, o kulie naatiu neijia. Aikok nanu intae anaa, enaidipa oshi aikoo nchere, ore lelo ooas mbaa naaijo nena nemejung katukul Enkitoria e Nkai.

English: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
Masaai: Kake ore pee aaitopiuni, naituruk te intae alo Galilaya.”

English: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
Masaai: Ore ake sii ti atua Isaakar o ti atua Asheri neeta apa Manase Betshean o nkang'itie enyena, o Ibleam o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Dori o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Endor o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Taanak o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Megido o nkang'itie enyena, ore ene uni naa Nafat.

English: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
Masaai: Aaisiasha nanu engoro ino; aaidaikie nanu ioshot inono.

English: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
Masaai: Matayo o Tomas, Yakobo ole Alfayo o Simon oji olkirowuai;

English: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
Masaai: Ore enkaji pooki nijing'ijing'i, entotoni te ine o entupuku te ina ang.

English: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
Masaai: Ore eirorita, ng'ura, nelotu Yudas laa obo le lelo tomon o aare, eboitare empikas sapuk naata lalema o siaren ooing'uaa lapolosak o lpayiani lo lorere.

English: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.
Masaai: Neiturrurro apa ilkituaak loo Lfilisti pee etum aaitaiki olasar kitok Dagon, enkai enye, neshipa sii, amu etejo apa ninche, “Eishorua enkai ang Samson ilo mang'atinta lang apik atua nkaik ang.”

English: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.
Masaai: “Meidip olchakeni obo to ltung'ani le ntorroni ake ninye pooki, aashu tiae ake ninye kitapong'oto naitapong'o ninye. Too lchakenini oare ake aashu okuni eidimi aaitisipa endung'oto enkiguana.

English: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
Masaai: neaku ninche pokira are osesen obo, Metaa meekure era are kake etaa osesen obo.

English: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitorioo olmalaika enkaina enye aing'orie Yerusalem pee eidaikie, neirridu Olaitoriani ina torroni, nejoki ilo malaika apa oasita ina mutata ti atua iltung'ana, “Eidipe; tushuko taata enkaina ino.” Netii apa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani embata ewueji neidong'ishoreki e Arauna Olyebusi.

English: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
Masaai: Ahinaas te nkop e Naftali (eyama apa ninye Basemat entito e Solomon);

English: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninche esiaai e Nkai enye o esiaa nkitisinyata anaa enataasa ilaranyak o larripok le kishomi, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi o layioni lenye Solomon.

English: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
Masaai: Meetae olorruesh olikae, enkoitoi enye ake eibung pooki lenye, epuo ninche eeta imasaa enye o larrabal, nemeibooroyu.

English: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
Masaai: Kake etubula ninye ororei le Nkai neponari.

English: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
Masaai: Kaji eiko osinka lo Laitoriani lai te neirorie Olaitoriani lai? Amu meekure taata aata engolon nemetii enkiyang'et atua nanu.”

English: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
Masaai: O te nkaraki olperere lo lasar le nkorropil le sahabu nasila, o enkiroishi e sahabu naitobirieki. Neisho sii nkitobirat tenkaraki engarri oo lbartan e sahabu nanapieki lelo kerubi oolak inaipuko enye aaitoip ilo sanduku lo sotua le Nkai.

English: And he said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my daughter: for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani, entito ai; inyaaka aitasapuk ena supatisho aitulusoo tene dukuya, nchere eitu iyie ilo asujaa ilbarnot, aa karsisi o aa aisinak.

English: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
Masaai: Neyau ilkumok nkishorot aaisho Olaitoriani te Yerusalem, neisho ntokitin e tipat Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, neaku keyanyiti ninye too loshon pooki, ebaiki ina kata neito idia alo.

English: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana le Benchamen o Yuda nepuonu osempewuet enetii Daudi.

English: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
Masaai: Ore eneing'uaa nena pokira are naa ilo siligi litoning'o apa pee elotu enitii olkilikuai osipa loo Lomon Supati, naa te keper eiputakini intae ilo siligi.

English: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu olmalaika obo le lekua oopishana ooata ilbakulini naapishana naabore ilmeita oopishana oobayie naairorie naajoki, “Wou, kaaitodol ina siankiki, ina kitok o Lkuoo le Ker.”

English: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
Masaai: Neipotu Yoshua ninche, nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee iteleja iyiook, aajo, ‘Eikilakuaniki iyiook intae oleng;’ aa atua iyiook ake itii?

English: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche aaitobiraki nanu ewueji nesinya, pee atum atotona ti atua ninche.

English: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaya enkarasha pus, neimulumul ina kitashet o ltaa te nkaraki ewang'an, te nebo iltaai lenyena, o lkinoketa o ngirran enye, o masaa pooki e ilata naapikieki:

English: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
Masaai: ore hoo neshomo aing'uaa korokoroni ajing olorika le nkitoo arashu etoiwuoki te nkitoria enye aa olaisinani.

English: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
Masaai: Ore taata, ng'ura eewuo olkiyioi loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli enatii, natodua enkibookinoto e nkop naibookito iltung'ana le Misiri ninche.

English: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:
Masaai: Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria enye neitobiraki osirua ilkituaak lenyena, o sinkan, Netii sii ilkituaak le njore le Parsia o Media o larikok o laiguanak loo lkerenketi dukuya ninye,

English: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
Masaai: ore tadekenya neitapuku neipilipil, ore teipa nemuguta netoyu.

English: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong mikinkilikuanana nanu toki. Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ti niomonunu toki te Papa, neisho intae te nkarna ai.

English: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
Masaai: Nedol ajo keekenya earare enkurtoroto e mpeut amu kenang'are osiwuo ninche. Ore te rripore e ong'uan e nkewarie nelotu enetii ninche, elo eporito enkare. Neyieu negiroo.

English: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa Eliesa ilo apolosani nena girran o suyai, apa naaishorutua lelo ootapejoyioki, neidong'i aaitaa entoki naimulumulieki olperere lo lasar,

English: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
Masaai: Etii oldeket le Nkai shumata enkaji oo larruok, kake kemayian ninye emanyisho oo supati.

English: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam airriwaa Hadoram laa ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai nagol, nenang iltung'ana loo Siraeli ninye too soito metua. Neisarrisar olaiguanani Rehoboam alo airot ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, pee eisikaki Yerusalem.

English: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
Masaai: Neing'urrie Yesu ninche neiseyie inkonyek enye; nedolishoyu ninche te ina kata nesuj ninye.

English: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
Masaai: Te neitaa likae kewan kitok mme toki ninye kewan elej.

English: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
Masaai: Amu ore entonata e Siria naa Dameski, ore entonata e Dameski naa Resin. (Ore te rishata oo larin ntomoni ile o imiet naa keitaae Efraim mpurdat o metaa meitoki aaku olorere.)

English: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
Masaai: Neaku Ororei osesen neton ti atua iyiook, nikitoduaa enkitoo enye, naa enkitoo o Inoti Obo le Papa, obore empiris o esipata.

English: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye arikoo Israel te nkosholai o te sahabu, nemeetae obo te lelo loo loshon lenyena otarrorre.

English: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yehoshafat o ltung'ana lenyena aaya iyarunot enye, netum ninche nkishu kumok, o masaa, o nkilani, o ntokitin naagol enkinyang'a, naawaita ninche o metaba anaa neaku menapayu. Nkolong'i uni eyaita ninche nena yarunot, eikumok apa oleng.

English: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Atolikio intae neitu irukuruku; isiaaitin naas te nkarna e Papa, kuna naaishakenoki nanu;

English: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
Masaai: Aewuo nanu airriki oltung'ani o menye nairriki entito o ng'otonye, nairriki entito o enkaputani.

English: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
Masaai: Amu ira iyie Papa lang, hoo nemeyiolo iyiook Abraham nemelimu iyiook Israel; ore iyie, Lo Aitoriani, ira Papa lang, ore enkarna ino, Olokordu iyiook ebaiki apa moitie.

English: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
Masaai: amu eitu eas ninche nkiguanat aainei, kake etanyaita nkitanapat aainei neisarkionie isabatoni aainei, ore nkonyek enye neitoriokino nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu oo loo menye.

English: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
Masaai: Nebore osesen lenye empiron neruko entolit loo loik lenyena.

English: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
Masaai: Neisiaai iltung'ana le Israel Eglon olaiguanani le Moab ilarin tomon o isiet.

English: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
Masaai: Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkalo e tatene olperere lo lasar le nkorropil.

English: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata ening'i olotabolo nkonyek o ltung'ani oini aa modooni.

English: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu te siadi Pasaka, te ina olong, nenya ninche ilng'anayio le ina kop, imukateni neitu eisuijieki o entapa natapejoki.

English: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
Masaai: Esipa meetae te nkop oltung'ani supat oas isupati nemeas aekata ng'ok.

English: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
Masaai: ore ake esaani e nkosholai nabo te ninche naa shekeli ntomoni naapishana, ore enkosholai pooki e kuna masaa naa shekeli nkalifuni are o iip ong'uan te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai,

English: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ake sii te Yerusalem negelu Yehoshafat kulikae Lawi o lapolosak, o lukuny oo lmareita loo Siraeli, pee edung enkiguana tenkaraki Olaitoriani nedung enkiguana tenetii enchankar. Yerusalem apa etii entonata enye.

English: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
Masaai: agilunore lelo tarakua pooki le Lebanon, lelo adoru ooilepieki shumata, negilunore lelo keek oogol le Bashan;

English: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
Masaai: eishoo ninye inkishu, o ntare, inkoshola o sahabu, o sinkan, o nkaisiaayiak, o ntamesin o sirkon.

English: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Masaai: Enchopo iruparen pooki e Nkai, pee indimidimi aaitasho aairisha ilosekin pooki le sheitani.

English: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Kake teneeta entioto, tenaa maima aashu modooni aashu ae tioto torrono nimipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
Masaai: Ore nkera enye kutiti naa kedung'udung'i te dukuya nkonyek enye, keibung'i nkajijik enye, ore nkituaak enye neikonyi.

English: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
Masaai: neshurtu olaiguanani olgisoi lenye otooruo Haman neisho Mordekai. Neisho Esta Mordekai enkaji e Haman meitoria.

English: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
Masaai: Eitu apa nanu airo too nkurrat, ti atua ewueji e misimisi; eitu apa nanu ajoki eishoi e Yakobo, ‘Eng'oruaki to lmuate.’ Airo nanu Olaitoriani esipata, naibalunye ina nasipa.

English: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
Masaai: Neidur ninye aing'uaa Negeb ometabaiki Betel ewueji apa netii olng'obor lenye te nkiterunoto aa erishata Betel o Ai.

English: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
Masaai: Ore laiguanak pooki le nkop naa eikisis iyie, Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninche irorei le nkutuk ino;

English: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
Masaai: Ore pee aigeroki intae, neme enkaraki nimiyiololo esipata, kake enkaraki niyiololo, niyiololo sii aajo metii emonkoi atua esipata.

English: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
Masaai: Ore ewaita enkata ebikito te ine, neitanapare ilalashera ninche te seriani neisho enetii lelo apa ooirriutua ninche.

English: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
Masaai: Amu eteshetakitia sii ninche ate iwuejitin e shumata, o ng'apeta o Asherim, te pooki wueji neika o tiabori pooki shani onyori

English: And many more believed because of his own word;
Masaai: Neiruk kulikae kumok te nkaraki ororei lenye.

English: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
Masaai: Ore tembata ina kop oo lapolosak keaku keeta Ilawi ewueji oo ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon endapasho. Ore enkadori enye pooki naa keaku intemat e nkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet ore endapasho naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam.

English: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
Masaai: Olpayian oigeroki enkitok nageluno o nkera enyena, nanyor ti atua sipat, neme nanu ake, kake neijia etiu lelo pooki ooyiolo esipata,

English: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
Masaai: Enkutuk ino makewan nikidung'oki iyie enkiguana, mme nanu, nikinchakenoki iyie enkutuk ino makewan.

English: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Asheri, Pagiel olayioni le Oharan;

English: And there was great joy in that city.
Masaai: Nejing eng'ida sapuk ina anasa.

English: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
Masaai: Ore naa taata anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye laaitasheyie nanu aitagol, naaitoton nanu to lorika le Daudi papaai lai, laa ninye laaitaa nanu olmarei, anaa apa enaisiligishore, keari Adonija metua ena olong.”

English: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
Masaai: “Ore anaa enaishu Enkai, ilo laaitung'uayie esipata ai, o ilo Magilani, ilo otipika oltau lai emion;

English: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
Masaai: o Ahinoam olayioni le Sakar le Harari, o Elifat olayioni le Uri,

English: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
Masaai: Ore apa kuna baa naa too nkolong'i e Yoaikim olayioni le Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak, o too nkolong'i e Nehemia ilo balusui o Esra ilo apolosani naa olasirani.

English: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
Masaai: Aitataanua nanu enkordunoto ai, meekure elakua, nemeekure eimutie enjeunoto ai; naa kapik nanu enjeunoto atua Sion, te nkaraki Israel ina kitoo ai.”

English: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
Masaai: neyupuyup engoro ai, naar nanu intae to lalem, neaku inkituaak inyi inkolia, neaku inkera inyi okishin.

English: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Serug ilarin tomoni uni, etaa menye le Nahor.

English: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa ore iyie lo talet loo ntare, na doinyo e ntito e Sion iyie kenya epukunye, iyie epukunye enkitoria nalotu, ina kitoria e ntito e Yerusalem.

English: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
Masaai: o laiguanak apa ootii moikuape ina kop oo ldoinyo o atua Araba kopikop e Kineret, o atua ina kop nagum, o atua Nafat-dor te nkalo o loontoluo,

English: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight,and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki nataasa ninche mbaa torrok too nkonyek aainei naaitagoro ninche nanu, ebaiki ina olong apa naitupukutuo loo menye te Misiri o metabaiki ena olong.”

English: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.
Masaai: Ore ina apiani negorokino ninye, nelo enkaji e menye te Betlehem ti atua Yuda aing'uaa ilo Lawi, neton ninye te ine too lapaitin oong'uan.

English: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
Masaai: Emayianaa ilo laa Enkai e Yakobo ninye eretoto enye, laa Olaitoriani Enkai osiligi lenye,

English: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
Masaai: “Entejo too nkiyiaa e kulo oomanya Shekem, ‘Kaa naikash te intae, te neitore intae ilayiok pokira ntomoni naapishana anaa te neitore intae obo?’ Entadamu sii aajo ara nanu oloito linyi o erubata inyi.”

English: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
Masaai: olayioni le Elkana, olayioni le Yehoram, olayioni le Eliel, olayioni le Toa,

English: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani neeta enkata e nkiputukuny o enkitunyoto o enkinyalata ti atua ilo erata le nduaata, nena naauroo isunta e nkanasa, nebaiki embuaakinoto ldoinyo.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie meibonu ninye embae sidai, kake entorrono eibonu?”

English: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Daudi agiroo ine te sujaroto, ninye o ltung'ana iip ong'uan; netoni iltung'ana iip are te siadi, lelo apa oonaurate oleng leitu eidim aatalang oreyiet le Besor.

English: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoab olkilikuai meshomo Tekoa, meyau te ine enkitok ng'en, nejoki ninye, “Ntaakunoyu ira enkaishirani, nipika ilkilani lo lkiyioi; nimiel kewan te ilata, kake taasa anaa enkitok naishirita too nkolong'i kumok te nkaraki o lotua;

English: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Ore osinka lino, papaai lang naa aisupat neton eishu.” Neirrug ilukuny enye te dukuya ninye te nkanyit sapuk.

English: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
Masaai: Enkaraki pee eji, “Inyo oloirura, tudumunye, tung'uai ilootuata, naa eikincho Kristo ewang'an.”

English: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
Masaai: Ekeishir enkop pooki, neishir pooki marei openy; neishir ilo marei le Daudi openy, neishir inkituaak enye maate; neishir olmarei le Natan makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel; etaasa ake pooki tung'ani enaishiaakino too nkonyek enyena.

English: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
Masaai: Keiwuang'ie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi kulo oshon te dukuya iyie aa kutiti; mindaikie iyie ninche pooki nabo kata, pee mikirasaki ake ing'uesi entim.

English: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
Masaai: “Keidim oltung'ani ataa oloota tipat te Nkai? Esipa ore ilo ng'en neeta tipat te kewan enye.

English: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
Masaai: Ore eloito ina oliai ayau enkare, neipotu ninye ajoki, “Iyakaki nanu embelati e mukate te nkaina ino.”

English: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
Masaai: Tuputunye, tuputunye, ntagoluoyu iyie Sion; nchopo lelo kilani linono sidain, iyie Yerusalem, na anasa sinyati, amu meigil ae kata alotu enitii ilo lememurata o ilo oiduruk.

English: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
Masaai: Nedumunye to ldoinyo le Hor neim enkoitoi Enaiposha Nanyokie, aapuo aamanaa te nkop e Edom; nesi iltung'ana te nkoitoi.

English: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
Masaai: Neitoki Enkai adamu Raheli, nening Enkai ninye nebol eng'uset.

English: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ebaiki olapa ng'ejuk o metabaiki olikae apa, o ebaiki sabato o metabaiki enkae sabato, kaapuonu iltung'ana pooki aaserem, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong nelotu ninye ine, nelo ninye ilo gilata neyeng'iyeng'a teine.

English: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibung ena kitanapata naa enkerai ng'en, kake ore ololo aisiritore oltung'ani olubo naa keitukurru menye.

English: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki le Yakobo ooetuo atua Misiri, laa ile ishoi enye enkorrok, nemeikenaro ilayiok loo nkituaak oo layiok lenyena naa iltung'ana intomoni ile o ile pooki;

English: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Manase, o nena pooki naataasa, o ina ng'oki nataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
Masaai: Itagorokine apa iyie ilkejek iyie Olaitoriani? Itagorokine iyie ilkejek anaa ke naiposha igilunore. Pee itakedo iyie mbartan inono, nena bartan inono e nkishuroto.

English: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
Masaai: laa te ninye kiaata elakunoto, naa empalakinoto oo ng'ok ang.

English: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.
Masaai: Neyau ninye ilpayiani tomon le ina anasa nejo, “Entotoni tene;” netoni ninche.

English: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
Masaai: metii ina apa naing'uaa ilbiasharani o kodi oo lamirak o naaing'uaa ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o lbalusuni leina kop.

English: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
Masaai: “Ore Besalel o Oholiab o pooki tung'ani oota enkidimata, o enkalamasisho oishoo Olaitoriani metayiolo eneiko te neas pooki siaai e nchetare e ine wueji sinyati, neas te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani.”

English: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
Masaai: nejo to ltoilo sapuk, “Ntasho ntoriori too nkejek inono!” Neitiamu aitashe nelo.

English: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
Masaai: Lo moda kulo entamoo ate eng'eno; intae iltung'ana oo moda, enining'o enajo.

English: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
Masaai: Neitoki aliki ninche ae kitanyaanyukoto nejo. “Etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa enkaisiijoi natudumua enkitok neitushulaki imboreitin uni e nkurma e nkano o metaba anaa neisuijoyu pooki.”

English: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
Masaai: Kake iyie eing'or nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani Enkai; te iyie nanu aing'oru esarunoto; miking'uaa nanu maata olaamitu!

English: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
Masaai: Neikoni neijia katitin uni, neitokini aainyaaya pooki keper.

English: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
Masaai: “Naa intae ootobiko kiboitarere too ntemat aainei

English: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
Masaai: Amaa taa tenelaakini ilo supat tena kop, kebaa elang elaakinoto eilo torrono o laing'okoni!

English: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
Masaai: Tipika nena kishorot inono pooki e ntapa emunyan, nimincho ake eaku metii emunyan o lning'o lo osotua lino o Enkai ino o lasar lino le ntapa; ore too nkishorot inono pooki nchooi emunyan.

English: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
Masaai: Epuo pooki ewueji nebo; amu enterit eing'uaa pooki nerrinyokino pooki enterit aaigil.

English: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
Masaai: Neitobiraki Ehudi kewan olalem opi nkaloli pokira are laa entemet nabo e nkaina o lpisiai enkadoro, neeniki ninye enkupes enye e nkeju e tatene aitabolu nkilani enyena.

English: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
Masaai: Ore te ninche nindimidimi aainosa olmaati te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o entiantianyi o mpukunot enyena, o entaboi o mpukunot enyena o entargeeti o mpukunot enyena,

English: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
Masaai: amu ore Mahalal, o Tirsa, o Hogla, o Mika o Noa, nena toyie e Selofehad neyama layiok loo lalashera le menye.

English: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
Masaai: Minya endaa oltung'ani opiak, ming'uar indaiki enyena sidain.

English: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye enkarae oo mukateni neitayu imukateni aisho te dukuya ninye, kake etanya ninye enya. Nejo Amnon, “Taarai pooki tung'ani maashomo aaing'uaa nanu.” Neipang pooki ng'ae alo aing'uaa ninye.

English: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
Masaai: Ebukoki enkurruna lelo kituaak, neitololong ina kimeita e ilo ogol.

English: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
Masaai: Nejoki Aron ninche, “Entayutu lelo giso le sahabu ootii nkiyiaa oo nkituaak inyi, o ilayiok linyi, o ntoyie inyi, nikiyakiki nanu.”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
Masaai: Nji naa ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Keaku enkitok ino enaiborrie onyek tiatua ena anasa, ore ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono naa kebatata to lalem, ore olokeri lino naa kedung'i aaorrior to lgosoi, ore iyie makewan naa iye te nkop nemesinya, nemeeta nchere pee melo Israel eyararoto aing'uaa enkop enye.’ ”

English: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
Masaai: Netii atua ninye oltoilo loo lororani lemeshilaa toki; tenebo ilewa ookishore tenebo ootorikuoki tiong'ota, nepik ninche ilkataarri nkaik e nena kituaak, o maupen enkitoo sidain too ilukuny enye.

English: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
Masaai: Kake aibooyie nanu enkaina ai, naasisho te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki ninye te dukuya iloreren, laa too nkonyek enye eipang'unye nanu ninche.

English: Then shall the father of the damsel, and her mother, take and bring forth the tokens of the damsel's virginity unto the elders of the city in the gate:
Masaai: ore menye ina kitok o ng'otonye neipang'unye aayau boo lelo monek le titoisho, enetii ilpayiani leina anasa tialuo,

English: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
Masaai: Kake tenepuonu ninche iloreren ore pooki wueji neetuo ninche, neisarkionie ninche enkarna ai sinyati, ore teina nejo iltung'ana tenkaraki ninche, ‘Ore kulo tung'ana naa iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, naa kepuku ake aapuo aing'uaa enkop enye.’

English: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Masaai: Eno Laitoriani enkop o ntokitin pooki naabore, enkop o lelo oomanya;

English: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
Masaai: Oloo larin artam oare apa Ahasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye olari obo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Atalia, enkakuyiaa e Omri.

English: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootoriko Paulo neitabau Atene. Ore eitanap Paulo ninche aisho olkilikuai oyaki Silas o Timoteo metasieku ine, nerrinyo aapuo.

English: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
Masaai: Niasiasa ina te nkolong e naapishana o lapa te pooki ng'ae otaasa eng'oki te ntorroni arashu te modai; metaa intayuyu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai.

English: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
Masaai: Itodua oltung'ani okuetiki aimaki irorei lenyena? Eeta olmodai osiligi sapuk alang ninye.

English: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
Masaai: Amu etejo ninye, Esipa iltung'ana laainei ninche, nkera aainei nemeeta elejare; netaa ninye Olaitajeunoni lenye.

English: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
Masaai: Inchoo iyie ninye eyieunoto oltau lenye neitu iyie mbooyo eomonunoto e nkutuk enye.

English: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
Masaai: Kapik nanu Ariel osina, nelo aaku olkiyioi o enkishirata, nelo ninye atiu te nanu anaa Ariel.

English: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
Masaai: Neitoki Elihu olayioni le Berakel le Busi lo lmarei le Ram agoro. Etagorokine ninye Yoab amu eitaa kewan olemeeta entioto neaku Enkai eiteleiki entorroni.

English: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
Masaai: Neinyal ninye isabibu lenye te nchan oo soito, near iretet lenye te nkirobi.

English: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
Masaai: neitobira ninye nena masaa enyena o larrabal torrok, nepik mbaa enyena esayiet napi.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Ore enkaraki neitu intae kirukuruku nanu, pee kintisinyinyi nanu too nkonyek e kulo tung'ana le Israel, miyauu naa ena umata aaitijing atua ina kop naishoo ninche.”

English: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: “Etii sii ilkituaak le moikuape ine ninche pooki tenebo ile Sidon pooki lelo ooshomo abori te nkurruna tenebo lelo ootaraki, tenebo ina kirutoto pooki nayautua te nkaraki olkirutoto lenye eirragie ninche memurata tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem, nenap enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oodoyio aapuo enemeneng'a engumoto.

English: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
Masaai: Kayau nanu osina shumata iltung'ana, o metaa kepuo ninche anaa ilmodook, enkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki ti alo Olaitoriani; keibukori osarge lenye anaa enterit, neikoni inkiri oo seseni lenye anaa emodioi.

English: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
Masaai: Nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, meeu shumata iyiook, anaa enikisilig iyiook iyie.

English: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aisarkionie iwuejitin neeika apa naatii enkalo oloo saen le Yerusalem, o metabaiki kopikop o ldoinyo le ntorroni, naateshetaka apa Solomon olaiguanani le Israeli Ashterot, ilo minong loo le Sidon, neitobiraki sii Kemosh ilo minong loo le Moab, o Milkoni ilo minong loo Lamoni.

English: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Naa tenisampumpu intae nkurman inyi nimisampumpu aaitabaiki nkiting'ot, nimisotisoto ina kurma nitudung'o te nkisampuare entung'uai ninche te nkaraki olaisinani o lomoni: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
Masaai: o emesa o ntokitin enyena pooki, o enkitashet oo ltaai o ntokitin enyena pooki, o lperere le nkorropil,

English: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong neitadouni enkitoo e Yakobo aaitabaiki enkop, ore ina piron o sesen lenye nesasu.

English: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
Masaai: Ore metii nena kulie pooki, naata olola laainaur anaa nkakeny anyamaliki sirito pooki.

English: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
Masaai: Ore teipa nepuonu nkurlen neiput lelo ng'oborri; ore tadekenya neirrag enkolioolio aman lelo ng'oborri.

English: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
Masaai: Neinyang'u too layiok le Hamor, aa papaai le Shekem too mpisai iip nabo e seshati enkop naa ninye etuunie ilngoborri lenyena.

English: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Eitoreisho laiguanak loo Loreren; ore lelo ooata enkitoria te ninche neji ninche ilooduporeki.

English: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiken enkiok enye pee mening enkishirata e lelo aisinak, naa keishir sii ninye nemeetae oloning ninye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho enkanashe e ng'utunyi amu eno lmarei le yieyioo lino ninye.

English: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Peres: Hesron o Hamul.

English: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, eton eitu epeji eilata, nelotu osinka lo lapolosani nejoki ilo tung'ani oitayuto olasar, “Nchoru nkiri o lapolosani naapeji. Amu meng'amaa ninye nkiri naayiera te iyie, kake inaajon.”

English: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
Masaai: Amu etoduaa apa Olaitoriani nchere ore ina kibookinoto e nkop oo Siraeli naa keme, amu meetae hoo obo otelekua, oloena anaa ololakuno, nemeetae oltung'ani oret Isiraeli.

English: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu naaitijing'ayioki sii ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu nchere meetae entoki naiduruk te kewan enye; kake eiduruk entoki te pooki ng'ae ojo eiduruk.

English: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
Masaai: Aing'ae oitoti ilkurruki, ina kata eishiraki inkiyioitin enye Enkai, nemanimanaa eitu etum endaa?

English: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
Masaai: Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore enkererema enye neikununo anaa enkererema e nkikompe, eikunuaki anaa entapukai sidai. Naa iltooi ooitukuoreki nkalifuni are enkare natii ilo moti.

English: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu ejo Saul ae ina olong; amu etejo ninye, “Eeta ake naanoto ninye; mesinya ninye, esipa mesinya ninye.”

English: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
Masaai: Nepolos pooki inkilani enye, neirot pooki ng'ae esikiria enye, nerrinyo aapuo enkanasa.

English: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Asheri aipang'ie lelo oomanya Ako, aashu lelo oomanya Sidon, aashu ile Ahalab, aashu ile Aksib, aashu ile Helba, aashu ile Afik, aashu ile Rehob;

English: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;
Masaai: Nejoki Yese Daudi olayioni lenye, “Iyaki ilalashera linono ena efa enkano napejo, o kuna mukateni tomon, ninap aitasiooyo aya ilng'oborri enetii ilalashera linono;

English: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
Masaai: Ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore enkaraki naatonyorra ninye nanu, kakordu nanu ninye; kamitu nanu ninye, enkaraki nayiolo ninye enkarna ai.

English: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
Masaai: Amaa teneyieu obo nekeshare ninye, meeta obo oidim atawaliki ninye kata nabo too nkatitin enkalifu nabo.

English: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the LORD.
Masaai: ore pee ebaya enkata nenutayu Hana neiu ninye enkayioni, nejo ninye enkarna enye Samuel, amu etejo ninye, “Atoomonuo nanu ninye to Laitoriani.”

English: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
Masaai: Eirrugote iltauja lang aabaiki enkop; eirragita iseseni lang te nkop.

English: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
Masaai: Atabuakua nanu aishiraki Olaitoriani, naawaliki ninye nanu te ilo doinyo lenye sinyati.

English: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani teneitu nanu aun aitagol olning'o lai lo sotua te ndama o te nkewarie o too nkitanapat e shumata o enkop,

English: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
Masaai: Ore peyie ekenyu, ng'ura, Leah ngole eishooki Yakobo, Nejoki Yakobo Laban, “Ainyoo ena nikintaasa nanu? Aime enaji Raheli doi apa aaisiayie? Ainyoo naa peyie kiteleja iyie nanu?”

English: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.
Masaai: Ore eyia, maaitiship kuna pooki te nadol Mordekai ilo Yahudi eton te nkishomi o laiguanani.”

English: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas o losho le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye naa Yeriko, o Bet-hogla, o Emekesis,

English: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
Masaai: Neaku ore ake oloibooyo enkitoria te ngogong'i ina naa Enkai naitasheyie, ore lelo ooibooyo te ngogong'i naa ate eyaki enkiguana.

English: The eleventh to PrAzareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon oobo Asarel, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
Masaai: nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki Bet-hogla, nelo agiroo kopikop e Bet-araba; nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki osoit le Bohan olayioni le Ruben;

English: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie sii too nkanas pooki e Yuda iwuejitin neeika lperereni oopejieki enkorropil. Netum enkitoria enkiyeng'iyeng too nkolong'i enyena.

English: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
Masaai: Kake ore anaa enaitabayioki nena baa pooki sidain naaisiligishore Olaitoriani ti alo intae, neijia sii eiko Olaitoriani ayaki intae ntorrok pooki, o metaba anaa nemut intae aiwuang'ie tena kop sidai apa naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai,

English: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong, neng'as Daudi agelu metaranyi isinkolioitin le nkishooroto e nashe, nerany Asaf o lalashera lenyena.

English: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
Masaai: To lwuasa emir lelo torrok ilaisinak; nchoo meibung'a ninche lelo rresheta ooitobira.

English: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli tomon, nabore enkorropil,

English: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
Masaai: Netanyamala sii oltau lai. Kake amaa iyie Olaitoriani, o anu kenya?

English: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
Masaai: “Keeya, koree emirishoi ino? Keeya, koree enoshi bae ino?”

English: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku keetae olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te mpolos e nkop e Misiri, o eng'ape o Laitoriani to lpolosie lenye.

English: Thus saith the LORD: Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore hoo negol ninche naa kumok keiwuang'ieki ninche neitarasari. Ore hoo naaisilisilo nanu iyie maaigil nanu aisilisil iyie.

English: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
Masaai: Neaku enyaaka Musa ashuko alo enetii Olaitoriani nejo, “Wooi etaasa kulo tung'ana eng'oki torrono oleng; eitayutuo nkaitin te sahabu neserem ninche.

English: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Masaai: Nchoo iyiook engolon te nkaraki ilmang'ati lang, amu pesho eretoto e tung'ani!

English: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kaisikong sii ilo maati omutisho te nkop peyie meitoki aainyal ilng'anayio le nkop ino. Ore osabibu otii enkurma nemeitoki aalau eishoi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
