English: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Ahija oltoilo loo roruat enyena, ejing'u aimu kutukaji, nejoki “Tijing'u ena kitok e Yeroboam; kainyoo pee intaakuno eira likae tung'ani? Amu aaitanapaki ilomon ooiroishi tenkaraki iyie.

English: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
Masaai: Ee, o metabaiki sii ninche sinkan laainei, loo lewa o loo ng'oruo, kabukoki Enkiyang'et ai te nena olong'i, naa keibonisho kenya ninche.

English: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
Masaai: Eigeroki apa kuna baa pooki anaa iishoritin too nkolong'i e Yotam olaiguanani le Yuda o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel.

English: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
Masaai: Ore hoo naa ilkuti tung'ana apa ina jore e Siria, eishooyie Olaitoriani apik nkaik enye enjore kitok, enkaraki natanyaita ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye. Neaku etudung'okito ninche enkiguana, Yoash.

English: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
Masaai: Amu too nkolong'i ile eitobira Olaitoriani shumata o enkop, o enaiposha, o nena pooki naatii atua ninche, neyeng'iyeng'a te nkolong e naapishana. Metaa etamayiana Olaitoriani enkolong e naapishana neitaa sinyati.

English: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
Masaai: nchoo emisimisu nkonyek enye pee medolishoyu, neirrugori too nkoriong'i enye ntarasi.”

English: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nanu ele; emiureishoyu.”

English: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ooiguanare ninye pee ear metua naa Sabad olayioni le Shimeat le Amon, o Yehoshafat olayioni le Shimrit le Moab.

English: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
Masaai: Amu enyaaka apa ninye ashet iwuejitin neeika apa naaidaikie papaai lenye Hesekia, neshetaki Baal ilpereren loo lasarri, neitobir ashera, anaa apa enataasa Ahab olaiguanani le Israel. Neserem ninye olorora pooki le keper neisiaai ninche.

English: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
Masaai: Kake keaku enkop mijooni te lelo oo manya, te nkaraki ilng'anayio loo nkiaasin enye.

English: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
Masaai: Ira orrindik pee kimpoti? Mme toki ina. Ti nikitalakuaki taasishore ake iyie ina sinkaisho ino.

English: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
Masaai: Entaranyaki Enkai na kitoriat pooki e nkop; entaranyaki Olaitoriani enkisisa,

English: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Efraim: Shutela, o Bered, olayioni lenye, o Tahat olayioni lenye, o Eleada olayioni lenye, o Tahat olayioni lenye,

English: Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
Masaai: “Tiatua Olaitoriani ake, epuoi aajo tialo nanu, isipat o eng'olon. Ore lelo laaiba neitukurruni ninche.

English: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
Masaai: Ore apa imbartan e Solomon naa Misiri eing'uaa o Kilikia. Ore lelo ooinyiang'u engarri oo mbartan te Misiri te shekeli iip uni e nkosholai, ore embarta naa te shekeli iip o onom;

English: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.
Masaai: Ebaiki netoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino lelo rorei pooki le Rabshake, laa ninye eirriwua olkitok lenye ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu amor Enkai naishu. Keisikong Enkai ninye tenkaraki lelo rorei ootoning'o. Ore naa taata ilepie enkomono tenkaraki ilo pisiai otelekua.”

English: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
Masaai: Keitadou ilaisiaayiak laainei lelo keek te Lebanon neyau embata enaiposha, neen ninche tenebo naaitadoiki te naiposha meetu ewueji niyieu naisho ninche meiperi teine, ning'amaa iyie ninche; ore te nkalo ino naa kayieu nincho iltung'ana laainei endaa.”

English: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
Masaai: “Te nitum nkera o nkera oo nkera inono, nimoruau teina kop, tenipong'ori aitobiru enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta te mpukunoto ake ninye ae toki, ore te asata eina bae torrono te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino, aitagor ninye,

English: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
Masaai: Ore to lari li okuni le nkitoria e Yohoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda, nelotu Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, Yerusalem nemuat ninye near.

English: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
Masaai: Ore apa anaa enira entoki naimakini aadiaare too loreren, Iyie na aji e Yuda o enkaji e Israel, kaitajeu nanu intae niakuku emanyianata. Emiureisho, kake enchoo egolu nkaik inyi.

English: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
Masaai: Shomo inturrurro ilpayiani loo Siraeli te nebo, nijoki ninche, ‘Aaipang'aka nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi Enkai e Abraham, o ene Isaak, o ene Yakobo, ejo, “Atisipua intae o ina naitaasaki intae te Misiri;

English: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.
Masaai: Ore epuoito ninche te nkoitoi, nepuonu ilomon enetii Daudi, nejo “Etaara Absalom ilayiok lo laiguanani pooki, metuata neitu ninye eing'uari obo.”

English: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni, o eng'irra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata metaa olasar le ntapa;

English: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: Ng'ura itii emanyisho ino sinyati, itii shumata, nimayian iltung'ana linono Israel oena kop ninchoo iyie iyiook, anaa apa eninosie olmumai too loo papa, enkop naruko naishi o kule.’

English: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
Masaai: Eitobirutua ninche imbaoi inyi pooki too lkeek ooing'uaa Semir; neyau iltarakua aaitung'uaa Lebanon nikintobiraki iyie eng'ape naado.

English: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
Masaai: nadol aajoki ninye nanu, ‘Isarisara tasiooi tung'uai Yerusalem, amu meng'amaa hoo ninche shakenisho ino ti alo nanu.’

English: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.
Masaai: Nelotu Daudi enetii Saul, nejing enkisiaayiare enye. nenyorru Saul ninye oleng; neaku ninye olanapani lenye loo masaa o larrabal.

English: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
Masaai: o eilata oo ltaai, isonkoyoni te ina ilata naputishoreki, o te nkorropil naisonkoyo,

English: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
Masaai: nintaanyunyu ometabaiki enkolong e tomon o ong'uan ele apa, ina kata nayieng'ie eumata pooki o lturrur loo Siraeli ilkuoo lenye le kerra teipa.

English: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
Masaai: Neya olantererai obo le nkitoo neitayunye olning'o o ninye, nepik ninye abori olmumai. (Ore iltung'ana kituaak leina kop oowa ninye aitung'uaa enkop,

English: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
Masaai: Nemayian Yoshua ninye, neisho ninye Hebron Kaleb olayioni le Yefune metaa enjung'ore enye.

English: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that my fury shall come up in my face.
Masaai: Kake ore te ina olong, ina kata nalotu Gog aarare ina kop e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kedumuni engoro ai.

English: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
Masaai: nchere kalo nanu agil ilo le Asiria ti atua enkop ai, ore te shumata lelo doinyo laainei naitunyoki nanu ninye enkop too nkejek; ore ina shata enye oo murto neiwuang'a te ninche, o ilo ola lenye otii oloililai.”

English: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
Masaai: Ng'ura kekedisho obo nekuet tiai anaa olkurragos, nelak inaipuko enyena agilunore Basara, ore oltau loo lmurran le Edom netiu akenya ina olong anaa oltau le nkitok te saisai enye.”

English: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
Masaai: Neishir enkop pooki ayietu egiroo iltung'ana pooki, nelang olaiguanani oerata le Kidron, negiroo iltung'ana pooki aing'or enkalo o lpurkel.

English: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
Masaai: tenaa oloripuno too usin anaa oloo nkarash naapuyiapui, anaa oloo lpapit loo ntare, anaa oloo ndapan, anaa ole pooki toki naitobiruaki too ndapan, anaa ole pooki toki naripuno too ndapan

English: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
Masaai: Neany ninye nejo, “Manya nanu endaa.” Kake etasayia isinkan lenyena ninye te nebo ina kitok, nening irorei lenye. Neaku neinyototo ninye te nkop neton te rruat.

English: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
Masaai: nemeiro mbaa e nkiteenikino to lng'ejep lenye, nemeitaas entorroni olchore lenye, nemekur aitubulaa olmarenke teilo le latia enye;

English: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
Masaai: kake ajo ake enaikash eng'eno nagut alang engolon hoo netemenaiyioki eng'eno nagut eilo aisinani neitu eshilari irorei lenyena.

English: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
Masaai: Kake ore eton eitu eisho ninche ing'uarrat enye, eton etii ina daa nkutukie enye,

English: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye te Seriani Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda alotu enkaji enye te Yerusalem.

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Meisisi Enkai ti atua ewueji enye sinyati; meisisi ninye to loing'ang'e lenye kitok!

English: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
Masaai: Amu mme lelo ooning ake nkitanapat, isupati ti alo Enkai, kake lelo ooitabaya nkitanapat eishori isipat.

English: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ore lelo kituaak le Israel netii atua iyie, pooki ng'ae te ngolon enye, netemerregelaki to sarge oibukori.

English: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Enchoru nkiyiaa lo tung'ana laainei te nkiteng'enare ai; errugu nkiyiaa inyi too rorei le nkutuk ai!

English: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: “Misoruru olomoni, iyiololo oltau lo lomoni, amu irara apa intae ilomon te nkop e Misiri.

English: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ninche Yesu aajoki, “Ainyoo pee ejo ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eji meeta nchere meng'as Eliya alotu?”

English: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
Masaai: Neitoki sii aajo, “Keyiolo Olaitoriani ndamunot oo lang'eni neyiolo ajo empesho!”

English: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitisiny neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena, nebarn endukuya enye pooki, neituku kewan te nkare, nesidanu ninye, ore tesiadi ina nelotu ninye atua ang, kake keton teboo olng'obor lenye nkolong'i naapishana. Ore te nkolong e naapishana nebarn pooki te ndukuya.

English: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiken enkutuk enye neibooyo olng'ejep lenye, neitapaash kewan enyamali.

English: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
Masaai: ore ake pee epuo lelo oonapita ilo sanduku le Nkai iroruat ile, nepolos ninye olkiteng o lashe opir.

English: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
Masaai: Kake teneyieu ninye nekordu ninye neponaa e rubata e imiet e tomon entemata e nkinyiang'a.

English: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD'S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche, ore pooki ng'ae otudumua oltau lenye, o pooki otuputuo oltau lenye, neyau enkishoroto o Laitoriani pee easishoreki te ilo ng'obor le ntumo, o te nkisiayiare enye pooki, o te lelo kilani oosinya.

English: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
Masaai: Neya ninche oloing'oni obo oishooki ninche, neitobir ninye, neipot enkarna e Baal ebaiki tadekenya ometaa dama, ejo, “Oo Baal tawaliki iyiook!” Kake eitu etumi oltoilo anaa oltung'ani otawala. Neitiam ninche aaman ilo perere lo lasar apa oitobira.

English: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
Masaai: Eirorie apa Olaitoriani aikok Manase o ltung'ana lenyena, kake eitu ninche ening.

English: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
Masaai: Naa kepejoo nkajijik inyi neyau enkiguana shumata iyie te dukuya nkituaak kumok; naamitiki iyie pee mias esiai enkiborra oo nkonyek, nimintoki aikata aishoru olekoisiaayio.

English: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
Masaai: Nelotu enkoliai aisinani, nepik elai are naanyokie naabaya esenti nabo.

English: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
Masaai: Neyieu Barnaba neshoroo Yohana oji Marko meiriamariyie.

English: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa kepuonu enitii eing'uaa Asiria o metabaiki Misiri, o ebaiki enaiposha ometabaiki enaiposha, o ebaiki oldoinyo ometabaiki oldoinyo.

English: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
Masaai: Itimiraka iyie iltung'ana le Yuda o le Yerusalem Ilgiriki, niya ninche aitalamaa oleng to lpolosie lenye.

English: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko e sahabu e shekeli tomon, nabore nkorropil;

English: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
Masaai: Kake etiakinote lelo aturok ooisilenokoki enkurma, ‘Ele doi olajung'oni; wootu, mataar metua pee eaku enaang enjung'ore.’

English: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
Masaai: Neishooyo aainosie enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
Masaai: o nkikompeni o nkalema o ngirran, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ngirran e nkima, e sahabu, tenkaraki nena kikeneta e kutukaji e atua ilo gilata liatua, ine wueji nesinya aisul, o nena kikeneta olgos le nkaji e Nkai.

English: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
Masaai: Kekordu Olaitoriani enkishui oo sinkan lenyena, meetae obo le lelo oosaru ninye otum oldeket.

English: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
Masaai: kake ore oloba anaa olomor Enkiyang'et sinyati, meeta empalakinoto aikata, kake etaa eng'oki ntarasi.”

English: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
Masaai: Nintoki ayau ilayiok lenyena, ninchopoki ninche inkilani,

English: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata apa naibelekenye ninye apaash Olaitoriani, neitobir ninche pee ear ninye metua te Yerusalem. Neisikaki ninye Lakish. Kake etusujakita ninche ninye Lakish, near ninye metua teine.

English: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
Masaai: Aing'ae oilepa alo keper neitoki adou abori? Aing'ae ilo oiturrurro osiwuo too nkaik enyena? Aing'ae ilo otununuko inkariak tiatua enkila? Aing'ae ilo oitasheyie inkiting'ot ena kop? Keji ng'ae enkarna enye, naa keji enkarna enkerai enye ng'ae? Esipa iyiolo iyie!

English: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
Masaai: Meibulai esupatisho too nkolong'i enyena, metuunoyu eseriani nkolong'i naabaa anaa inaabik olapa.

English: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
Masaai: Nimiyamama intae o ninche aaisho intoyie inyi ilayiok lenye aashu aayamaki ntoyie enye ilayiok linyi.

English: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo lang laa kewan ake eishuyie, nemeetae olalang laa kewan ake enang.

English: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
Masaai: Nelotu Sihon aarare iyiook, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, neitayu olarrabal te Yahas.

English: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
Masaai: kake ore taata eewuo enkirukoto nemeekure kitii abori ilo aramatani.

English: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
Masaai: kalimu nanu ina nyorrata o Laitoriani nauno, ina kisisa o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki naaishoo iyiook Olaitoriani, o ina supatisho kitok te nkaji e Israel, apa naishoo ninye ninche terisioroto o lng'ur lenye, te risioroto e ina kitoo e nyorrataenye.

English: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
Masaai: Amu iyookiki aakurru te nkaraki lelo keek apa laaijo ilng'abolo lishipakinono, neitukurruni intae te nena kurman apa nitegelutua.

English: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
Masaai: Ng'ura, nelotu oltung'ani nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kaa bae naikishiaan aas pee atum enkishui nemeish?”

English: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
Masaai: Ore pooki kishoroto e ntapa natapejoki tiatua ewueji napejishoreki o pooki toki naitobiraki te ngirra aashu teneyierishoreki naa eneilo apolosani oitarasayie aishooyo.

English: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
Masaai: Ore dama nerikoo ninye ninche te nkatampoi, naa ore kewarie pooki nerikoo ninche te wang'an kitok.

English: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
Masaai: Nepik Tamar nkuruon endukuya enye nepolos ilo kila oado apa oishopito; neiteleiki nkaik enyena endukuya enye, nelo, neyietu aishir eloito.

English: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
Masaai: “Etoduaa Olaitoriani ina neiturraa ninche, te nkaraki ina naitagoro ninye ilayiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena.

English: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
Masaai: Kake eishoo Abraham ilayiok loo nkapiak enyena inkishorot, ore eton eishu, neidurrie ninche aitung'uaa olayioni lenye Isaak meshomo enkop oloosaen.

English: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
Masaai: Neishoru Musa enkitanapata, neitubulari olomoni ti atua ina ang oo lng'oborri, aajo “Mincho olee arashu enkitok eitoki aas ae toki ti alo nkishorot e ine wueji sinyati.” Neiboori iltung'ana pee meitoki aayau.

English: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Kiata sii pokira olkujita o lgilat ooirragi.”

English: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
Masaai: amu esila nabo ake eeta, oo larin tomon o aare, neirrag etaa keye. Kake ore ejo alo neiding'akino olorere.

English: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Nemaigil nanu aiwuang'ie enkeju e Israel teina kop apa nategelaka loo papaai linono teneing'or ninche aaibung nena pooki naitanapa ninche, o nkitanapat pooki, o nkikoot o nkiguanat apa naaishoruaki aaimunye Musa.”

English: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
Masaai: Neaku kejo ilaranyak loo nkatinin, “Wootu Heshbon, nchoo esheti ninye, nchoo enkanasa e Sihon metesheti aaitagol.

English: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
Masaai: neitook pooki ng'ues e ong'ata; neishu iloitikoishi enkure.

English: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
Masaai: ore ena kop natara Olaitoriani te dukuya eumata e Israel, naa enkop nanyor nkishu, neeta isinkan linono nkishu.”

English: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore peyie emany enkaji e Israel enkop enye, neisarkionie ninye too nkoitoi enye o too nkiaasin enye; ore olkuaak lenye te dukuya nanu netiu anaa oloirerio le nkitok te nkata enkiduruk enye.

English: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
Masaai: Newaliki ninche ninye aajoki, “Kira eishoi e Abraham; neitu ae kata kiaaku isinkan le likae tung'ani; kaji etiu pee ijo iyie, ‘Kelakuni intae?’ ”

English: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: kake ore ilo tung'ani onya nkiri eilo asar lo Laitoriani le seriani eata ninye olduruk, nedung'ori ilo tung'ani aaitung'uaa iltung'ana lenyena.

English: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa keiwuang'ie te Yerusalem o te Yuda, ina naisiligi o ina naishuyieki, eneisiligi te ndaa o nkare;

English: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
Masaai: Meyiolo oltung'ani enkoitoi nalo ine, nemetumi ninye te nkop oo looishu.

English: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
Masaai: ore ninye makewan neituruk te dukuya ninche, neirrugo abaiki enkop katitin naapishana, o metaba anaa nenyiku olalashe lenye.

English: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
Masaai: Isai iyie enkitok, nelotu likae lee ayiolou; nishetu enkaji kake mimany, niun enkurma oo sabibu kake minos isabibu lenye.

English: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
Masaai: Ore te nkumoi e biashara ino nikibore apa iyie olarrabal, nias iyie eng'oki; neaku aatanang'ayie iyie anaa entoki naisarkionieki aaitung'uaa oldoinyo le Nkai, ore ilo kerubi arriponi nikiaraa iyie aipungie ong'ata aitung'uaa empolos e lelo soito ooimerlel.

English: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
Masaai: Kaae neisarrisar Abigail, neya imukateni iip are, o lbenia oare loo lonito le naisho oo sabibu o nkerra imiet naayieng'a, o ntemat imiet enkurma napejo o rridat iip loo sabibu, o mukateni iip are oo lng'abolo, neirragie ninche te nchumata oo sirkon.

English: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
Masaai: ore ina kata airorita nanu aomon, ore ilo tung'ani oji Gabriel, duoo latoduaa te nduaata e dukuya, nelotu ine natii nanu akuetu oleng te ina kata o lasar le teipa.

English: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nekinyu Hesekia sahabu pooki too nkutukie oo nkajijik e nkaji o Laitoriani, o ntaloishin oo nkutukie oo nkajijik apa naatumura Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, neisho olaiguanani le Asiria.

English: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
Masaai: Ketoning'o ake eji, “Ore olapa tung'ani oinosie iyiook osina, nele taata olikioo enapa kirukoto natang'asa ajo aidaikie,”

English: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
Masaai: Etudumutua inaaiposha iltoiloishi lenye, iyie Olaitoriani nedumu ninche oltoilo lenye o enkikurrukur.

English: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ore esiana enye naa nkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile.

English: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
Masaai: Teneiro apa Efraim, neikirikira iltung'ana; eilepieki apa ninye tiatua Israel; kake etaasa ninye entorroni te Baal neye.

English: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu, Olaitoriani, enkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono; naa kaibung nanu o metabaiki enkiting'oto.

English: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
Masaai: Ore pee elang'aki Kaisaria, neilep airoroki esirit, neitoki adoyio alo Antiok.

English: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelo Olaitoriani aitomijoon enkop neitaa mitil, naa kelo aibelekeny neidapash lelo oomanya.

English: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
Masaai: Neilep apa Gideon aim enkoitoi naim intamesin to loosaen le Neba o Yogbeha nerasaki ina jore; amu merripo apa ina jore.

English: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
Masaai: Tenebore nkatampo enkare, neshaiki enkop; naa teneurokino olchani kopikop arashu moikuape, ore ine nesulakino olchani neirrag te ine.

English: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
Masaai: Einosa iltung'ana loo loreren eng'olon enye, nemeyiolo ninye; eisuaaki ilpapit ooibor shumata ninye, nemeyiolo ninye.

English: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
Masaai: Entadamu nena siaaitin enking'asia naataasa ninye, o enkiguana natudung'o ninye.

English: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
Masaai: Majo ena nkaraki intae. Kajo pee aitisip te nkirowuaj e kulikae inchere kedede sii ninye enyorrata inyi.

English: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
Masaai: Keituraa ninye enkolii enkuo enye amu meetae nkujit.

English: The children of Bethlehem, an hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Betlehem naa iip nabo o tikitam o okuni.

English: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellow soldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
Masaai: Atoduaa ajo keishiaakino nairriwaki intae Epafroditas olalashe lai, naa olaisiaayiani te nebo nanu, osikari te nebo nanu, naa olkipaaret linyi naa olaisiaayiani too nkolati aainei.

English: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo kitok loo sikarini ajoki, “Kainyiang'ua nanu ina kiela too ropiyiani kumok oleng.” Nejoki Paulo, “Kaikino nanu.”

English: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Gehasi osinka lenye, “Mpotu ena kitok e shunam.” Ore ake pee eipotu ninye, neitashe ina kitok te dukuya ninye.

English: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
Masaai: naa ore enkaraki nitaasa intae entorroni nalang enoo loo papaai linyi, amu ng'ura, etusuja ake pooki ng'ae te intae engolong'u enye torrono, eany aaning nanu;

English: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk oltung'ani ng'en neitubulaa eng'eno, nemeneija etiu indamunot oo lmoda.

English: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
Masaai: Netabuaa Isaya ajo ti alo Siraeli: “Ore hoo neba nkera e Siraeli anaa osinyai le naiposha, oloti pisiai ake eitajeuni ti atua ninche;

English: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
Masaai: Ina Ai naaterretena nanu te ngolon, neitaserian enkoitoi ai.

English: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
Masaai: Natagorokine oleng lelo oshon oodol ate anaa keserian. Amu ore apa pee agorokino ninche penyo, neitaa lelo oshon osina sapuk te ninche.

English: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
Masaai: Netii apa nena kikompeni ilukuny e nena ng'apeta are, o shumata ina natii embata ena ripata olmarisian, netii apa ilgululu iip are, emanaa too lkererin oare, naa neija eikununo enkae toki te nchumata enkae ng'ape.

English: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
Masaai: Neirukurukore oloti barnoti laa olkarasha ake errotianita; neibung ninche ninye.

English: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keikurrukurroki ninche nena naaibung'a, te nkikurrukur naaijo ene naiposha. Naa te neingor oltung'ani enkop, ng'ura, enaimin ake o osina; ore ewang'an neitomisimis nkatampo enyena.

English: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
Masaai: Amu aatoomono, “Mincho ninche meting'idata te nkaraki nanu, lelo ooitokoos ti atua nanu te neideketari enkeju ai!”

English: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
Masaai: Iun iyie nkurman oo sabibu nintobir ninche, kake miok iyie enaisho enye, niminturrur ilng'anayio amu kelo ainos olkurto tiatua enkop inyi pooki.

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Asheri nkalifuni artam o obo o iip imiet.

English: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani ena kop, pee kipuonu aabatata to lalem? Ore nkituaak ang o nkera ang naa keaku inaari metuata; aimeikash naaji te iyiook te nikirrinyo aapuo Misiri?”

English: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening aashu eishoru enkiok enye, pee eibelekenya aaing'uaa entorroni enye nemeitoki aapejoki enkorropil kulie aitin.

English: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
Masaai: Ilbaat loo ndapidapo epuo ninche aamany, ingumot enkop o olkutot loo ndapidapo.

English: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
Masaai: Toning'oki nanu, nikiwaliki; aaidimua nanu eng'olikinoto ai atalepunye nanu,

English: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: kake enchooi olasar opejori, ilo asar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; aapolos oloing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,

English: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
Masaai: Eikurrukurro olng'atuny; ai ng'ae lemeureishoyu: Eiroro Olaitoriani Enkai; aing'ae lemeibonisho?”

English: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Masaai: Talama entorroni nias isupati, ing'oru eseriani, nisuj ninye.

English: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
Masaai: Nejo Yudas Iskariot, obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena, (ilo oyooki akaldaa)

English: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
Masaai: Etalepori oltau lai ti atua nanu, ore enkaraki ina kaadamu nanu iyie, ebaiki enkop e Yordan o ene Hermon, ebaiki oldoinyo le Misar.

English: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaji o enkarsisisho naa enjung'o naing'uaa iloopapa, kake ore enkitok ng'en naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa.

English: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
Masaai: Nesotu Yosef impisai pooki naanotoki te nkop e Misiri o te nkop e Kanaan, te ntapa nainyiang'utua; neyau Yosef nena pisai aya enkaji e Farao.

English: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
Masaai: Masaa e sahabu, enkosholai, o soito oogol enkinyang'a o lului, o lkarash oopuyiapui o lmorijo, o loonyokie o mpukunot pooki oo lkeek oorropil o ntokitin pooki naaguetuni too lala loo lkanchaoni, o ntokitin pooki oo nkeek naagol enkinyang'a, o suyai, o esekenkei o ltoto ooibor.

English: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
Masaai: Ore sii kuna naa indung'eta e rashe e Solomon naatisira iltung'ana le Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
Masaai: Ore naa, intae iloomanya Yerusalem o ltung'ana le Yuda, atoomono intae, enguanareki nanu o ina kurma ai oo sabibu.

English: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina emincho ntoyie inyi meyama ilayiok lenye, nimiyaya sii ntoyie enye aayamaki ilayiok linyi. Niming'oruru aekata osotua o ninche o karsisisho enye eji pee igolulu, nitumutumu aainosa endaa sidai eina kop nintaa enjung'ore oo nkera inyi ntarasi.’

English: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
Masaai: oltung'ani oata mbaa are to ltau lemeuno too rrekiei lenyena pooki.

English: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
Masaai: “Ore intae intare aainei, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, ekaiguanare enker o enker, naiguanare ilmeregeshi o loroi.

English: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
Masaai: nintaa osiwuo ilkiliku linono, nintaa olang'at le nkima ilaisiaayiak linono.

English: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
Masaai: Tooro olchumati lino kat naapishana arashu isiet, amu miyiolo ajo kaa torroni napukoki enkop.

English: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
Masaai: Aainyo naa pee kining'ito iyiook pooki eiro nkutukie ang naaikini iyiook?

English: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
Masaai: Ore te na bae keetae nkumok naaji naagol elimunoto, amu eijo ketagolo intae ilukuny mining'ung'u.

English: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
Masaai: Eitirrish likae tung'ani enkolong nabo aitulusoo te nkae, neitirrish likae nkolong'i pooki aitoris. Enchoo pooki tung'ani metonyorrai te ndamunoto enye makewan.

English: If a man have two wives, one beloved, and another hated, and they have born him children, both the beloved and the hated; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated:
Masaai: “Teneeta oltung'ani nkituaak are, enkirotet o entinki, netoikitio ninche ninye nkera, ina kirotet o entinki; naa tenaa ore olkikau naa oleina tinki,

English: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
Masaai: Enkaraki natemenayie ninye ororei lo Laitoriani, netigila enkitanapata enye, ore ilo tung'ani keiwuang'ieki tukul, ore eng'oki enye naa keaku shumata ninye.”

English: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
Masaai: Ore enkitok namoda neilepilep; nemeutaroyu, nemeeta enkurruna nayiolo.

English: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol nkera pooki oo Siraeli ina kima edou, o enkitoo o Laitoriani te shumata ina aji e Nkai, neirrugo ninche aaitabaiki nkomomi enkop, te ndung'oroto, neserem neisho Olaitoriani enashe ejo, “Amu aisupat ninye, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neye Shaul, neitoreisho Baalhanan olayioni le Akbor te rishata enye.

English: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
Masaai: “Ore ilayiok linono pokira aare likitoikioki te nkop e Misiri eton eitu alotu enitii tene te Misiri; naa ilaainei; Efraim o Manase eaku ilaanei anaa paa ilaainei Ruben o Simon.

English: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
Masaai: “Kake ayiolo nanu oltonei lino, o enkipang'ata ino o enjing'unoto ino, oina nikigilunore iyie nanu.

English: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lipalakiki embae ake pooki, natapalaka sii nanu. Amu ore olatapalaka, te naa kaata enatapalaka, nataasa ina te nkaraki intae, anaa ketii Kristo, ine.

English: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
Masaai: Eitabayie Olaitoriani engoro enye etubukuo ninye engoro enye nairowua; neiyupuyup anaa enkima te Sion, nemut ilkitamanyunot lenyena.

English: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
Masaai: Amu kepuonu nkolong'i, nikintamuat lmang'ati linono oolkerenket, nikipunyaki too nkaloli pooki,

English: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
Masaai: “Aing'ae ele otiu enduaata enye anaa entadekenya, newang anaa olapa, anaa enkolong, neitureisho anaa enjore naata inankan.

English: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
Masaai: Ore too le Shilo naa: Asaia ilo kikau, o layiok lenyena.

English: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooitobira nenyaanyukie ninche; naa neijia etiu lelo pooki ooisilig ninche.

English: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina kata nikilo Olaitoriani aisho enkiyagata te ina mion o to sina lino, o te ina kisiaayiare nikitipikaki isiaaisho,

English: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
Masaai: Na ti nijing'ijing'i enkaji eroroki.

English: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
Masaai: Neirorie Enkai Israel too nkitoduat e kewarie nejoki ninye, “Yakobo, Yakobo,” nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
Masaai: Neponari Yesu eng'eno, nebulu, neitiship Enkai o ltung'ana.

English: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
Masaai: Ore apa enkitok e Amram naa keji Yokebed, entito e Lawi, apa natoikioki Lawi te Misiri; neiki ninye Amram Aron o Musa o Miriam enkanashe enye.

English: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku keetae nkanas imiet ti atua enkop e Misiri, naairo enkutuk e Kanaan. Neinos olmumai pee eiruk Olaitoriani loo lororani. Ore nabo e kuna naa kepuoi aajo Enkanasa e Nkolong.

English: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, laa ninye ake oas mbaa e nking'asia.

English: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oas intorrok neeta entiyoto e mpaashata oo nkitanapat; ing'ok empaashata o nkitanapat.

English: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
Masaai: Te nening oltung'ani irorei laainei nemeibung nemaiguanare nanu ninye, amu eitu alotu pee aiguanare enkop, kake pee aitajeu enkop.

English: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
Masaai: Eminguanare anaa inaalioo, kake enguanare te nkiguana oo sipat.”

English: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
Masaai: Ore enkisudoroto e lelo akir oopishana litoduaa te nkaina ai e tatene, o lelo kilang'ilang'eta oopishana le sahabu, ore lakir oopishana naa ilmalaika loo sirito naapishana ore ilkilang'ilang'eta naa sirito, pokira naapishana.

English: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
Masaai: Nesaru aaibung ninye.

English: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho neibung isiaaitin aainei o metabau enkiting'oto naisho ninye engolon meitoria loreren.

English: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata, ng'ura etipika Olaitoriani oltau le lejare kulo oibonok pooki; eimaka Olaitoriani embae torrono tialo iyie.”

English: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
Masaai: Inchoo ilakir lenyena le nkakenya emisimisu nchoo ninye eisiligu ewang'an nemetum nemedol osirua enkakenya tenewang'u.

English: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
Masaai: Kake ore Saulo, oji Paulo, eiganya Enkiyang'et Sinyati, neing'ode ninye,

English: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
Masaai: Neng'uarrayu ninche oleng aalang sahabu, aalang ninye sahabu sidai, nemelok sii aalang enaisho nelang olkenkei le mulug.

English: For thus saith the LORD unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda: Ira iyie sidai anaa Gilead te nanu, itiu iyie anaa endukuya e oldoinyo le Lebanon kake esipa kaaitaa nanu iyie olpurkel o enkanasa neme manya.

English: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
Masaai: Ore pee ebulu enkano, neiu ilng'anayio nebulu sii ninye endiati.

English: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Tiniyieuu nanukaa entang'atang'a ai aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, entoning enajo, entoomonokoki te Efron olayioni le Sohar,

English: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
Masaai: Etiu ninche anaa ntare naayae enemeneng'a, neaku keeya olchekut lenye; neitoriori ninche aadoiki Engumoto, ore esidano e nkitobirunoto enye neidaaya aish; neaku enemeneng'a enkang enye.

English: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
Masaai: Ore Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ilo sinka le Solomon olayioni le Daudi, nedumunye agilunore olkitok lenye.

English: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
Masaai: Naarik nanu aitaman ninche; naa ing'ura, etii apa iloik kumok oleng ina nong'oto; naa ing'ura etoito ninche oleng.

English: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
Masaai: Neimulumuli apa shumata lelo gilat te lelo tarakua ootipikaki shumata nena ng'apeta artam oimiet, etii ake iltarakua tomon o imiet olkereri obo.

English: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
Masaai: Metaa einyo Abraham tadekenya enasirie neirot osikiria lenye, nerik ilbarnot lenyena oare tenebo enkayioni enye Isaak. Nedung'u ilkeek ooinokie olasar opejori, nedumunye alo ewueji netiaka ninye Enkai.

English: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
Masaai: Neibung ninche osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki nkolong'i naapishana te nchipai; amu eitishipa ninche Olaitoriani, neibelekenya oltau lo laiguanani le Asiria aibelekenyakino ninche, ometaa etareto ninye ninche te siaai e nkaji e Nkai, Enkai e Israel.

English: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
Masaai: Ore anaa elototo oo ng'arrin oo mbartan, neipid ninche too nchumat oo ldoinyo, anaa endarata enkima nainos isuut, anaa enjore nagol, natoluaakine olarrabal.

English: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
Masaai: “Kainyoo nanu ayau dukuya Olaitoriani, nalotu airrugo te dukuya Enkai natii shumata aisul? Kalotu nanu dukuya ninye oo lasarri oopejori too lasho lo lari obo?

English: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
Masaai: neirriwaa Toi olayioni lenye Yoram enetii olaiguanani Daudi, pee eisho ninye enchunet, o pee eisho ninye enchunet enkaraki nataarare Hadadesa nemir ninye; amu kesej apa eeta Hadadesa olarrabal o Toi. Neyau Yoram te nebo ninye ntokitin e nkosholai, o sahabu, o no suyai.

English: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya nkolong'i naashukore, neing'uari enkayioni Yesu te Yerusalem. Nemeiyiolo intoiwuo enyena.

English: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
Masaai: Nelimu ina aibalunye. Nerik Petero ninye neiteru aikok.

English: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
Masaai: Tenelo oltung'ani airo mbaa e nkijape o elejare, ejo, “Kaaliki nanu iyie ilomon le naisho oo sabibu o enaisho napi?” Neidim ninye ataa olalikioroni lele orere!

English: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
Masaai: ore ilo tung'ani oiseyie mbaa naaikununo neijia neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa nemeinos nena tokitin sinyat meteleku ake teneituku osesen lenye te nkare.

English: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
Masaai: Kaae nelusoo olaiguanani Solomon too laiguanak pooki le nkop, te karsisisho o te ng'eno.

English: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
Masaai: Meetae apa hoo obo le Anakim otelekua ti atua enkop oo ltung'ana le Israel; te Gasa ake, ti atua Gati, o ti atua Ashdod, etelekutua embata.

English: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani. Nelo ninye abik tembata eilo erata le Kerit tenkalo oloosaen to lkeju le Yordan.

English: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.
Masaai: Kake eeta apa Amnon olchore, oji enkarna Yonadab, olayioni le Shimea, olalashe le Daudi; ore apa Yonadab naa oltung'ani kalamas oleng.

English: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
Masaai: Netii duoo enkikompe e Farao enkaina ai, naitayu ilng'anayio loo sabibu, naironyaki enkare enye ina kikompe, napik ina kikompe e Farao inkaik e Farao.”

English: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
Masaai: “Etaasa inkituaak kumok imbaa sidain oleng: kake ore iyie ilang ninche pooki.”

English: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
Masaai: o Gedor o Ahio, o Sakaria, o Miklot,

English: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
Masaai: Kairriwaki nanu emayianata ai shumata intae to lari le ile pee etum atoiu ilng'anayio too larin okuni.

English: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
Masaai: Ore Isaakar naa osikiria ogol, neirrag te rishata oo muatat oo ntare;

English: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
Masaai: Iloobore empukunoto ake pooki e nkarruoisho, o entorroni, o ing'uarrat, ilaa ntorrok ake edol, iloobore olom, o ilooitayu loikop enchankar, olosek torrono, esayiet, enkurrare,

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu te nkitanapata e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang, o te ne Kristo Yesu osiligi lang.

English: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo apolosani ninche, “Enchom te seriani. Ore ina lototo nipuopuo netii abori enkong'u o Laitoriani.”

English: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
Masaai: Kalo ele olotu eing'uaa Edom, oishopito ilkilani oonyokie ooing'uaa Bosara, kalo ilo olotu eishopo ilkilani le nkitoo, olotu te nkitoo o te ngolon? “Nanu ilo oibalunye esipata, Olmagilani oitajeusho.”

English: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
Masaai: Nepuku empuruo too nkumeishin enyena, nepuku enkima nanyaisho te nkutuk enye, o nkuk naaishu naapuku te ninye.

English: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o are, to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:
Masaai: Neponaa Ahitofel ajoki Absalom, “Nchooki nanu mategelu iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon o are, pee aipang nanu amir Daudi kewarie.

English: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina niking'eliki Sidon; neing'urrie Yulio Paulo, neisho meshomo abaiki lchoreta lenyena meitoomoni.

English: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
Masaai: “To sarge le lelo oosesekuani, te ilata e lelo magil, eitu eshuko enkawuo e Yonatan, neitu eshukunye olalem le Saul erok.

English: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo nkolong'i artam, etulusoyie enkeeya enye, neitodol kewan ninche nkatitin kumok, too nkoitoi naaitadedeyie aaoru ninche olng'ash nchere keishu; netoduaa ninche ninye, eirorie ninche aimaki mbaa e nkitoria e Nkai.

English: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
Masaai: Nele osotua laitayu o enkaji e Israel te nelusoo nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo. Kapik nkitanapat aainei atua lukuny enye, naiger ninche ti atua iltauja lenye, naa kaaku Enkai enye, neaku ninche iltung'ana laainei.

English: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
Masaai: Emintaa ake ate olminong te pooki toki naikurtutari; nimindurukiekie ate te ninche, pee miakuku ake ilolminong.

English: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
Masaai: Amu ore duoo te na kewarie neitashe olmalaika le Nkai nara nanu olenye naa ninye aserem,

English: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
Masaai: Kake ore Enkai, naa ninye naitagol ilooata, osina, neitagol iyiook te mbaunoto e Tito;

English: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
Masaai: o enaisho oo sabibu pee eitiship oltau le tung'ani, o eilata pee eitawang enkomom enye, o endaa pee eitagol enkishui e tung'ani.

English: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
Masaai: neiu Yosia Yekonia o lalashera lenyena te nkata e yararoto e Babilon.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
Masaai: neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura, kaitame nanu ninche; keye lelo barnot to lalem; ore layiok lenye o ntoyie enye neye to lameyu;

English: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
Masaai: Etalepori oltau lai te nkaraki osina; ntagoloki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino!

English: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
Masaai: o metaba anaa naing'uraki Olaitoriani ewueji, ewueji nebikie ilo magilani le Yakobo.”

English: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ilalashera lenye o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana o ntomoni ile. Iltung'ana oata enkidimata oleng ninche, tenkaraki e nkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
Masaai: neitoki aya nena keek oltarakuai o hisopo oina arasha nanyokie tenebo ina motonyi naishu. Neitadoiki ninche atua ilo sarge le motonyi nateyieng'aki tiatua enkare naruko, neisuaki enkaji katitin naapishana.

English: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
Masaai: Te nepuku enkiyang'et enye nerrinyokino ninye enkop; ore te ina olong neish nkitobirat enyena.

English: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore etoni o eitashe, naa nanu ake eimaki eranyisho.

English: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naapuonu neibung Yakobo ntona, neitapuku Israel neiu ntilitan neiput enkop pooki ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
Masaai: Tooko enkare naing'uaa enchorro ino makewan, ina are narukunye aing'uaa enchorro ino.

English: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
Masaai: Keitabaya Olaitoriani enyorrata enye te nanu; ore enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ebikoo ntarasi. Minturraa iyie esiaai oo nkaik inono.

English: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
Masaai: Neinyototo alo; neitayu enkarasha te nkomom neishop inkilani enyena e nkolia.

English: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu ilng'oborri le Kushan tiatua emion ore iltung'ana le Midian neikirikira.

English: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
Masaai: Kake ore pee elotu ele ayioni lino, otumutaka masaa inono mulayoni, niyieng'aki olkiteng opir.’

English: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
Masaai: Nchoo meishori iyiook iloing'ok oare naa nchoo ninche metegelaki ate obo, nedung'udung neiteleiki ilkeek, kake emipik enkima ine. Naa kaitobir sii nanu olikae oing'oni naiteleiki ilkeek, nemapik enkima ine.

English: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: “Naa ena enkitanapata e ilo lo lmumai, te nelulung'ayu enkata enye e nkiteng'elata: neyauni ninye kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:
Masaai: “Kake ore ilapolosak loo Lawi, lelo ayiok le Sadok, lelo oogolie ewueji ai sinyati, ina kata nashomo iltung'ana le Israel aapong'ori aaing'uaa nanu, kepuonu ninche enatii aanyiku peyie aasiai nanu, naa kaaisiaai nanu aaitaiki nanu nena naapir tenebo ilo sarge, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;

English: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Nebo, naa onom o are.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
Masaai: metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekairo nanu to lom lai oirowua aarare ilkulikae oreren, naarare Edom pooki, lelo ooishoo enkop ai ate metaa enenye te nchipai oltau neimaki inolmena, pee etum aawaita ninye te ngolon.

English: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
Masaai: Nintaa ninche enkitoria o lapolosak le Enkai ang, naa keyooki ninche aaitoreisho te nkop.”

English: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
Masaai: Neshukunye neinepu eirurate, nejoki Petero, “Simon, iyie ilo oirura? Italaikine aishololoyu ena ninye nabo?

English: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina ilo iyie aisho nkishorot ole sere Moreshetgat; ore nkajijik e Akisib naa keaku entoki nalejisho, too laiguanak le Israel.

English: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee meekure ewang sahabu. Kainyoo pee eibelekenye sahabu nasila! Ore lelo soito oosinya neirragaa aaidapasha te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi nalala e nkanasa.

English: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Masaai: Esipata ake, esipata ake tusuja, pee itum atopuaa nijing ina kop nikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
Masaai: “Tiniata eyiolounoto, toning'u ena; toning'o ina najo nanu.

English: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
Masaai: kake kedung'ori ilarruok te ina kop, ore ilaitang'orok nedotuni too ntona.

English: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
Masaai: nesuju ninche Hoshaia, o lpisiaai le lelo kituaak le Yuda,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yehoash apa naataasa ninye, o enkidimata enye oina nataarare Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
Masaai: Emishulare aaku nabo o lelo lemeiruk. Ai ti aji eshula supati o ntorrok? Kaa shula eeta ewang'an o enaimin?

English: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
Masaai: Nanyorraa nanu enkitumurrunoto, amu meeta tung'ani toki sidai tiabori enkolong kake pee edaa, neokisho neshipakino kewan, amu eiriamariyie ena eekenyata enye tiatua nena olong'i e nkishui naisho Enkai ninye tiabori enkolong.

English: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
Masaai: Nedung ninye iltung'ana lenyena metaa ilturrurri okuni, neirrag aanyisho ti ong'ata: neing'orisho ninye nedol iltung'ana eipang'u aapuku te nkanasa, nedumunye ninye, aar ninche nesesekuan ninche.

English: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
Masaai: ‘Medol ninye oltung'ani obo le ilo porror torrono, ina kop apa nainosie olmumai nchere kaisho loo papaai linyi,

English: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.
Masaai: Neitoduaaya pokira oare ate to ltim loo Lfilisti; nejo Ilfilisti, “Eng'ura, epuonu Ilhebrania aaipang'u too ngumot te nenen apa neisudorie ate.”

English: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bigfai naa nkalifuni are o onom o ile.

English: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
Masaai: Naineneng'aki nanu ninche enkiroishi e nkosholai o sahabu o masaa, o nena kishorot te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ang apa naaishorua olaiguanani, o lautarok lenyena, o lkituaak lenyena, elulung'a Israel pooki;

English: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
Masaai: Kake itejo, “A-a! Eikikuet iyiook too mbartan,” ore enkaraki ina, ikuetikuete aapuo, “Ore iyiook nikikuetie mbartan aakuet oleng,” neaku keten oleng lelo oosuj intae.

English: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
Masaai: Kake atolikio intae kuna baa pee te nebau enkata enye, nidamumu ninche nchere atolikio intae. “Neitu aliki intae kuna te nkiterunoto, amu aboitare apa intae.

English: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii oltalet le Shekem ina, nejing ninche osempewuet le nkaji e Elberit.

English: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
Masaai: o Elishama, o Eliada, o Elifelet, ooudo,

English: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
Masaai: Ore ti atua Yerusalem te mbata o lturoto loo nkerra, netii ewueji neji te nkutuk oo Lhebrania Betsaida, neeta nchomito imiet.

English: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
Masaai: o Beara olayioni lenye, laa ninye apa eewa olaiguanani Tilgat Pilnesa le Asiria te yararoto. Ninye apa oltung'ani kitok too le Ruben.

English: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
Masaai: Neitoki te nkolong nasujita ina, neitashe Yohana o looiteng'eni aare lenyena;

English: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
Masaai: neibalunye enkordunoto enye too ltung'ana leton meino, nchere ninye otaasa ina.

English: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna baa, ina kata pee eyagaa engoro o laiguanani Serser, nedamu Fashiti ina nataasa o ina naidipaki aatejo enkaraki ninye.

English: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
Masaai: Meeta ninye menye anaa ng'otonye, nemeeta entipat, nemeeta eneiting'ie enkishui enye, kake etiu anaa ilo Oinoti le Nkai, ora olapolosani ntarasi.

English: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia natoning'o osina loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli ooitaa Lmisiri isinkan natadamua naa ilo ning'o lai.

English: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues natoduaa neikununo ana olowuaru keri. Netiu nkejek enyena anaa ino lng'arurumi, netiu enkutuk enye ana eno lng'atuny. Neisho ilo asurai ina ng'ues engolon enye o lorika lenye le nkitoo, o enkidimata sapuk.

English: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
Masaai: Ore pee edol Petero ilo nejoki Yesu, “Olaitoriani, oo ninye ele?”

English: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
Masaai: Naa ore anaa ina nikitaa nabo o ninye te nkeeya enye te nkibatisa ang, netaa ina ketunukayioki iyiook te nebo ninye, neaku ina naitopiwuo Papa ninye too lootuata te nkias e nkitoo, neaku ina enkishui ng'ejuk te iyiook.

English: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto, pee eini Musa, eisudoyioki lapaitin okuni intoiwuo enyena, amu etoduaa ninche aajo aisidai ina kerai; neitu eureyu ninche ina naitanapishe olaiguanani.

English: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
Masaai: Enchoo naa iltauja linyi eitoriori te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai, nipuopuo too nkiguanat enyena, nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat enyena anaa ena olong.”

English: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
Masaai: nijoki ninye, ‘Terretenayu, ntirring'ayu, nimiureishoyu, nemishalu te nkaraki nena oben are e nkima netaa keimisiloo, te nkaraki engoro e Resin o Siria o layioni le Remalia.

English: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
Masaai: Metaa etawala ilo tung'ani oitashe tiatua lelo keek ooji mihadasi ajoki ‘ore kuna naa inaairriwua Olaitoriani meetu aaman enkop pooki.

English: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
Masaai: Keru osikiria le ntim eeta olkujita, anaa olkiteng einosita olkujita.

English: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki oomanita ninche neretu ninche too masaa e nkosholai, o te sahabu, o too masaa, o too ng'uesi, o too ntokitin naagol enkinyiang'a tenebo nena pooki naaishoruaki to lpela.

English: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
Masaai: Nedumu ninye nelo airragie te ndapash o ltung'ani le Nkai, neiken kutukaji, neipang alo.

English: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
Masaai: “Maape iyiook emanyisho enye; mateserem iyiook ti abori nkejek enyena!”

English: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
Masaai: Ore enkiyang'et e tung'ani naa oltaa lo Laitoriani, ojur oleng pooki toki e atua enye.

English: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
Masaai: Neitoki ile Kohat aadumunye aaidur, enapita nena tokitin naasinya, neitasheyie ilo ng'obor le Nkai eton eitu ebau ninche.

English: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
Masaai: Ore apa endaa naitobiri te nkolong nabo naa olkiteng obo o nkerra ile gelunot; eitobiraki sii apa ilukunkuni te nkaraki nanu. Ore ake too nkolong'i tomon netii ilbenia le naisho oo sabibu te nkumoi; ore ake etii kuna pooki eitu nanu aikilikuanu endaa naipirare olbalusui, amu keiroishi apa esinkaisho te kulo tung'ana.

English: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
Masaai: peyie etum iltauja lenye aatalepori, nebatata ilkumok too nkishomin enye. Aishorua ilo alem oimerlel; Aha! eitobiruno ninye anaa enkiwuang'ata, netisikaki peyie etum ateyiengisho.

English: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Masaai: Ore pee edolu ninye Ilfarisayo kumok o Sadukayo epuonu meibatisae nejoki ninche, “Naishoi oo lasuriaa ai ng'ae otoroja intae elanya engoro nalotu?
