English: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
Masaai: kake ore olook ina are naisho nanu, nemetir enkure ntarasi; amu ore ina are naisho nanu keaku enchorro ti atua ninye, naitootuaakino enkishui oo ntarasi.”

English: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
Masaai: Ore ina niun naa enkantererai ake, naa ene nkano aashu ene ae ake tapa.

English: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
Masaai: amu irara apa intae enaimin, kake irara taata ewang'an ti atua Olaitoriani; enchom anaa nkera e wang'an,

English: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku eitanapishe olaiguanani, neitobir ninche osanduku nepik ninye boo ina kishomi e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
Masaai: Neitayu iltung'ana pooki ilgiso le sahabu ootii nkiyiaa enye, neyaki ninche Aron.

English: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
Masaai: Keidim ilarikok arruok aaibung'ata o iyie, lelo ooitobiru ntabo te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat?

English: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
Masaai: “Naa keng'as Olaitoriani aisho enkisulata lelo ng'oborri le Yuda, pee eaku ore enkitoo e nkaji e Daudi o enkitoo e lelo oomanya Yerusalem, nemelus te nkitoo Yuda.

English: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
Masaai: Metaa eshomo ayau ninche ayaki ng'otonye, neitobir ng'otonye endaa sidai namelok naaijo enoshi nanyor.

English: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
Masaai: “Kaji intae inkoko pee ijojo, ‘Kira iyiook iloing'ok, iltung'ana ooidipa olarrabal?’

English: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet ele apa naa o sirua; nkolong'i naapishana einosi imukateni neitu eisuishieki.

English: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
Masaai: Neinosaki ilo aisiaayiani Isaak imbaa pooki naataasate.

English: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
Masaai: o ilaiguanak pooki le Turo, o laiguanak pooki le Sidon, o laiguanak lo lomanaa le naiposha;

English: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Ashtarot.

English: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
Masaai: Kake alotoo aasita ena ake naasita taata, pee maisho erishata lelo ooyieu ina, ilooyieu erishata naitoduaarie ate anaa kerisiore esiaai naishooki ninche enaang, amu etejo ninche ninye eeta.

English: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
Masaai: neiger ninche ilautarok oogilunore ninche pee eitashal ninche teina kiaas enye, too nkolong'i pooki e nkitoria e Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, ometabaiki enkitoria e Darias olaiguanani le Parsia.

English: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
Masaai: Ore ilo asar linyi le ntapa enkiterata enchorie Olaitoriani olasar tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
Masaai: Ore ninye eitu elotu ororei ajing olng'ejep lai, ng'ura, Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie pooki.

English: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
Masaai: ore isinkir le naiposha, o motonyi o loing'ang'e o nguesi e ong'ota, o ntokitin pooki naaiserpepiari tioriong e nkop, o ltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop, naa keilanyisho pooki te dukuya nanu, ore ildoinyo naa kenang'uni abori, ore imartin nesulari, ore pooki suntai naa keurokino enkop.

English: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neirragie isoito barrikon ooji oniks neikodi te sahabu, nepiki te nkarriyiano te nebo nkarn oo layiok le Isirael.

English: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
Masaai: netunukayioki intae te nebo ninye ti atua enkibatisa, naa te ninye enyaakaki aaitopiu intae te nkirukoto ti atua enkiaas e Enkai, naitopiwuo ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata.

English: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
Masaai: Nejoki isinkan lo laiguanani olaiguanani, “Ng'ura, eanyita isinkan linono pee eas enaba anaa enadung'u olkitok lai olaiguanani.”

English: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
Masaai: Neaku enkop enaisarkionieki, neaku aitamio nanu enkitarruorroto enye, nelopu enkop lelo oomanya.

English: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
Masaai: Erukokino inchorroi pooki enaiposha, kake meboreyu ae kata enaiposha. Ometabaiki ine nerukunore nchorroi, nenena naaruko ake aaigil.

English: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
Masaai: shomo tung'uai ine nimbelekenya alo enkalo o loosaen, nilo aisudori to erata le Kerit. Aa taa oloo saen lo lkeju le Yordan.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ng'ura, kalotu nanu te nkatampoi nairrusha, pee etum iltung'ana aatoning te naairorie iyie, pee kitum sii aairuko ntarasi.” Neitoki Musa aliki Olaitoriani irorei loo ltung'ana.

English: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
Masaai: Naa eipik ilo orika lo lng'ur enchumata o sanduku; ore atua ilo sanduku nipik ina shakenisho naaisho nanu.

English: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
Masaai: Amaa Abana o Fabar, lelo kejek le Dameski, aimesidan ninche aalang nkariak pooki e Israel? Aimaidim nanu aitukuore nena naishiu?” Neaku eibelekenye ninye alo te ngoro.

English: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
Masaai: Amaa kenya te mpiunoto, etiu neijia, keaku ene ng'ae ina kitok? Amu eyama pokira oopishana ninye.”

English: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
Masaai: Entoomon pee meaku enaipuk inyi ene nkata o loirujuruj anaa enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.

English: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
Masaai: Amu iyiook emuratare nasipa, ilooserem Enkai te nkiyang'et, nikiwuasare Kristo Yesu, nimiking'idare osesen.

English: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon Petero ninye, “Lo Kitok, kaji ilo?” Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ore enalo, nimikindim atusuju taata, kake eikisuju te siadi.”

English: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
Masaai: Ore eilata o esonkoyo neitiship oltau, kake kepolos enyamali oltau.

English: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
Masaai: ketiu anaa oltung'ani okuet ailany olng'atuny nenang'are olng'arurumi, aashu elo atua aji neigaraki enkaina enye esuntai neony olasurai ninye.

English: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
Masaai: Amu kejo aa ilkigerot? “Eiruko Abraham Enkai ore enkaraki ina neikenaki Enkai ninye esupatisho.”

English: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.
Masaai: Nemaata embae enye nauno najo aigeroki Olaiguanani Kitok. Ina pee atorikuo dukuya iyie, Olaiguanani Agripa, peyie aa ore pee eidipi aatujur natum enaiger ajo.

English: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
Masaai: Ore olorora le keper nerrarra aaku enterit. Ore oloing'ang'e pooki nepiyaya anaa endapana ore ilo orora pooki nerrarrunye anaa enasulunye mbenek o lng'aboli, anaa enasulunye ilng'abolo ooto to lchani.

English: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile isotutu; kake ore te nkolong e naapishana aa ene sabato nemetii hoo toki.”

English: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ntorioki iroruat inono iwuejitin neeidaa; einyala olmang'atinta pooki toki te wueji ino sinyati!

English: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
Masaai: “Ng'ura ara nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e pooki naishu; keetae hoo toki nagol te nanu?

English: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
Masaai: Neing'oru ilaiguanak pooki le nkop enetii Solomon ejo pee ening eng'eno enye natipika Enkai atua endamunoto enye.

English: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.
Masaai: “Neaku te ine netii ninye eirriwuaki ina aina, nesiri ele kigeroto.

English: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
Masaai: Neidim pooki lee tiatua ilapolosak ainosa, entoki nasinya ena oleng.

English: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
Masaai: Nebatata nabo kata te nkalo oo nkejek enyena neye; nejing'u lelo barnot neinepu etua, neipung'ie aaya, nepuoi aanukaa aaitatashaki olpayian lenye.

English: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
Masaai: Eisha ilmang'ati te nkidaata oo ntarasi; nitadotuo iyie nkanas enye; ore endamunoto enye neisha.

English: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
Masaai: Neiputukuny ninche, nejokino, “Ai ng'ae doi ele? Olaa kening ninye osiwuo o enaiposha?”

English: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
Masaai: Netumie sii elde oitaakaki are kulie are.

English: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
Masaai: Ore amu keyieu Pilato neitiship ina siamo, nelaaki Barabas neng'as aishooyo Yesu metooshi too nkeenta neitoki aitarasaa metashei.

English: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
Masaai: o metabaiki ina olong apa nailepieki aaya shumata. Ore eton eitu eilepieki neitanapisho te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, aitanap lelo tung'ana apa ootegelua metaa lkipaareta, lenyena.

English: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
Masaai: neaku emincho ake etumi oltung'ani omenaa ninye. Entaretoi meshomo te seriani pee elotu enatii. Amu aanyita nanu neanyita sii lalashera.

English: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
Masaai: Eitu alotu aipot lelo supati kake ilaing'okok meetu aairridu.”

English: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
Masaai: Ore teine neya Sadok olapolosani olmouo le ilata to lng'obor nebukoki Solomon aput. Neitoki ninche aaosh emowuo; nejo iltung'ana pooki tobikoi olaiguanani Solomon.

English: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
Masaai: o nanu sii, pee aaishori enkiroroto te nabol enkutuk te mpijan alikioo mbaa naaisudoro e kulo Omon Supati,

English: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
Masaai: Etashala nkung aainei te nkaraki eenata empukoroto e kewan; netasasa osesen lai aaku iloik ake.

English: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o supat naa enchorro e nkishui, kake ore enkutuk oltorrono nenuk entorroni.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Ntorioi ina pere natii enkaina ino ing'orie Ai, amu kaaisho nanu iyie apik atua enkaina ino.” Neitorioo Yoshua ina pere apa natii enkaina enye aing'orie ina anasa.

English: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: “Eminyal olomoni arashu imbooki ninye enkop, amu irara sii apa intae ilomon te nkop e Misiri.

English: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajoki Doeg, “Imbelekenyayu iyie tusulakinoyu ilapolosak.” Neibelekenya Doeg le Edom nedoiki lelo apolosak, near ninye ina olong iltung'ana ntomoni isiet o imiet ooishopito enkila dorrop sidai.

English: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Masaai: nejoki Isaya ninche, “Entiaaki olkitok linyi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Miureishoyu tenkaraki lelo rorei litoning'o, laa ninche aatusukenyie nanu isinkan leilo aiguanani le Asiria.

English: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
Masaai: Etejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, “Ng'ura kayau nanu enkitamioto shumata Amon le Sebes, o Farao, o Misiri, o nkaitin enyena o laiguanak lenyena, shumata Farao o lelo ooisilig ninye.

English: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
Masaai: Eitu taa eisho Enkai ninye hoo enkiti wueji metujung'o aitaa enenye, eitu hoo eisho enkiti rashe e nkop, kake eishoo Enkai ninye o siligi ajoki keaku ene ishoi enye eshomo ninye. Naa ore taa ejoki Enkai ninye neijia, meeta Abraham enkerai.

English: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul Daudi, “Mindim iyie ashomo ataarare ele Filisti; amu ira iyie olbarnoti ake, naa oltung'ani apa ninye lo larrabal ebaiki kitisho enye.”

English: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
Masaai: Te neikirikira enkop o lelo pooki oomanya, nanu ilo oitasheyie ing'apeta enyena.

English: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Usiel naa Mika, ore too layiok le Mika naa Shamir.

English: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
Masaai: “Metaa ekaaiguanare iyie, iyie na aji e Israel, pooki ng'ae te risioroto oo inkoitoi enyena, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Irridu nimbelekenya aing'uaa intorrok inono pooki, arashu eyaku ing'ok inono enkidaaroto ino.

English: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
Masaai: Ore arrinyo, nadol te nkiyopata olkeju ilkeek kumok te nchoto nabo o te nkae.

English: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keitupukoo ate ilchoreta lo loyamishe eton eisiritore? Ore eton eisiritore oloyamishe, nemeidim aaitupukoi ate.

English: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
Masaai: Nerik Musa o Aron kulo tung'ana ootegeluaki;

English: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee kincho nanu matoduaa ntorrok, naing'or enyamali? Etii enkidaata o larrabal dukuya nanu; naatudumakine enyamali o enchankar.

English: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's:
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki lelo lo lgilata lenye, “Ore Naomi enoshi natorrinyunye te nkop e Moab, nemirita enkiti wueji e nkop apa o ltung'ani lo lgilata lang oji Elimelek.

English: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
Masaai: “Wootu entodol oltung'ani laatolikio mbaa pooki apa nataasa: kebaiki sa naa ele Kristo?”

English: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Ara nanu empiunoto nara enkishui. Ore ilo laairuk nanu, ore ninye te neye, neishu;

English: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
Masaai: o ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o noo nkineji, o nkeek o lerai,

English: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
Masaai: Naa intobir isaanini enyena e nkorropil o masaa enyena naapikunyeki olasar opikuni te sahabu nasila ntobir ninche.

English: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
Masaai: “Ninkenikene intae ebaiki ina akenya etulusoyie sabato, ebaiki ina akenya apa niyautua orridati lo lasar oyuki wikii naapishana naalulung'a,

English: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong isilan sidain o lbarnot naa keiterre te nkure.

English: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
Masaai: Eyau enkiba enchankar sapuk, kake ore enyorrata neimulumul nkitarruorrot pooki.

English: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
Masaai: “Tenipuonunu kenya ina kop e Kanaan naisho nanu intae metaa eninyi, tenapik nanu enkeeya oo lbolot atua enkaji tiatua ina kop inyi,

English: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam o imiet le yararoto ang, te nkiterunoto o lari te nkolong e tomon o lapa, to lari le tomon oong'uan eidipaki aaibung'a enkanasa, teina olong; netii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu.

English: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
Masaai: Kake kaipot nanu Olaitoriani; naa kaaitajeu nanu Olaitoriani.

English: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
Masaai: Ore teina kata, ore ake pee edol Daudi ajo etawalikia Olaitoriani ninye teilo kurroto oiutuutishoreki le Onan loo Lyebusi, neitobir ninye ilasarri lenyena teine.

English: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
Masaai: kake etiaaka ninche, “Kalo ake pee aliki sii ninche kulie ang'itie kulo omon supati le nkitoria e Nkai. Ina pee aairriwuaki.”

English: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
Masaai: Naa keaku te nkaraki Aron o layiok lenyena, neinos ninche tiatua ine wueji sinyati, amu ore te ninye naa erubata sinyati oleng naing'uaa nena kishorot naapejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, embae nadamuni anaake.”

English: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
Masaai: Imbung'aki iyiook mbariak, nena bariak kutiti, nena naainyal inkurman ang oo sabibu, amu ore inkurman ang oo sabibuni neitapuka.”

English: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina neitayuni ilasarri oopejori lianaake, ilasarri lo lapa ng'ejuk too siruai pooki gelunot to Laitoriani, o lasarri le pooki ng'ae oitayu nkishorot o lpela aisho Olaitoriani.

English: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
Masaai: Neitoki Elisha alotu Gilgal naa aisapuk olameyu teina kop. Ore etonita nkera oo loibonok le Nkai te dukuya ninye, nejoki ninye, osinka lenye, “Ntobira emoti sapuk pee iyier endaa te nkaraki ninche.”

English: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria enye neiriwaa ninye iltung'ana lenyena kituaak, Benhail, o Obadiah, o Sekaria, o Netanel, o Mikaia, pee epuo aaiteng'enisho too nkanas e Yuda.

English: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Perosh, naa nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti kata nedol likae ejo, “Ira sii iyie obo lenye.” Kake etejo Petero, “Ero, mara nanu.”

English: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
Masaai: Nereu osinka intamesin tomon olkitok lenye nelo eya nkishorot kumok oo mpukunot pooki to lkitok lenye nedumunye alo Mesopotamia, enkanasa e Nahor.

English: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
Masaai: Nebol taa Filipo enkutuk neiteru te ilo kigeroto, neinosaki ninye ilomon supati le Yesu.

English: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
Masaai: “Olapa taa Musa ilo otanyaita ninche ejo, ‘Ai ng'ae doi likinchoo iyie ntoria nirish iyiook?’ Ninye eirriwaka Enkai metaa oloitore nesaru te nkaina e ilo malaika oipang'aka to lnchani.

English: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Delila ajo etolikio ninye mbaa enyena pooki, neirriwaa olkilikuai aipotu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti pooki, ejo, “Elepu wootu ena kata nabo, amu aatolikio mbaa enyena pooki.” Neilepu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti aapuonu enetii ninye, neyau mpisiai too nkaik enye.

English: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
Masaai: Nening ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ina neing'oru enkoitoi pee ear ninye; kake etureita ninye, amu eing'asiayie enkikoo enye ilo orora pooki.

English: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
Masaai: Kake etoduaa ninche ninye elo te shumata e nkare nejo ke nkukuu, nebuaku aaishir;

English: Then Job answered and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoab awal ajo:

English: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
Masaai: neton te ine o metua Herode; pee ebaya enapa natejo Olaitoriani to loiboni le Nkai pee ejo, “Aipotuo enkerai ai aitung'uaa Misiri.”

English: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
Masaai: Ae taata enkata e dukuya naikilikuanishore nanu Enkai te nkaraki ninye? A-a! Mincho olaiguanani eomonu ae toki to sinka lenye arashu te nkaji pooki e papaai lai; amu eitu eyiolou osinka lino ae toki te kuna pooki, te sapuk arashu te nkiti.”

English: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
Masaai: tenaa olapolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput oas eng'oki, ayau entorroni shumata iltung'ana, nchoo ninye eitayu tenkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa oloti oing'oni lemeeta entioto aisho Olaitoriani metaaolasar le ng'oki.

English: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
Masaai: “Eilepa ltung'ana aare aapuo aaomon te nkaji e Nkai, naa Olfarisayoi obo naa olasotoni le kodi olikae.

English: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
Masaai: ninyang'unye nena pisai entoki pooki naba anaa eniyieu, olkiteng aashu enker, enaisho oo sabibu aashu enaisho napi, entoki ake ninye naba anaa eniyieu; nilo iyie ainos teine te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino ning'ida, iyie o lmarei lino.

English: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.
Masaai: Nedung'u Olaitoriani enkata, ejo “Taaisere eas Olaitoriani ena bae ti atua ena kop.”

English: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Saul, neirriwaa ninye kulikae kipaareta, neibonisho sii ninche. Neitoki Saul airriwaa ilkiliku te nkata e uni, neibonisho ake sii ninche.

English: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
Masaai: Nemayian ninche Rebeka ejoki: “Enkanashe ang taa iyie ng'otonye oo nkalifuni, oo nkalifuni tomon, naa inchoo metujung'o eishoi ino kishomi elelo ooiba ninche.”

English: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
Masaai: Neyaki ninche ninye ilo asar opejori eitaaki rubat, o endukuya; nepejoo ninye ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neas ina iltung'ana le Israel, neipang'ie ninche too lng'oborri meshomo auluo; ore anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani Musa, ina etaasa iltung'ana le Israel.

English: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
Masaai: toning'o iyie itii keper, ina manyisho ino, nias te risioroto e nena pooki nikimpotie ilo tung'ani loo loreren iyie; pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo enkarna ino, nikiureyu iyie, anaa enaasita iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, netum aatayiolo nchere ore ena aji natesheta nanu te nkarna ino naa enkarna ino eipotieki.

English: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
Masaai: Kake kiyieu pae nikining enijo iyie o nena nilimu; amu pooki enikiyiolo ti alo ena kiteng'enare ng'ejuk napaashari, keimakini te pooki wueji eibai.”

English: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
Masaai: Nadol nanu, epuku te nkutuk e ilo asurai, o te nkutuk e ina ng'ues, o te nkutuk e ilo le lejare, inkiyang'eta uni torrok naaijo ntuaan e nkare.

English: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
Masaai: Aisho intae enkitanapata ng'ejuk, entonyorrata anaa enatonyorra nanu intae.

English: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
Masaai: Yesu le Nasareti etuputo Enkai te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o engolon nelotoo aas isupati, neishiunye lelo pooki ooibooko oloirirua enkop, amu ketii naa Enkai te nebo ninye.

English: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
Masaai: “Torrinyoyu, nilo ajoki Hesekia, ilo kitok loo ltung'ana laainei, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Daudi papaai lino: Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino. Atoduaa nanu ilkiyio linono; ng'ura kaaishiunye nanu iyie; ore te nkolong e uni, naa ilep iyie alo enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
Masaai: Neitoki aliki enkitanyaanyukoto nejoki, “Meetae oltung'ani oboru erashe to lkila ng'ejuk aripaki olkila musana, pee meinyal ilo ng'ejuk elde musana.

English: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aputunye, naing'orisho naa eisidain njo aainei te nanu.

English: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?
Masaai: Ore apa etii ninche embata e nkaji e Mika, neyiolou ninche oltoilo le ilo barnoti le Lawi; neibelekenya ninche nejoki ninye, “Kaing'ae likiyaua iyie ine? Kainyoo iyie iasita tene wueji? Kainyoo esiaai ino tene?”

English: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
Masaai: Errip Olaitoriani ilo omoni, neibung ninye enkoliai o ilo lemeeta menye, kake ore enkoitoi e ilo torrono neyau ninye enkidaata.

English: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
Masaai: Ore eirorita Yesu, neipot Olfarisayoi obo meshomo anya endaa te nkaji enye, nelo, neton anya endaa.

English: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
Masaai: Kanaan apa menye le Sidon, ilo kikau lenye, o Heti,

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
Masaai: Newaliki Benaia olayioni le Yehoida olaiguanani ajo “Esai! meiruko Olaitoriani lai, Enkai anaa enatii Olaitoriani tenebo olkitok lai olaiguanani, metotiwuo neija.

English: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.
Masaai: Nelotu Daudi Baalperasim, nemir Daudi ninche te ine; nejo ninye, “Etigila Olaitoriani ilmang'ati laainei te dukuya nanu, anaa olairrag le enkare teneosh enkuaas.” Neaku ore enkarna e ine wuejinaa keji Baalperasim.

English: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te nkaina enye e tatene o te nkaina enye magilani, ejo, “Maaigil nanu aishooyo entapa inyi metaa endaa oo lmang'ati linyi, nemeok iltung'ana leeiking'a ina aisho inyi oo sabibu naa ninye itanaurikitia;

English: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisik aing'uaa enkuretisho nedoiki atua engumoto, ore eked engumoto ailepu neibung orreshet. Amu kayau nanu kuna baa shumata Moab teilo ari le nkitamioto enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
Masaai: Ore anaa enamanita ildoinyo Yerusalem, neijia etiu Olaitoriani emanita iltungana lenyena, ebaiki ena kata o intarasi.

English: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
Masaai: Keitoriori enkoitoi e ilo asipani; itooro iyie enkoitoi e ilo asipani.

English: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
Masaai: Neaku eishoo olapolosani ninye emukate nasinya, amu metii apa emukate ine meteleku ake ina mukate enkitoduaaroto, naa ninche eiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa dukuya o Laitoriani, pee eitapaashikini imukateni naairowua ina olong naawaki.

English: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
Masaai: Neishiunye ilootigilate iltauja, neen ilbaa lenye.

English: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
Masaai: Oo Efraim kaa nanu aporokinore nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin? Nanu doi ilo likiwaliki nikigolie iyie. Atiu nanu anaa olchani onyori, onyaanyukie oltarakuai, nanu eing'uaa ilng'anayio linono.

English: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
Masaai: Mesioki Olaitoriani agoro neeta enkidimata kitok, nemeeta kata nemeitalaku Olaitoriani entorroni. Ore enkoitoi enye naa olkutati o siwuo, ore nkatampo naa enterit oo nkejek enyena.

English: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
Masaai: Iyie omutan enkop nibukoki enkare, iyie oitubulu oleng; ebore ilo keju le Nkai enkare; iyie oisho ninche enkurma enye, amu neijia iyie ntobira aiko.

English: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
Masaai: “Irorie Serubabel, olbalusui le Yuda, tiaki, etaa enkiti kata pee aikirikirie nanu keper o enkop,

English: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
Masaai: teneilep kulo tung'ana aapuo aaitayu ilasarri te nkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem. Neitoki iltauja le kulo tung'ana aaibelekenyakino olkitok lenye, Rehoboam olaiguanani le Yuda, naar ninche nanu matua nerrinyokino Rehoboam olaiguanani le Yuda.”

English: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.
Masaai: Amaa ti niaata noshi ake baa pooki e nkishon, ei lelo tung'ana leme le toki ti atua esirit igelulu meiguanare?

English: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Masaai: Kaing'ae laayau nanu atua ina anasa nasheta? Kaing'ae laarik nanu Edom?

English: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?
Masaai: Ore ebaiki nkolong'i oo loo papaai linyi itapaasha nkiguanat aainei neitu imbung'ubung'u ninche. Entushukunye enatii, naa kashukokino sii nanu intae ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Kake ijojo ntae; ‘Kaji kinko tenikishukunye?’

English: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
Masaai: meetae likae laaijo ninye too nkitoduaat o too nenking'asia naaishoo Olaitoriani ninye metaasa te nkop e Misiri, te Farao o too sinkan lenyena pooki o te nkop enye pooki.

English: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
Masaai: Netii ine wueji inkituaak kumok naaing'orita te nelakua naatusujutua Yesu eing'uaa Galilaya eisiaaita ninye.

English: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
Masaai: aa taa, Enkai apa tiatua Kristo naitoning'o e nkop o kewan enye. Meshum ninye nemeikenaki iltung'ana nkitadiaat enye, kake eisiliga iyiook aisho olkilikuai oning'oreki ninye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaki Aron o layiok lenyena,

English: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
Masaai: Ira iyie sidai too nkera e tung'ana; etubukokoki empiris enkutuk ino; ore enkaraki ina, kitamayiana Enkai ntarasi.

English: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
Masaai: Ore eshomo ninche aalam enkang e Mika, neishiruni iltung'ana ootii nkajijik ootaaniki enkaji e Mika, nepuo ninche aainepu lelo tung'ana le Dan.

English: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:
Masaai: Amu ore ake ninye pooki ng'ae le nkaji e Israel, arashu olomoni ake pooki tiatua Israel ooroo kewan te nanu, nepik nkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin nemeishu oltau lenye nepik entoki narror oo ntorrok enyena dukuya enkomom enye, eji neitoki ake alotu enetii oloiboni le Nkai pee elotu aikilikuanu imbaa enyena te nanu, ore nanu makewan Olaitoriani naa kawaliki ninye nanu enkorrok ai;

English: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
Masaai: Mejing enkai omoni atua intae; emirrugo aaserem enkai omoni.

English: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Ore taata eitabayie Olaitoriani enkisiligata enye apa naisiligishore, amu atijing'a nanu erishata e Daudi papaai lai, naton to lorika le nkitoo le Israel, anaa apa enaisiligishore Olaitoriani, natesheta nanu enkaji te nkaraki enkarna Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki enkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana neiteru ninche aaitayu olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani. Kake eton eitu eshetuni olkitamanyunoto le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
Masaai: Neaku inkolong'i pooki e Kenan ilarin iip naaudo o tomon, neye ninye.

English: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Miureisho amu ore enkaina e Saul, papaai lai, mikitum iyie; iaku iyie olaiguanani te Israel, naaku nanu oliare te iyie; eyiolo sii Saul papaai lai ena.”

English: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
Masaai: Kuna apa nkarn e lelo tung'ana ooirriwayie Musa meshomo aaikitalan ina kop. Neisho apa Musa Hoshea olayioni le Nuni enkarna, nejo Yoshua.

English: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
Masaai: Neitayu Enkai oloing'ang'e nerish inkariak natii abori oloing'ang'e o nkariak naatii shumata oloing'ang'e, neaku nejia.

English: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
Masaai: nelo asujaa ilo tung'ani le Israel o meshomo olgilata li atua, nerem pokira are, ilo tung'ani le Israel o ina kitok, aipang'ie empere to sesen lenye. Ina taa pee eiwuang'ieki olmeitai too ltung'ana le Israel.

English: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
Masaai: naa ena naishooki Iloreren metang'arieki enjung'ore neaku irubat o sesen obo, le ncholiek e ina kisiligata ti atua Kristo Yesu eimu lelo Omon Supati.

English: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
Masaai: Neikordodisho ninche, neiro mbaa torrok; ore te nkitokoos neiro mbaa naaitorogonyie ilkulikae.

English: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
Masaai: olperere le nkorropil te nebo mbokishi enyena, o ina ilata naputishoreki o ina orropil naisonkoyo o ilo odung'oro le kutuk aji te kutuk aji o lng'obor le Nkai;

English: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
Masaai: Etasapuka olkiyioi too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa eiting'o enaisho oo sabibu; neishieki eng'ida pooki; neishieki enchipai pooki e nkop.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itarruoitie aalang iloreren oomanita intae neitu ipuopuo too nkiguanat aainei, anaa imbung'ubung'u nkikoot aainei, niasiasa enaas nkitanapat ooloreren oomanita intae;

English: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
Masaai: Intokitin are aaikilikuan iyie mikimitiki ake ninche nanu eton eitu aye:

English: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
Masaai: Etipika apa Olaitoriani enkuretisho nena kitoriat pooki oo nkuapi naamanita Yuda, neitu ninche eitayunye Yehoshefat olarrabal.

English: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
Masaai: Neijulujula ninche, nesulunye te nebo, meidim ninche aataretu ilo ola, kake ore ninye nkorroki enye kepuo eyararoto.

English: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
Masaai: naa ore pee eaku italaari aaishoru ate katukul, nikiterretenate pee kintame enkiaas pooki e ilo lemening'isho.

English: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
Masaai: Ekesipa ena shakenisho. Metaa isikong'a ninche te mpijan pee etum aataa supati te nkirukoto

English: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
Masaai: “Aimetii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo intae? Naa keitu ninye eisho intae eseriani te pooki shoto? Amu eyaua ninye lelo oomanya ena kop apik atua nkaik aainei; naa keaku enkop abori Olaitoriani etii o ltung'ana lenyena.

English: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia ajoki Isaya, “Ore ilo rorei lo Laitoriani liroro iyie naa eisidai.” Amu etejo apa ninye, “Kelo atii eseriani too nkolong'i aainei.”

English: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
Masaai: Kake ti nitumomo te nebo, neme Endaa o Laitoriani ina nipuonunu aanya.

English: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
Masaai: Neitobir apa Solomon pee eshet enkaji e Nkai tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, neitobiraki kewan enkaji e nkitoo.

English: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
Masaai: Ng'ura, itoning'o enaitaasa ilaiguanak le Asiria nkuapi pooki, neinyal ninche aaidaikie katukul. Eikipuoi doi aakordu iyie?

English: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
Masaai: Ore emukate naishoru Enkai naa ina nadou aing'uaa shumata neisho enkop enkishui.”

English: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Netii ake erubata nabo ilng'amat oare pee etumi aairuburubie te nebo; ninko neijia too rubat pooki

English: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
Masaai: Kake eitu ear iltung'ana le Israel ninche metuata, amu ore apa ilkituaak lo lturrur neinosa olmumai to Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel. Neing'unyung'uny olturrur pooki te nkaraki lelo arikok.

English: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eilep olng'ejep le nkima alo shumata epuku te ilo asar, neilep ilo malaika te ilo ng'ejep le nkima lo lasar eing'orita Manoa o enkitok enye; nebatata aaitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop.

English: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
Masaai: Nchoo enkisisa kitok e Nkai ejing iltoiloishi lenye, nejing ilalema oopi nkaloli pokira nkaik enye,

English: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

Masaai: Kemurati intae isuaten oo seseni linyi, naa keaku ina olmonekie lo sotua te rishata ai o ntae.

English: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaatonyorra Papa, atonyorra sii nanu intae. Entotoni ti atua enyorrata ai.

English: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: enjung'ore to sinka lenye Israel, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
Masaai: Nenyorraa ina umata pooki aas ina, amu eisidai apa ina bae too nkonyek o lorere.

English: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
Masaai: Etiu ninye te nanu anaa olng'arurumi orreshisho, etiu anaa olng'atuny oisudori airrag.

English: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
Masaai: Neitarasaa olapolosani ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitayu olasar lenye le ngoki o lasar lenye opejori.

English: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
Masaai: Nanu, ee, nanu oiroro naipotu ninye, ayaua nanu ninye naa kelo ninye adupoyu te nkoitoi enye.

English: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
Masaai: Naaitoki obo le lelo payiani airorie nanu ajoki, “Kakua kulo, ooishop ilkilani ooibor, naa kaji eing'uaa ninche?”

English: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
Masaai: Neishir olmarei le nkaji e Lawi makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate; neishir olmarei le Shemeit makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate;

English: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyie Enkai oo lororani, toning'o enkomono ai; irrugu enkiok, iyie Enkai e Yakobo!

English: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomenisho naa kemanaa ninye, kake ore iloobor neisho omom.

English: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
Masaai: Nanu Paulo oigero ena kirorokino te nkaina ai makewan. Ele olilmonekie le mpalai ai pooki, neijia oshiaake aiko te naiger.

English: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
Masaai: nemeetayie tipat shakenisho te tung'ani amu keyiolo openy naatii atua tung'ani.

English: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena neye olaiguanani loo Lamoni neitoreisho Hanan olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
Masaai: Ore amu katala enaikonakino pee atum atujurro kuna baa, naikilikuan ninye tenaa keyieu nelo Yerusalem paa te ine epuoi aaiguanare te nena.

English: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
Masaai: Nejoki sii olorere, “Te nidolulu oshi enkatampoi eilepa te nkalo e ndoyioroto, nijojo nabo kata, ‘Kelotu asha’; netiu neijia.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, tialo lelo shekuti ooing'or iltung'ana laainei: “Indapasha intae eluaata ai, nitaaraitie ninche meshomo, neitu intae ing'oring'oro ninche. Ng'ura, kaitame nanu intae te nkaraki nkiaasin inyi torrok, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
Masaai: Tiaaki Ilamoni: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itejo ‘Aha!’ te nkaraki ewueji ai sinyati ina kata peyie eisarkionieki ninye, o te nkaraki ina kop e Israel ina kata peyie eitaa ninye mitil, o te nkaraki ina aji e Yuda ina kata peyie elo eyararoto;

English: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam oong'uan olapa le dukuya aitashe nanu te ngilata e ilo keju kitok, aa taa, Tigris,

English: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
Masaai: Neisho ninye ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani meitamani enkanasa, neman ninye nabo kata; nepuonu ninche ilng'oborri lenye, neirrag ninche ina kewarie ilng'oborri.

English: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
Masaai: Neipot Abraham enkarna enkayioni enye natoikio ninye Sara ajo Isaak.

English: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina aiturubare nanu iroruat aainei nkiguanat inono pooki; aiba nanu pooki oitoi torrono.

English: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
Masaai: Nelo Rehoboam Shekem, eshomo apa Isiraeli pooki Shekem aaitaa ninye olaiguanani.

English: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
Masaai: Amaa pee abel imukateni imiet abelaki ltung'ana nkalifuni imiet, kaja nkikapuni oo lmong'oishi oobore litasotutuo?” Nejoki, “Tomon o aare.”

English: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
Masaai: Ore Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neitobiraki kewan imowuarak e sekenkei, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Te kuna ilo iyie arrumoo ile Siria o metaba anaa neidak ninche.’ ”

English: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
Masaai: Naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.

English: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
Masaai: Naa kiti ninye alang ilanterera pooki, kake ore pee ebulu neaku sapuk alang inkaitubulu o metaa olchani, o meetu intaritik aapik isinkin ilng'osil lenyena.”

English: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina nedol enang'ole siamo naitashe te lido kekun le naiposha nchere, metii ai peut ine nabo ake, neitu eiriamariyie Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena ajing atua empeut amu eshomo ilooiteng'eni lenyena oopeny.

English: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
Masaai: Ore te nkumoi oo ing'ok inyi, teina nemetii esipata biashara inyi nisarkionie iwuejitin inono sinyat, neaku ayaua atua iyie enkima aitung'uaa erishata ino; nikinya ninye iyie amut, naaibelekeny iyie aitaa nkuruon tioriong enkop, te dukuya lelo pooki likitoduaa iyie.

English: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata Eli, eidipa nkonyek aailiilai, metaa meekure edolisho, neirura apa ninye te wueji enye makewan;

English: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
Masaai: Ajoki intae, ore ebaiki taata, maitoki ae kata aok enaisho oo lng'anayio loo sabibu o metabau enkolong naok eokoto ng'ejuk te nebo intae te Nkitoria e Papa.”

English: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
Masaai: Amu ore too rorei oobayie le Daudi, naa ena esiana oo Lawi ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
Masaai: neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaitorioo enkaina ai agilunore Ilfilisti, naa kadung'oo ile Kereti, namut iloomanaa le naiposha.

English: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo ninye, “Enkenisho eng'urai kaing'ae oshomo ti atua iyiook.” Ore ake pee eidip aaikenisho, ng'ura, metii Yonatan o lanapani lenye loo masaa olarrabal ine.

English: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
Masaai: Keitu nanu aaitanap iyie? Tonyuaa nintagoluo; miureishoyu, niming'aeng'ae, amu etii Olaitoriani Enkai ino te nebo iyie te pooki wueji nilo.”

English: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
Masaai: Misim olaisinani eji amu kaaisinani, arashu irony oloota osina te kishomi;

English: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
Masaai: Kake ore ilayiok le Musa ilo tung'ani le Nkai, neishooki nkarn oo ltung'ana le Lawi.

English: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
Masaai: Inyor iyie irorei oomutisho, iyie o lolng'ejep olejisho

English: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
Masaai: Kake aikoo nanu ninche najoki ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee irragirraga tioriong e suntai? Teningiligili aaiko neijia, naibung nanu intae.” Ore ebaiki ina olong neito idia alo eitu ninche eigil aapuonu te nkolong e Sabato.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani; ore te nena olong'i, keibung iltung'ana tomon ooing'uaa iloreren le pooki ng'ejep olkila lo Lyahudi, ejoki, ‘Maape tenebo aairiamari, amu kitoning'o aajo etii Enkai tenebo iyie.’ ”

English: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
Masaai: Naa supati ninche pokira are ti alo Enkai, nesuj inkitanapat o nkitoriat pooki o Laitoriani, meitong'or.

English: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
Masaai: Ore enabayie tena bae, nena pooki nitoning'o. Turia Enkai, nimbung inkitanapat enyena, amu ena elulung'ata e siaai pooki e tung'ani.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake eirorie Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, neisho ninche enkitanapata nayaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli o Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, pee eriku iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.
Masaai: Amu etaa apa iloo papa ilemeisiligayu, netaasa ninche entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai ang; etung'uitie ninche ninye, neibelekenyate aapaash emanyisho o Laitoriani, neisho ninche ninye oriong.

English: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Meidim ilo oten ailanyisho, nemeidim olmurrani aimisho te moikuape te mbata olkeju le Farite etarrorrote ninche nebatata.

English: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore te siadi nashuku nanu lelo tung'ana loo Lamoni apa ootarayioki, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilapolosak o Lawi apa ooetuo tenebo Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, o Yeshua: o Seraia o Yeremia o Esra,

English: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani ntarasi! Esai, Esai.

English: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Ahab Elija, “Ekinepua nanu lo mang'atinta lai?” Newaliki ajoki, “Ee aainepua, amu itegelaka iyie kewan pee ias mbaa torrok te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
Masaai: Keitiship Olaitoriani ilmeregeshi enkalifu nabo, o lkejek enkalifu nabo le ilata? Kaishooyo nanu olkikau lai te nkaraki nkitarruorrot aainei, ilo ng'anayioi lo sesen lai te nkaraki eng'oki o ltau lai?”

English: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
Masaai: Tenaa aing'eni apa ninche, anaata etayioloito ena, anaata etumusutuo enkiting'oto enye!

English: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
Masaai: Amu eing'or ninye enkomom enye, ore pee elo, nerikino nabo kata enaikununo.

English: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
Masaai: Amu etoponari nkitarruorot ang te dukuya iyie, ore ing'ok ang neishakenoki iyiook; ore nena kitarruorot ang netii te nebo iyiook, nikiyiolo iyiook ntorrok ang:

English: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
Masaai: Tubukoki engoro ino napi shumata lelo oreren limikiyiolo ninche, o shumata lelo tung'ana lemeipot enkarna ino; amu einosa ninche Yakobo; einosa ninche ninye nemut ninye, neitomijoono ninche emanyisho enye.

English: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
Masaai: Ore lelo ooituruk o loosujita nebuaku aajo, “Hosana! Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani!

English: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
Masaai: “Ore to lpolosie lo loontoluo nchoo eaku Enaiposha Kitok o lo manaa lenye; ele ninye eaku olpolosie lino lo loontoluo.

English: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
Masaai: ninche oojo, ‘Eton eitu enyiku enkata nikishetie nkajijik; ore ena anasa naa emoti nayierishoreki ake nikira iyiook nkiri.’

English: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
Masaai: Ore ilomon lelo torrok oleng loo loreren, naa kedung ninye aauroo neing'uaa. Edoiki inchumat oo ldoinyo o nong'ot pooki ilng'osil lenyena, ore lelo ng'osil lenyena sapuki neirrag too wuejitin pooki neeim inchorroi eina kop; ore iloreren pooki le nkop nepuo aaing'uaa oloip lenye aaing'uaa ninye.

English: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
Masaai: Ore te Ebatana, teina anasa kitok natii olkerenket le Media, netumi teine olpiyayati oigerore ena: “Embae nadamuni.

English: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Amu enkitanapata ina te Israel, elimunoto e Nkai e Yakobo.

English: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
Masaai: nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye te ngolon, nepolos ninye ilo ng'atuny anaa oltung'ani opolos olkuoo le kine; nemeeta apa ninye toki te nkaina enye. Kake eitu apa ninye eliki menye aashu ng'otonye enataasa ninye.

English: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Atasayia intae ilalashera laainei emiaas entorroni naba inji.

English: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
Masaai: Nedoyio ninye alo airorie ina kitok; neitiship ina kitok Samson oleng.

English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o enyorrata e Enkai o enchula e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, te nebo intae pooki.

English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
Masaai: Etaasa apa iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa; neor ninche enkop.

English: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
Masaai: Naa aikipuonu aarare iyie eing'uaa enkalo e moikuape too ngarrin oo imbartan, o ngarrin o lorora kitok lo lorere; keiturrurro ninche peyie kiarare too nkaloli pooki eeta ilong'oi kutiti o sapuki, o nkopiyiani o larrabal, naa kapik enkiguana atua ninche, naa keiguanare intae anaa enatiu enkiguana enye.

English: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni oo kuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Omori aitore Israel, neitoreisho ilarin tomon oare. Too larin ile eitoria Tirsa.

English: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
Masaai: neaku keyiolo Olaitoriani enaiko te nekordu too ntemat lelo ooure ninye, o enaiko pee eibooki enkitamioto lelo ooas intorrok o metabau ina olong e nkiguana

English: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata eilo sarge lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, nepik olapolosani enchumata enkitipet e nkiok e tatene eilo oitukui, o enchumata olmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene, o le nkeju enye e tatene.

English: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
Masaai: Kake eng'ura amu etii ilo laaitarasaa ena mesa te nebo nanu.

English: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
Masaai: Ore ilo oisunkur te nkiba neiro to yieta irorei, kake eisudoo aibok elejare to ltau lenye;

English: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
Masaai: Ororei osipa ele nchere: Te nikituata te nebo ninye, naa eikiyooki sii aaishu te nebo ninye.

English: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
Masaai: Nepuo ninche, aatoni te Geruut Chimham te mbata e Betlehem, ejo pee epuo Misiri,

English: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
Masaai: Aisisaki intae ajoki entonyorrai erikore oo ltung'ana leeijo lelo, o ene pooki ng'ae oisiaaisho te nebo intae, o sinka.

English: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani kitok ninye, “Lo Kitok, tadou eton eitu ee enkerai ai.”

English: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
Masaai: neng'as aar isinkan ooboitare, nedaa neokisho te nebo lamerak;

English: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
Masaai: Ore pee eilepaki, empeut, negira osiwuo.

English: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
Masaai: olayioni le Yakobo, olayioni le Isaak, olayioni le Abraham, olayioni le Tera, olayioni le Nahor, olayioni le Serug,

English: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
Masaai: iranyakinono to lkerempe le Nkai o sinkolioitin o rrepeta e nkiyang'et, iranyishosho aaisis Olaitoriani too ltauja linyi pooki;

English: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
Masaai: Indim iyie aisiliga ninye te nkaraki naa sapuk engolon enye, naa aing'ueiki iyie ninye esiaai ino?

English: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
Masaai: nejoki, “Eng'as oshi ake pooki ng'ae aishoru enaisho oo sabibu sidai ore etookishoteki, neishoru eneme sidai oleng; imboo iyie idia sidai o taata.”

English: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook omon te dukuya iyie, nikira lapuayak anaa apa enatiu loo papa pooki; etiu nkolong'i ang te nkop anaa oloip, nemeetae enebikieki.

English: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.
Masaai: Ore apa pee eya Saul enkiguana te Israel, nearare ninye ilmang'ati lenyena pooki te pooki shoto, etaarare Moab, o Ilamoni, o Idom o laiguanak le Soba o Lfilisti; naa ore ake eneibelekenyakine neisulu ninye.

English: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
Masaai: Naa ore te nyorrata ino nauno iwuang'ie ilmang'ati laainei, nindaikie ilmang'ati laainei pooki, amu ara nanu osinka lino.

English: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche. “Aitoduaa intae isiaaitin kumok naaing'uaa Papa lai. Kaa nabo te kuna siaaitin kinang'ieng'ie nanu too soito?”

English: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
