English: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
Masaai: Ore pee edumunye ninye alo teine, nenang'are Yehonadab olayioni le Rekab elotu anang'are ninye; neiroroki ninye, nejoki, “Ketiu oltau lino te nanu anaa enatiu olalai te iyie?” Nejo Yehonadab, “Ee” Nejoki Yehu, “Tenaa neijia nchooki enkaina ino.” Neisho ninye Yehu enkaina. Neyiataa Yehu ninye apik engarri oo mbartan.

English: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
Masaai: Nebol Enkai inkonyek e Haga nedol enchorro enkare, nelo aiput ilo bene lenye lo lchoni enkare neisho ina ayioni metooko.

English: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
Masaai: Asaria apa menye le Amaria, naa Amaria menye le Ahitub

English: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
Masaai: Neiteru kulikae aanotaki, neimulumul enkomom, nedam, nejoki, “Imbonisho!” Neitanang'are ilarripok ninye ioshot.

English: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
Masaai: Ore ina sahabu pooki oo nkishorot naishoo ninche Olaitoriani, eing'uaa lelo arikok le lelo oora nkalifuni le njore, o lelo le maa iip naa shekeli nkalifuni tomon o ile o iip naapishana o onom.

English: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
Masaai: Naa ina pee eitu apa eitabari olapa sotua musana metii osarge.

English: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
Masaai: “Mbung'a osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki. Too nkolong'i naapishana inosa mukateni neitu eisuijieki, anaa enaaitanapa, te ina kata nategeluaki to lapa le Abibu; amu teilo apa apa iewuo aipang'u aing'uaa Misiri.

English: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
Masaai: Esipa aajoki, mipuku te ine katukul o metaba anaa nilak empisai nabayie.

English: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
Masaai: Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, inkituaak are naapuonu dukuya! Etii osiwuo inaipuko enye; neeta inaipuko naatiu anaa inaipuko emotonyi nanyaanyukie entilagos, nedumu aailepie ina kikapu metaa etii erishata enkop o keper.

English: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
Masaai: Kake ore lelo oonyor ate lemeiruk ina sipata, laa ntorrok esuj nening ninche, netum lelo engoro o erasakinoto.

English: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
Masaai: “Etii sii Asiria ine, tenebo olorora lenye pooki, nemanita ninye inkuraren enye, lelo pooki ootaraki, ootumutaki to lalem;

English: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
Masaai: Neas Daudi anaa enaitanapa Enkai, near ninche enjore oo Lfilisti ebaiki Gibeon ometabaiki Geser.

English: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
Masaai: Keyooki aapuonu nkolong'i, naayae oloyamishe aaitung'uaa ninche, neitupukoo taa ate ina olong.

English: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
Masaai: Neiguana maate ejo, “Mukateni mikiaata.”

English: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:
Masaai: Neisho ninche lelo aisiaayiak apa ooitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani. Ore lelo aisiaayiak apa oasisho tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani; neishooyo te nkaraki eramata o enkitobirata eina aji.

English: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
Masaai: Naa tenerem ninye tenkaraki enkiba, anaa eipony ninye, aashu etarresho ninye, neaku etua,

English: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
Masaai: e Negeb o enkisiajata, aa taa ilo erata le Yeriko ina anasa oo ltuka ometabaiki Soar.

English: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ishmael naa kuna inkarn enye, too nkangitie enye o too lngoborri lenye. Ilkituaak tomon o are anaa iloshon lenye.

English: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
Masaai: Ninye oitanapa iyiook matolikioi too ltung'ana pooki, nikinchakenoki nchere ninye osiruno te Enkai metaa oloiguanaki ilooishu o lootuata.

English: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruninghooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
Masaai: Amu ore eng'or enkisampuare, eidipa enkurma aitapuka, neibelekenya ntapuka aaku ilng'anayio, nedung'oo ninye lelo ng'osil to lalem odung'ishoreki, ore lelo ng'osil oo luaari nedung'oo.

English: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
Masaai: Kake miyiololo doi intae ninye, nayiolo nanu ninye; naa te najo nanu mayiolo ninye, naaku olalejani anaa intae; kake kayiolo doi ninye nasuj ororei lenye.

English: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore nabo e nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, neisho lelo malaika oopishana ngirran naapishana e sahabu naabore engoro e Enkai, naishu ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e nkiterata e nkata oo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki, enkolong apa nayieng'i ilkuoo, oodamunyeki Pasaka, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena ninye, “Kaji iyieu nikipuo aaitobir pee inyayie Pasaka?”

English: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
Masaai: Nedumunye Daudi te ine neisik alo enkapune e Adulam; ore ake pee ening ilalashera lenyena o enkaji e papaai lenye pooki, nedoyio aapuo enetii ninye.

English: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
Masaai: Kaitaba eishoi ino anaa enterit enkop; metaa te neidimayu meikena oltung'ani enterit enkop, neidimayu sii meikeni eishoi ino.

English: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the daytime. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
Masaai: Netum osina torrono te nkaraki iyasat enye torrok, nedol ninche anaa olkar te nemera dama, intibil ninche o ntiyot, edaa te nkilepilep, epeipeeno enyaita osirua te nebo intae.

English: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
Masaai: Ore olikiomon, inchoo; ore olikisilen, mimitiki.

English: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
Masaai: “Anaa enakurru olapurroni teneibung'i, neijia etiu sii enkaji e Israel keitukurruni: ninche, o laiguanak lenye, o lkituaak lenye o lapolosak lenye, o loibonok lenye.

English: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
Masaai: (Ore apa te dukuya naa pesho ninye te iyie, kake ore taata netaa ole tipat oleng, te iyie o te nanu.)

English: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Airoroki intae lelo pooki oonyor Enkai ti atua Roma, ooipotoki entaa sinyat. Meeu empiris o eseriani atua intae eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
Masaai: Salma menye le Betlehem o Heref menye le Betgader.

English: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
Masaai: Naa ti niyau enkishoroto ino olperere lo lasar, nidamu te ine olalashe lino likiaatakinore,

English: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
Masaai: “Etua apa papa lang tiong'ota; metii apa ninye ina umata, e lelo ooiturrurrote aapaashare Olaitoriani te ncholuek e Kora, kake etua te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan; nemeeta apa layiok.

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Efraim nkalifuni artam o iip imiet.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Imayiana Simon ara Yona, amu eitu kiboloki ena entoki naata osesen o sarge, kake Papa lai otii shumata.

English: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani le Asiria Tatan le Rabsari, o Rabshake eeta enjore kitok, naing'uaa Lakish pee erasaki Hesekia te Yerusalem. Ore ake pee ebau nepuonu aaitashe tembata olchorro le shumata, otii enkoitoi oo laitobirak loo nkilani.

English: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
Masaai: Amu ejo lkigerot, “Mien olkiteng enkutuk eidong'ito enkurma,” nejo sii, “Eishiaakino olaisiaayiani olekoisiaayio lenye.”

English: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Nahor abik ilarin iip o tomon o ooudo eidipaki aatoiu Terah, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?
Masaai: Netonita apa Elisha te nkaji enye, netonita ilpayiani tenebo ninye. Neirriwayie apa olaiguanani oltung'ani, kake ore eton eitu ebaiki ilo kilikuai Elisha, nejoki Elisha lelo payiani, “Idolidolo aajo eirriwua ele oitayu iloikop oltung'ani laalotu adung'oo endukuya? Eng'orisho ore ake pee elotu ilo kilikuai ninkenikene kutukaji, nimbung'ubung'u enkikenet e kutukaji aaibooyo ninye. Aimening'o oltoilo loo nkejuk olkitok lenye te siadi ninye?”

English: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
Masaai: Kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ai te nkitisipata; naa eyiolou iyie Olaitoriani.

English: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
Masaai: Ore pee edol Petero ina, nejoki ninche, “Lo lewa lang le Israel, ainyoo naing'asiayie intae te ne, naa kaji etiu paa iyiook ing'oring'oro? Ijojo pasa ai te nkaraki ongolon ang maate arashu te nkaraki esupatisho ang pee eishiunyeki ele tung'ani meinyo alo?

English: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
Masaai: ore Yoiarib naa Matenai; ore te Yedaia naa Usi,

English: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Nchiraki akenya Saul o anu, idolita ajo atanya nanu ninye pee meaku olaiguanani te Israel? Imputa ina mouo eilata nilo; kaairriwaa nanu iyie enetii Yese, ilo Betlehemi, amu aing'uraka nanu kewan ai olaiguanani ti atua ilayiok lenyena.”

English: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
Masaai: Tiaaki naa iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Ara nanu Olaitoriani, naa kayau nanu ntae aitung'uaa esinkaisho enye, naa kalaku nanu ntae te nkaina naitoriori o too nkiasin sapuki e nkiguana.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkitok tenebo entito enye, nimiya entito o layioni lenye aashu entito e ntioto enye aitalioo emasipaisho enye; nkanashera inono ninche, entorroni ina.

English: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
Masaai: Miata iyie ematua aashu erubata te na bae. Amu meisiriri oltau lino ti alo Enkai.

English: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
Masaai: Nebau enkolong oo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki, ina olong nayieng'i olkuoo lo sirua le Pasaka.

English: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
Masaai: Nepuo te ine o metabaiki Beeri, aa taa, olchorro apa laa ninye etiakinye Olaitoriani Musa, “Nturrurro iltung'ana te nebo, pee aisho nanu enkare.”

English: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki intae, ‘Itabautua intae enkop oo ldoinyo e Amori, apa naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
Masaai: ilo oishorua kewan te nkaraki ng'ok ang pee esaru iyiook te na towuo arruoni te risioroto eyieunuto e Enkai ang naa Papa;

English: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.
Masaai: Ore naa kaitayu enkitanapata: Ore pooki orere, o pooki kop, o pooki ng'ejep oiro inaapaashare Enkai e Shadrak o Meshek o Abednego nedung'i aaitaa ndung'udung'ot, ore nkajijik enye neidaikieki; amu meetae ae Ai naidim atokordu tena pukunoto.”

English: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
Masaai: “Ore te iyie, iyie naaji e Israel, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Shomo pooki ng'ae isiayia inkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot inono nemeishu, tenakata o te siadi ena, tinimikining'ining'i nanu; kake ore enkarna ai sinyati mintokiki aikata aaisarkionie too nkishorot inyi oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu.

English: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Ahas adumu enkosholai o sahabu pooki natii enkaji o Laitoriani o atua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani, neirriwaa anaa enkishooroto aisho olaiguanani le Asiria.

English: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
Masaai: Naa keinyang'u apa ninche engarri oo mbartan naing'uaa Misiri te shekeli iip ile e nkosholai, neinyang'u embarta te shekeli iip nabo o onom. Neikunaki sii apa neijia aamiraki ilaiguanak pooki le Hiti o laiguanak le Siria.

English: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Amaa, eikishetaki iyie enkaji nabikie atua?

English: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
Masaai: neaku ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie; naarare inchorroi inono, naa kaitaa enkop e Misiri enkop mitil nemetii toki, eiteru te Migdol ometabaiki Siene, o meshomo abaiki olpolosie le Etiopia.

English: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
Masaai: o Basemat entito e Ishmael enkanashe e Nebaiot.

English: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninche enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, neisiaai Asherim o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin. Nelotu engoro napi shumata Yuda o Yerusalem tenkaraki ena kitarruoroto enye.

English: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
Masaai: amu ore lelo ootamayiana Olaitoriani naa kejung enkop, ore lelo ootediaa ninye naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
Masaai: “Maibung'ata iyiook pokira anaa apa enatiu papaai o papaai lino: ng'ura aairriwaka nanu iyie enkishoroto e nkosholai o sahabu. Shomo ntobira osotua lino o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli, pee aatum atung'uai nanu.”

English: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
Masaai: Kaing'ae apa ilo liurere, neaku itelejishe, neitu kidamu nanu, eitu ninye kipik ndamunot? Keitu nanu ang'iri ena kata pooki, neitu ake kiureyu nanu?

English: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
Masaai: amu eshomo ilooiteng'eni lenyena aainyiang'u endaa te ina anasa.

English: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
Masaai: Etaa nanu ederrie lelo ootoni te kishomi, netaa nanu eokore ilamerak.

English: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
Masaai: amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa Enkai olng'ur; meitiak ninye intae neidaikie intae nemerikino ninye ilo ning'o lo sotua loo loo papaai linyi apa oinosie olmumai tialo ninche ntarasi.

English: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
Masaai: neyau ina lukunya te mbesen, neisho ina tito; neisho entito ng'otonye.

English: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
Masaai: Ore Nebukadnesa, olaiguanani le Babilon nelotu ina anasa ina kata etang'adutua isinkan lenyena;

English: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
Masaai: Koree naa lelo ang'eni linono? Nchoo ninche mikitoliki neisho metayiolouni, ina naiguanua Olaitoriani loo lororani pee egilunore Misiri.

English: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
Masaai: embelekenyunye enteru elototo inyi, nipuopuo ina kop oo ldoinyo e Amori, ole latia enye pooki te Araba, teina kop oo ldoinyo o te nkop nashong'ishong, o Negeb, o lomanaa le naiposha, ina kop oo Lkanaan, o Lebanon o metabaiki ilo keju kitok, ilo keju le Frati.

English: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
Masaai: Kalo te intae olo aning ena, nelo ajing ine ainining'isho te nkaraki ina kata nayooki alotu.

English: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
Masaai: Kincho oshiaake Enkai enashe te nkaraki intae ilalashera oonyorri to Laitoriani, amu etegelua apa intae Enkai ebaiki enkiterunoto pee eitajeuni te nkoitoi e nkitisinyata te Nkiyang'et o te nkirukoto ti atua esipata.

English: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
Masaai: Kayieu taata nalotu enitii te nkata e uni, nemaaku olola, amu mme doi masaa inyi ayieu kake intae ate. Mme nkera oshi naashumaki ntoiwuo kake ntoiwuo naashumaki nkera.

English: Give us this day our daily bread.
Masaai: Inchoo iyiook ena olong endaa ang e anaake.

English: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
Masaai: Neisarrisar Abraham alo atua olng'obor enetii Sara, nejoki ninye, “Isiosionie imboreitin uni e ntapa napuyiapuy nimpurj aitobir imukateni.”

English: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
Masaai: ninchooyoyo olasar opejori, ilo asar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, iloing'ok tomon o okuni, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo; naa lelo lemeeta ntiot;

English: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
Masaai: Niomon iyie ninye naa aikining ninye iyie; nilak iyie ilmuma linono.

Masaai: Nejoki lelo kituaak o ltung'ana pooki lelo apolosak o loibonok, “Meishiaakino ele tung'ani endung'okinoto e nkiguana e keeya, amu eirorie ninye iyiook te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
Masaai: Torrinyu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani! Nchoo enkomom ino metawang'a, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!

English: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana ninye, “Enkishui ang te rishata e nkishui inyi, te neaku eitu ilikio kuna baa ang, nikitum taa aaitaasa iyie te supatisho o te nkisiligata te neisho iyiook Olaitoriani ena kop.”

English: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
Masaai: lelo apa laiteng'ela nanu te nkaraki enkata enyamali, te nkolong olarrabal o enjore?

English: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
Masaai: Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye nengoroo embae, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata enkila enye esekenkei, to lgoo; ore enkaraki ina nejoki ninye olarewani lenye le ngarri e mbarta, “Mbelekenyayu ntung'uayioki nanu olarrabal, amu aatipikaki nanu olbae.”

English: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
Masaai: Neyau ilo aisiaayiani intokitin naagol enkinyiang'a o enkosholai o sahabu o nkilani neisho ninche Rebeka. Eishoo sii ninye olalashe lenye tenebo ng'otonye intokitin naagol enkinyang'a.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: ore to lasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o sitiman le kineji imiet, o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai.

English: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too lmang'ati laainei! Iyie nanu akuetikia asaru!

English: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ruben ilo kikau le Israel naa: Hanok, o Palu, o Hesron, o Karmi.

English: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
Masaai: Tushumu nkonyek inono toduaa shumata; kaing'ae oitobirua kuna pooki? Ilo oyau ilo orora lenye te nkumoi, neipotu ninche pooki too nkarn enye, te ina kitoo e nkidimata enye, naa ore enkaraki nagol ninye oleng meimin ninye nabo.

English: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: Kake tenemeituku ninye ilkilani lenyena anaa eituku ososen lenye nenap ninye entorroni enye.”

English: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
Masaai: Entobirakinoto pee iararere Babilon aaman aamuat te pooki shoto, intae pooki ooriu enkawuo, entang'or ninye, mileku mbaa, amu etaasa ninye eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani.

English: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
Masaai: Anoto apa nanu enkidetidet naaituria; ore airragita te ndapash naaitanyamal ndamunot o nduaat e ndukuya ai.

English: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
Masaai: Kaing'ae oidim aitaasa intae entorrono, te naa airara intae ilanyuaak le nena sidain?

English: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo netii ilarripok oong'uan enkoitoi kitok netii oare ine wueji neitobiraki aakus.

English: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye papaai lenye, “Oi endukuya ai, endukuya ai!” Nejoki papaai lenye osinka lenye, “Ewaita ninye enetii ng'otonye.”

English: Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.
Masaai: Indipa naa doi aaiputakinoto? Metaa ndipakinote? Itaa intae karsisi! Nitaa intae ilaiguanak mikitii iyiook! Wooi te naa ndipa aataa laitoriak, pee kitum sii iyiook aataa laitoriak te nebo intae.

English: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
Masaai: Ore ake sii aishoo ninche isabatoni aainei, anaa olmonekie te rishata ai o ninche, peyie etum aatayiolo aajo nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.

English: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
Masaai: “Nanu ilo laa ore te ngolon ai sapuk o te nkaina ai naitoriori oitayio enkop, tenebo iltung'ana o ng'uesi naatii oriong enkop naa kaisho nanu ilo pooki ladol eishiaakino te nanu.

English: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Etii iloshon aare atua enkoshoke ino, naa ore lelo tung'ana pookira liiu, naa ekeori; ekegolu obo aalang olikae, ore olbotor naa keisiaai oloti.”

English: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
Masaai: Ore te lelo kulikae pooki najo nanu, neme Olaitoriani te neeta olalashe enkitok neitu eiruk, netonyorrayie metotona ninche te nebo, nemeitoki ilo aituraa ina;

English: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
Masaai: Amu ore te nkiti rishata naa keish engoro ai, neibelekenyakino engoro ai enkidaata enye.

English: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
Masaai: Eewa ninye eyararoto meshomo Babilon lelo apa ooilanya olalem, neaku isinkan lenyena, o metaba anaa neitasheyieki enkitoria e Parsia.

English: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Lawi naa: Gershon, o Kohat, o Merari.

English: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
Masaai: Amu etii ina nyorrata ino nauno dukuya nkonyek aainei, nalotu nanu te sipata enitii.

English: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
Masaai: Tayiolo ntisipa pee minos osarge, amu ore osarge naa enkishui, niminos iyie enkishui tenebo nkiri.

English: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
Masaai: Tawaliki ninche, tiaki, “Entoning ina naiteng'en intae Olaitoriani! Emining ilaitumusumusok - ore enajoki ninche intae nemeret intae.”

English: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
Masaai: “Ore akenya teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, naa keing'uaa empijan olaiguanani o lkituaak; neiputukuny ilapolosak neing'asia iloibonok.”

English: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
Masaai: Ore egiroo Yesu aing'uaa ine nesuj iltung'ana aare modook ooishiraki aajoki, “Ing'urrie iyiook enkerai e Daudi.”

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani tialo ng'apeta, o lmoti le nkare, o nkitasheyieta o kulie masaa pooki naatung'uayioki tiatua ena anasa,

English: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
Masaai: Neiko neijia ole aare o le okuni o metabaiki ole oopishana.

English: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
Masaai: Enyeito, emaape; idol etabaua ilo laakaldaa.”

English: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
Masaai: Etiopia apa engolon enye o Misiri, nemeeta engolon enye enkiting'oto; Ilaretok lenyena apa ile Libia.

English: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
Masaai: meisudoro enkidikidikoto o sesen lai te iyie, ina kata pee aaitobiruni nanu te nkisudoroto, ina kata aaitubuluni nanu te nguton e nkop.

English: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nena, lo alashera sinyat, oong'ar enkipototo e shumata, entadamu Yesu, olkipaaret naa olapolosani kitok le na limunoto ang.

English: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
Masaai: Ore pee etum, esipa ajoki intae, eshipakino oleng ina alang nena ntomoni naaudo o naaudo neitu eimin.

English: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
Masaai: Nesuj Simon Petero o ilo likae oiteng'eni Yesu. Neyiolo ilo likae oiteng'eni Olapolosani Kitok, nejing ninye o Yesu atua olgoriet lo Lapolosani Kitok.

English: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
Masaai: Kake ore pee eliki ninche irorei pooki le Yosef, lelo apa ootiaka ninye ninche, ore ake sii pee edol ingarrin naaetuo pee enap ninye neitoki oltau le Yakobo papaai lenye apok;

English: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Yoshua ololepilepi loo ltung'ana ebuakita, nejoki ninye Musa, “Etii ololepilepi lo larrabal atua enkang oo lng'oborri.”

English: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.
Masaai: Te neye kulo tung'ana enkeeya e oshiake oo ltung'ana pooki aashu te neinepu entaboi oo ltung'ana pooki, neaku naa eitu aairriu Olaitoriani.

English: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
Masaai: Amu ebore enkop iloololoito; ore te nkaraki oldeket neishir enkop, ore nkujit naanyori e ong'ata neitoi. Ore olkuaak lenye naa entorroni, ore engolon enye neme sidai.

English: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
Masaai: Etoyio olchani loo sabibu, netoyio olng'aboli, ore kukumanka, o ltukai, o lchani loo lng'anayio, netoito pooki. Neiting'o enchipai too nkera e tung'ana.

English: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Naa ketiu ninye anaa te neisampisho olaisampuani, negilu ilng'osil le nkurma, netiu anaa ina kurma naitashe te nesuli ilng'osil lenyena netiu anaa oerata le Refaim.

English: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu iyie, ira Petero naa te nchumata ena soit ashet enkanisa ai; nemegilu ae kata ltimito le nemeneng'a.

English: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
Masaai: Neilep iltung'ana le Israel aapuo olarrabal aarare Benchamen; neitoluakino iltung'ana le Israel ninche te Gibea.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too nkatinin e Yehu olayioni le Hanani, apa naatisiraki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
Masaai: Ore lelo aranyak o looiguran, nejo, “Ore nchorroi aainei pooki naa atua iyie etii.”

English: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
Masaai: “Meetae olayioni le Israel olo aiborrie onyek tiatua enkaji Enkai, nemeetae entito e Israel nalo aiborrie onyek tiatua enkaji Enkai.

English: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:
Masaai: Neyupuyup oleng engoro e Daudi te nkaraki ilo tung'ani; nejoki ninye Natan, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani otaasa ena eishiaakino neye;

English: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Masaai: Enkolong ena naitobira Olaitoriani; matishipakinoto niking'ida te ninye.

English: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
Masaai: Netii ltung'ana aare enkurma; neyae obo neing'uari olikae.”

English: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, ore tiatua nena nyaun naata nkopir naapuo too nkejek moo ng'uan indimidimi intae aainosa nena naata ndapi too nkejek enye, naa ninche epuoyie te nkop.

English: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
Masaai: Entudumunye naa taata, nipuopuo aalang olkeju le Seredi. Neaku kishomo iyiook aalang olkeju le Seredi.

English: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
Masaai: naaishooki maitoduaa ltung'ana pooki eneikunari enkitabaroto e ina kishorunoto naisudoyioki apa too lporori ti atua Enkai naitayio pooki toki;

English: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
Masaai: Ore nkiri o lchoni nepejoo ninye te nkima tiauluo ilng'oborri.

English: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
Masaai: Entorrinyoki ninche ena olong taata nkurman enye, o nkurman enye oo sabibu, o nkurman enye oo loirienito, o nkajijik enye, o maaip oo ropiyiani enye, o entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o ina ilata apa niwaita aaitung'uaa ninche.”

English: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol ilalashera lenyena aajo kenyor menye ninye aitalang ilalashera lenyena pooki, neibayu ninche ninye oleng, neaku meyieu neirorie ninye te supatisho.

English: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
Masaai: Ore olanyor lai netiu anaa embene e nkorropil te nanu, ina nairrag te mpolos oo lki laainei.

English: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
Masaai: Ore naa taata iakuku intae iloodiaa, ore ilkulikae te intae naa keaku irrindiki anaake, ilaiperrak loo lkeek o laokunok le nkare te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai.”

English: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
Masaai: ore ake pee eiririkino enkata, neibalunye ti atua ororei lenye aimunye ina likioroto naaishooki nanu mainosai te nkitanapata e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang.

English: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
Masaai: emayianata tenimbung'ubung'u nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, naitanapa apa nanu intae ena olong,

English: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Esipa eng'as Eliya alotu neitang'ejuk imbaa pooki. Paa amaa, ainyoo pee ejo lkigerot ti alo Enkerai e Tung'ani, eji keitamei too mbaa kumok nemenuni?

English: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi eilo torrono naa kekordilo, kake ore olkuaak leilo supat naa aisidai.

English: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
Masaai: “Entisipu naa ena, intae ilemedamu Enkai, pee mayooki ake apolos intae, nemetumi hoo obo oitajeu!

English: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
Masaai: Kake ntajeuo iyie iyiook too lmang'ati lang, nitipika olmilo lelo ooiba iyiook.

English: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Nibukoki Aron o layiok lenyena aitisiny ninche, pee aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak.

English: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu isinkan lo laiguanani Hesekia enetii Isaya,

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidima enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
Masaai: Metaa etudumunye Yakobo alo o pooki toki naata, nepuonu Beer-sheba, neitayu ilasarri aaitaiki Enkai e papaai lenye Isaak.

English: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninche enkaji e Nkai neuroo esuntai e Yerusalem, nepejoo nkajijik enyena pooki e nkitoo te nkima. Neinyal nena tokitin pooki e tipat.

English: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
Masaai: Amu te neaku ake oltung'ani olaning'oni lo rorei, mme olaasani, netiu ninye anaa oltung'ani oing'or enkomom enye te nking'uret.

English: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Hesekia o lkituaak aadol lelo sotot, neisis Olaitoriani nemayian iltung'ana lenyena le Israel.

English: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
Masaai: Ore nkiting'ot pokira are e nena keenta neibung'ieki lelo kererin pokira aare; neiko neijia aaibung'ie te nkalo e dukuya ooronyi le ina kila dorrop.

English: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Abiata, “Atayiolo apa te ina olong, etii Doeg ilo Edometi ine, inchere esipa keliki ninye Saul. Ayaua nanu ina keeya oo ltung'ana pooki le nkaji e papaai lino.

English: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo apa ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ina kata apa eikenoro to lgoriet le rripore ejo.

English: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche olaiguanani Nebukadnesa, “Laaiguanani, tobiko ntarasi!

English: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
Masaai: Neipang'u ninye nelotu aliki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, nejoki ninye, “Shomo timira ina ilata nilo alak isilen inono, ore iyie o layiok linono ninosinoso enkae ilata.”

English: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etiakita isinkan lenyena, “Nchoo eing'urakini enkiti siankiki olkitok lai olaiguanani, naa nchoo ninye eboitare olaiguanani, pee egolie ninye; nchoo ninye eirrag to lgoo lino pee etum olkitok lai olaiguanani airouaja.”

English: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
Masaai: Neitaiki ninye ilo ng'obor eneitushurieki too ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi, o ndapan oo nkineji.

English: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
Masaai: Naa kuna apa njung'oreitin naatang'amutua iltung'ana le Israel te nkop e Kanaan, apa naaishoo ninche Eliesa olapolosani o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o lukuny oo lmareita loo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: Let all your things be done with charity.
Masaai: Enchoo eaku ore pooki bae niasiasa, entaas te nyorrata.

English: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oipirta Turo. Enteyietu enchira, na melin e Tarshishi, amu eitomijoonoki Turo neaku metii enkaji aashu ewueji neitasheyieki! Ore ebaiki enkop e Kupro eibalakinyeki ninche.

English: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
Masaai: nejo ninche maate, “Eikimut iyiook ninche katukul;” etapejoitie ninche iwuejitin pooki e Nkai neetumoreki ti atua ena kop.

English: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
Masaai: Amu ebaya lewa ootii, nkalifuni miet. Nejoki Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Entotona olorere too intukusi maa onom.”

English: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
