Masaai: Neisik apa kulo aiguanak pokira imiet, neisudoo ate ti atua enkapune te Makeda.

English: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
Masaai: Kake eitu ajo nanu aing'oru hoo nabo e kuna tokitin, neme ina pee atisiraka intae kuna baa; enaikash te naye alang te naiko neijia. Pee metumi oltung'ani hoo obo oyooki ajo kawuasare empesho.

English: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
Masaai: ninosinoso intae te wueji sinyati, amu erubata ino o erubata oo layiok linono te nena kishorot naapejokini te nkima Olaitoriani; amu ina nanu aaitanapaki.

English: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni lemesipa nemelo eitu eitamei, naa ore ilo oiro elejare nemeilanyisho aisik.

English: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
Masaai: Nelikini Yakobo aajoki:, “Eewuo olayioni lino Yosef enitii;” neitagoluo Israel nenyok ainyototo aton te ndapash.

English: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
Masaai: Nchoo ninche ena kitanapata too lkituaak lenye: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: ena intae ipupuo aajoki ilkituaak linyi:

English: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
Masaai: Kaae neipang kulo aapuo te nkanasa, lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni too lkerenketi, oina jore natusujayie ninche.

English: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
Masaai: Netii enkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong inchomito uni, netii kopikop inchomito uni, netii moikuape uni, netii endoyioroto e nkolong inchomito uni.

English: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
Masaai: o nkiaasin enyena e dukuya o kulie e siadi, ng'ura eigeroki ninche te mbuku oo laiguanak le Israel o le Yuda.

English: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
Masaai: Te ina errepi Papa, inchere iatata lng'anayio kumok, niakuku taa ilooiteng'eni laainei.

English: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
Masaai: amaa te neidaikieki ilkitamanyunot kaa eas ilo supat?”

English: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
Masaai: Neitashe Yesu nejo, “Empoto.” Neipoti ilo tung'ani modooni aajoki, “Intagoluoyu; inyo amu kimpot ninye.”

English: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
Masaai: Nerresh ilaisiaayiak lenyena ninye near metua tiatua aji.

English: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
Masaai: “Ore ilo ng'anayioi oshi otang'uarra oltau lino nikitung'uayie iyie, ore intokitin inono pooki e nkuso o esikar kitung'uaitie ninche, nemeitokini ae kata aatum.”

English: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa lelo arishak le Israel, “Nchoo ake pooki ng'ae te intae esesekuan oltung'ani lenye oteenikia kewan esinkaisho e Baal e Peor.”

English: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
Masaai: Nerrinyo lelo aapuo aaliki lkulikae, kake eitu ninche eiruk.

English: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
Masaai: Naaitoki aiseyie nanu obo oata empukunoto e tung'ani naaitagol nanu.

English: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore ninye mbariak keisho ilki neitanak nkera kake ore entito oo ltung'ana laainei netagogong'o, etotiuo anaa isidan tiong'ota.

English: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Sanbalat, o Tobia, o Lmarabu, o Lamori le Ashdod nchere eloito dukuya e ramata e suntai e Yerusalem, netunukaki ilusien enyena, negoro ninche oleng.

English: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
Masaai: amu inkilikuanu ajo, ‘ainyoo tipat naata nanu? Kaa sipata nanu aata alang tenataasa eng'oki?’

English: Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that is abomination before the LORD: and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.
Masaai: ore ilo moruo apa le dukuya otaarayie ninye meshomo, nemeidim anyaaki aawa ninye ayama eidipaki aatipik olduruk. Amu olminong ilo te dukuya Olaitoriani, nemeishiakino teniyauu entorroni shumata ena kop naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi entujung.

English: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Ainyoo pee eiro olkitok lang irorei laijo kulo? Metalama isinkan linono ina aaku keidim aataas embae naijo ina!

English: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
Masaai: Ee, ekaisho iltung'ana meshomo tiatua iyie, o ltung'ana laainei Israel; naa keya ninche intae, iyakuku intae enjung'ore enye, nemeitoki ae kata inkera ang aatum osina.

English: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
Masaai: Neman Yesu inkang'itie pooki sapuki o nkutiti, neiteng'enisho too nkajijik enye e ntumo, nelikioo ilomon supati le nkitoria e keper, neishiunye pooki keeya o pooki pukunoto e mueyian.

English: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
Masaai: Kepuoi aaya Edom, ore Seir, ilmang'ati lenyena naa kepuoi aaya, eitobirari ninye Israel aisulu,

English: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
Masaai: Ore te intae metiu nejia; kake ore pooki tung'ani te intae oyieu neaku kitok; inchoo eaku olaisiaayiani linyi,

English: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.
Masaai: Nejoki Yonadab ninye, “Irraga te ndapash ino, nintaakuno eimuei; ore ake pee kilotu papaai lino adol, tiaaki ninye, ‘Nchoo enkanashe ai Tamar aalotu aisho endaa nanya, neitobir endaa te dukuya nanu, pee atum nanu atoduaa ina daa, nanya nanu te nkaina enye.’ ”

English: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Noa, “Atumuta to ltau ajo kaiting'ie pooki sesen, amu eiputa enkop o larrabal tenkaraki ninche, ng'ura kaidaikie nanu ninche o enkop.

English: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
Masaai: Amu ti nimbelekenyanya aaibung'are olpisiai le kuna kuapi naatelekutua tene ti atua intae niyamama o ninche, pee iyamiyama nkituaak enye neyam nkuninyi,

English: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
Masaai: Nebolu lelo emasipaisho enye; neibung ilayiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena; ore tenebo ninye nedung to lalem; neaku ninye entoki naimakini tiatua inkituaak ina kata nadung'okini ninye enkiguana.

English: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
Masaai: “Ore iyie, Nakerai e tung'ani, iwa osoit nirragie te dukuya iyie, nisir ilkererin te ilo soit oitodolu enkanasa e Yerusalem;

English: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
Masaai: Nejo Daudi eeta enkure, “Woi naaji tenatum oltung'ani laayaki enkare naok to lchorro le Betlehem otii embata e kishomi!”

English: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Ruben, eiteru tenkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Yuda, erubata nabo.

English: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
Masaai: Amu etoikioki iyiook enkerai, eishooki iyiook enkayioni, naa keaku oloililai lenye etii enkitoria, naa kepuoi aajo enkarna enye, “Olaiguanani le Nking'asia, Enkai Magilani, Papa loo Ntarasi, Olkitok le Seriani.”

English: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani kulo rorei, neing'oru eneiko pee ekordu Daniel; nenyamalu o metadoi enkolong pee ekordu ninye.

English: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
Masaai: Neitoki sii aitobir ntokitin e shumata naaikununo anaa nkopiyiani enkitoo, to suyai otosholaki, pee epiki shumata e nena ng'apeta; ore apa enkadoro entoki nabo naa ntemat imiet e nkaina.

English: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
Masaai: Netolimutuo lelo oibonok le Nkai, pooki ooiroro, ebaiki Samuel o lelo ootusujutua ninye, eibalunye sii apa ninche kuna olong'i.

English: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele laa ninye kitoning'o te ninye kinosaki intae nchere, ewang'an Enkai nemetii enaimin atua ninye tukul.

English: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
Masaai: Keitu eitapong'oo intae Hesekia pee eisho intae entuata to lameyu o te nkure, ejoki intae, “Kekordu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang te nkaina o laiguanani le Asiria?”

English: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
Masaai: Teneishooyo oltung'ani ewalata eton eitu ening'u, naa emodai enye o enkurruna.

English: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
Masaai: Na Ai, ore ebaiki kitisho ai kinteng'ena iyie nanu, neton ake aibalunye nkiasin inono e nking'asia.

English: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
Masaai: Kake eirriwayie Absalom ilkiliku te nkisudoroto atua Israel pooki, ejo, “Ore ake pee ining'ining'i oltoilo le mowuo, entejo, ‘Absalom olaiguanani te Hebron!’ ”

English: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
Masaai: Neewuo enetii ilenyena, neitu eng'amu ltung'ana lenyena ninye.

English: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
Masaai: Netii apa kulikae ootii ine ina kata ootolikitio Yesu eneikuna Pilato Ilgalilaya ootara metuata neitushulaki osarge oloo lasarri lenye.

English: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
Masaai: Olaitoriani iyiolo iyie; tadamuaki nanu nikimutan nanu, nintalaku elap tiaalo nanu too laisilisilok laainei. Ore te ng'iriata ino mikiya nanu; tayiolo ajo tenkaraki iyie pee anap imorot.

English: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
Masaai: Ore sii entaiki ninye kulie naatii irridat, ning'ueikiki ninye metasotu, nimimbuakiki ninye.”

English: Then said they, What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him? They answered, Five golden emerods, and five golden mice, according to the number of the lords of the Philistines: for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Kainyoo ilo asar le nkitarruorroto likishukoki iyiook ninye?” Newalu ninche aajo, “Iltuduta imiet le sahabu o ndero imiet e sahabu, anaa esiana oo lkituaak loo Lfilisti; amu etii apa shumata intae olmeitai otiu anaa ele o shumata ilkituaak linyi.

English: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, imbung'a inkitanapat e papaai lino, niming'uaa enkiteng'enare e yieyioo lino.

English: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
Masaai: nenap ninye oloing'oni pooki auluo ewueji nemeiduruk ine neibukorieki nkuruon, nepejoo ninye te nkima oo lkeek; ore te ine wueji neibukorieki nkuruon.

English: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
Masaai: Apa moitie iyie itipika olkitamanyunoto le nkop, ore keper naa esiaai oo nkaik inono.

English: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
Masaai: Amu enkurruna doi ninye te neimakini nena naas ninche too nkisudorot;

English: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
Masaai: Etii olduruk lenye olkila lenye eitu ninye edamu enkidaata enye ore enkaraki ina aikitok embatatata enye. Meeta ninye oltung'ani oitagol ninye. Olaitoriani, ing'ura osina lai, amu eisula olmang'atinta.

English: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
Masaai: “Naa tiaaki iyie ninche, ore pooki tung'ani le nkaji e Israel aashu o le lelo tung'ana omon oo etuo aatoni tiatua ninche oishorua olasar opejori,

English: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:
Masaai: “Kake teneiba ake ninye oltung'ani olelatia enye, neirrag arreshu ninye, neibung ninye, nesesekuan ninye neaku etua, nekuetiki ilo tung'ani nabo e kuna anas,

English: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
Masaai: Kake meidaikie ake Olaitoriani enkaji e Daudi, tenkaraki olning'o lo sotua apa oitobira ninye o Daudi, neisiligishore apa ninye pee eitoreisho eishoi enye, o layiok lenyena ntarasi.

English: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
Masaai: Neetuo ltung'ana kumok loo Lyahudi enetii Marisa o Mariamu o aaitigir tenkaraki lo lalashe lenye.

English: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
Masaai: Ore iyie o layiok linono o sinkan linono niturokiki ninye enkurma niyauu atua nena nintayuyu, pee etum olayioni lo lkitok lino endaa nanya; kake ore Mefiboshet olayioni lo lkitok lino nedaa anaake te mesa ai.” Neeta apa Siba ilayiok tomon o imiet o sinkan tikitam.

English: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
Masaai: Kaing'ae ilo tung'ani ng'en oleng oidim atayiolo ena: laa ninye eirorie enkutuk o Laitoriani, pee etum ninye aibalunye? Kainyoo pee einyalaki enkop aaidaikie anaa ong'ota, metaa meetae hoo obo ooim atua?

English: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
Masaai: Te neibelekenya ilmang'ati laainei, kerrorro neidak te dukuya iyie.

English: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
Masaai: Ming'or enaisho te nyokieni, ina kata eitokitoku te nkikompe, nedoyio aitobirari too lgoso.

English: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninye, “Olayioni lo laiguanani, kainyoo pee igira asasu anaake? Aimikiliki iyie nanu?” Nejoki Amnon ninye, “Kanyor nanu Tamar, enkanashe o lalashe lai Absalom.”

English: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
Masaai: Kake ore nkishu pooki o nena masaa naatii nkang'itie kiwaita aaraya.

English: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
Masaai: Iiu iyie ilayiok o ntoyie, kake meaku ninche nkuninono, amu keyae ninche aaraya.

English: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Kornelio, osajini kitok, oltung'ani supat oserem Enkai naa yioloti eyanyit olorere pooki loo Lyahudi, eirriwaka Enkai olmalaika neirorie ajoki mikirriwaki olkilikuai wou shomo enkaji enye, meshomo ninye aning irorei lijoki.”

English: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
Masaai: o sii, “Esisa Olaitoriani, Iloreren pooki;”

English: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Papa, tapalaki ninche, amu ai meyiolo enaasita.” Neosh ninche enkukuo pee etum aatoor nkilani enyena.

English: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
Masaai: “Ming'ida iyie Filistia, o intae pooki, eji nchere, etigile ina ng'udi apa natoosho intae; amu te eishoi o lasurai epuku olasurai torrono aisul, ore olng'anayioi lenye naa olasurai olo tiaai.

English: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
Masaai: Naa entiaaki lelo tung'ana le Israel, ore ilo pooki odek Enkai enye nenap eng'oki enye.

English: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
Masaai: Nekuet olbarnoti obo alo ajoki Musa, “Eibonisho Eldad o Medad to lng'obor.”

English: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye ineeshumishoreki sapuki too nkanas e Yuda. Neeta isikarini magil yiolot, te Yerusalem.

English: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
Masaai: Etudung'oyioki intae aarishie Kristo, intae taa lelo ooimu nkitanapat eji pee eikenaki Enkai intae isipat; imbelokinote oriong empiris e Nkai.

English: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
Masaai: Ebaa ena modai ninkilikuanua! Ore ina niun iyie openy nemeeta nchere eitu engas aye pee etum atubulu.

English: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
Masaai: Eikash oltung'ani oitashe te mborron neasaki kewan esiai, alang ilo orup kewan nemeeta endaa nanya.

English: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
Masaai: ore hoo nemetii olarrabal inkaik aainei, naa kesila enkomono ai.

English: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
Masaai: Ng'ura enjore namanita amuat enkanasa pee eya, naa ore te nkaraki olalem o lameyu olmeitai eishooyioki enkanasa aapik nkaik oo Lkaldayo, laa ninche oarare ninye. Ore apa ina niroro iyie netabayie, naa ng'ura, idolita iyie.

English: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
Masaai: ore te Abija naa Sikri; ore te Miniamin o te Moadia naa Piltai;

English: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
Masaai: Aaturrumoyioki nanu oleng, eyieu arriaa, kake aatareto Olaitoriani.

English: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
Masaai: Ore irorei le nking'oming'om naa kemelook, anaa mbelat e mukate, nedoyio aapuo atua ilkutot lo sesen.

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata eidipa oloiboni Hanania atigila nkeek aitayu te murt e Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ejo:

English: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
Masaai: Ore too lapolosak naa Yedaia, o Yehoiarib o Yakin,

English: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
Masaai: Naa keaku kitok neji Oinoti lo Lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki naa keisho Olaitoriani Enkai ninye olorika le nkitoo le Daudi menye lenye,

English: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
Masaai: Meing'urrie ninye nkera enyena, meitaas ninche anaa nkera enyena; ore hoo tenaa enepesho esiaai enye, meureisho ninye;

English: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
Masaai: Neaku sinyat ninche nkitanapat nesinya sii ina kitanapata, nesipa naa supat.

English: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house,and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, ore nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ino, o nena apa naatushuma loo papaai lino o metabaiki ena olong, naa kenapi aaya Babilon; meing'uari toki, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
Masaai: iyie oishopoki kewan ewang'an anaa olkila, iyie oisalaasha keper anaa olng'obor,

English: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
Masaai: Amu ore apa te ine, ore lelo ootaaraitie iyiook, neyieu nikiranyaki ninche osinkolio, ore lelo ooisilisil iyiook, nejo, “Entaranyaki iyiook obo loo sinkolioitin le Sion!”

English: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
Masaai: Ore peyie aayau ninye ine, ng'ura, etii apa oltung'ani, laa ore empukunoto enye netiu anaa osuyai, neeta te nkaina enye enkopito natemishoreki o entiyani natemishoreki te nkaina enye; neitashe ninye te wueji e kishomi.

English: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nji etejo Hesekia, ‘Ore ena olong naa enkolong o sina, enkolong e moroto, o esulare; etaa keini nkera nemeetae engolon naiunyeki.

English: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
Masaai: Nemut ninye nena anas, o erata pooki o pooki omanya inkanas, o pooki toki nabulu e nkop.

English: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
Masaai: atinyikaka apa nanu embata enkidaaroto tiatua eumuta olorere!”

English: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
Masaai: ilo apa otagolie iyiook te nebo ilooishu, neitu eisho nkejek ang metarrorroto.

English: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
Masaai: Aishiraka nanu ninye abuaku, neisis olng'ejep lai ninye.

English: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
Masaai: Naitoki adol likae malaika edou aing'uaa shumata, eimulumula te nkatampoi, netii olokirrai shumata endukuya enye, netiu enkomom enye anaa enkolong, neikununo nkejek enyena anaa ng'apeta e nkima.

English: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki Abraham Abimelek tenkaraki enchorro natoorutuo isinkan le Abimelek.

English: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
Masaai: o Nebo, o Baal-meon (eibelekenyaki nkarn enye), o Sibma, neisho ninche kulie arn nena anas naatesheta ninche.

English: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatasho ninye, neor nkilani enyena aaoshie enkukuo.

English: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
Masaai: o nkera inyi, o nkituaak inyi, o lomon ootii atua ilng'oborri linyi, oilo obarn ilpapit loo nkerra o ilo likiokoki enkare,

English: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
Masaai: intae ilooinos nkiri oo ltung'ana laainei, nenang'aa ilonito lenye aaidie ninche, nigiligili iloik lenye aaitaa ng'iligilat, nigiligil anaa iloik oopiki emoti, netiu anaa nkiri naatii emoti.

English: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
Masaai: Neirorie sii Abna Benchamen; neitoki Abna alo aliki Daudi te Hebron nena pooki naatodua Israel; pooki o enkaji e Benchamen pooki aajo sidain te neas.

English: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
Masaai: naa te naikilikuan intae embae nimikiwalikiki.

English: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
Masaai: ilo oibooyo enaibon oo laimonkok, neitaa iloibonok le lejare; ilo oibelekenyu ilang'eni arrinyu, neitaa ina ng'eno enye emodai;

English: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
Masaai: Tipika olalem oololo amu eo enkisampuare. Entijing'u entunyo amu eipute enkironyet. Eilogilog iltooi aadooyo, amu aikitok entorroni enye.

English: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkitanapat naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, naaipirta olee o enkitok enye, olpayian o entito enye, te lelero enye, eton etii enkaji e papaai lenye.

English: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
Masaai: Ore nena kishorunot enyena naa ketejo pee eaku kulikae ilkipaareta, neaku kulikae iloibonok le Nkai, neaku kulikae ilalikiorok, neaku kulikae ilairritak o laiteng'enak,

English: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
Masaai: Etung'uayioki ina tito e Sion anaa olng'obor ti atua enkurma oo sabibu, anaa olkirragarie ti atua enkurma e entoki naaijo nkaimalasia anaa enkanasa natang'aduaki.

English: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
Masaai: Neishopito olkila oitadoikioki osarge neji enkarna naipotieki Ororei le Enkai.

English: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
Masaai: Nedumu ninye ninche te ina saa ake e nkewarie, neisuj nena oshot enye, neibatisae ninye nabo kata o lelo lenyena pooki.

English: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
Masaai: Amu kelotu eng'eno atua oltau lino, ore eyiolounoto neaku aisidai tiatua oltau lino.

English: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
Masaai: Ore eton eitu elo Abimelek anyikaki ninye, etejo, “Olaitoriani, oar metuata iltung'ana loo sipat?

English: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
Masaai: Near metuata ilaiguanak le Midian te nebo lelo kulikae ootasesekuanaki, Efi, o Rekem, o Surian, o Hur, o Reba lelo aiguanak imiet te Midian neitoki sii aasesekuan Balaam olayioni le Beor to lalem.

English: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana pooki loo siraeli nchere etorrinyunye Yeroboam, neirriwaa olkilikuai aaipotu ninye meeu eumata, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te shumata Isiraeli pooki. Meetae hoo obo otusujayie enkaji e Daudi, meteleku ake olosho le Yuda.

English: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
Masaai: Naa kaiput ildoinyo linyi lmpopoki; o too ndoinyo inyi o too nong'ot inyi o iyarat o lashepak linyi pooki kebatata nena pooki to lalem.

English: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: neiu Oholibama Yeush o Yalam o Kora. Kulo ninche Ilayiok le Esau ootoikioki ninye te nkop e Kanaan.

English: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Aijalon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
Masaai: Netii enchorro e Yakobo ine. Neton Yesu te mbata e nchorro etiu neijia, etanaure te lototo enye. Netaa enaaku saa ile ina kata.

English: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou iltung'ana le ina kop ninye neirriwaa ilkiliku lubot pooki e ilo kirine neyakini ltamueyia.

English: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.
Masaai: Neiturrurro Yuda aaing'oru eretoto to Laitoriani; eing'uaa nkanas pooki e Yuda nepuonu aaing'oru Olaitoriani.

English: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
Masaai: Neitoki aisho enkitanyaanyukoto ejo, “Keidim olmodooni atoriko likae modooni? Aimesulakino pokira aare engumoto?

English: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
Masaai: Kake entadamu sii intae napa olong'i e dukuya ina kata apa eidipaki aaitawang'aki intae, ing'iriri enkitirrishakinoto nagol te nebo emion,

English: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
Masaai: o ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o laiguanak pooki loo loshon ooshula oomanya olpurkel;

English: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
Masaai: Kake eiteng'ela Mariamu nena baa pooki edamu to ltau lenye.

English: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
Masaai: Naa ena enkitanapata nikiata aa ninye eing'uaa, nchere ore ilo onyor Enkai neishiakino nenyorru sii ninye olalashe lenye.

English: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
Masaai: Tagolieki nanu Olaitoriani, amu iyie nanu asaru.

English: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
Masaai: Keisiaaisho apa Samuel te dukuya Olaitoriani, ina ayioni eishopito enkila sidai dorrop.

English: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
Masaai: Aikijo aa naa, lalashera laainei? Te neaku nturrurrote, nebaiki neterretene likae eeta osinkolio anaa eeta enkisuma, e mbolunoto, e nkiroroto oo lng'ejepa aashu enkitawalata, kake enchoo nena pooki eaku ine nchetunoto ake e ilo turrur.

English: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
Masaai: Ore pee ejing ninye Yerusalem, neing'oling'ola enkang pooki, aajo, “Ai ng'ai ele?”

English: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
Masaai: “Kemayiani ilng'anayio lo sesen lino, o lng'anayio le nkop ino, o lng'anayio loo nkishu inono, oina ponunoto oo nkerrai inyi.

English: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Masaai: lelo ooiro elejare too nkutukie enye, laa ore enkaina enye e tatene, naa enkaina e tatene e lejare.

English: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
Masaai: ore oloba anaa olemebatata aserem nenang'akini atua olkokuet le nkima oyupuyup.

English: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu lelo Yahudi apa ootashare ninche, nejoki ninche iyiook katitin tomon, ore too wuejitin pooki neemanya ninche, nepuonu ninche aagilunore iyiook.

English: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nerrinyu olaiguanani le Edom enkanasa e Elat, metaa ene Edom, nearaa iltung'ana le Yuda aitung'uaa enkanasa e Elat; nepuonu iltung'ana le Edom Elat nebik ninche teine o taata.

English: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
Masaai: Ekaishoru sii nanu ewalata ai; naa kaibalie sii nanu enduaata ai.

English: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yoshua te nebo ltung'ana pooki lo larrabal, pee eilep aapuo Ai, negelu Yoshua iltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni magil oodupa, neirriwaa ninche kewarie.

English: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
Masaai: Ara nanu ilo olimu shakenisho enye makewan, naa kaaishakenoki nanu Papa laairriwua.”

English: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
Masaai: “Ore apa teina kata naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Tagueta mbaoi are o soit naatiu anaa inapa e dukuya, nilepu alotu enatii to ldoinyo, nintobir osanduku loo nkeek.

English: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani tiatua ilayiok le Aron, laa ninye etubukokoki eilata aaput pee etonie olorika lenye, neitarasaki ninye Olaitoriani anaa apa enaibalunyeki ntarasi; nepejori pooki.

English: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
Masaai: Eish enkishui ai anaa emeli nakuet oleng, anaa olkurragos odoiki aibung entoki nainos.

English: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Shefatia, o Sebadia olayioni le Mikael, netii tenebo ninye Ilewa ntomoni isiet.

English: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
Masaai: Oltung'ani apa ogol oleng Yeroboam, naa ore ake pee edol Solomon ajo kaarriyia ilo barnoti, neisho meitasheiki esiaai pooki oo nkaik e nkaji e Yosef.

English: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika lelo ooitashe te dukuya ninye, “Entayu nena kilani naang'u naaiduruk naaishopito entung'uai ninye.” Nejoki ninye, ninye “Ing'ura, aiwuang'ie ing'ok inono te iyie naa kaaishopoki nanu iyie inkilani sidain.”

English: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Daudi awalu nejo, “Empotokoki Betsheba.” Neaku eewuo ninye enetii olaiguanani, neitashe te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninche iloing'ok oopishana, o lmeregeshi oopishana o lkuoo le kerra oopishana, tenkaraki olasar loo ng'ok o tenkaraki enkitoria, o tenkaraki ewueji sinyati o tenkaraki Yuda. Neitoki ninye aitanap ilapolosak lelo ayiok le Aron pee eishooyo ninche anaa olasar te nchumata olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani.

English: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Solomon ainos olmumai to Laitoriani ejo, “Maaitaasa Olaitoriani ena naaitulus tenemeinosieki ele rorei enkishui e Adonija!

English: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
Masaai: ae laisiaayiak le Kristo ninche, nanu olusoo. airorita anaa oloata oloirirua? Ateeke nanu te siaai nagol, te eenata te korokoroni, te earata oo nkeenta o te batisho e keeya nalang enayiolo ninche.

English: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
Masaai: pee eyanyitu pooki Enkerai anaa te neyanyit Papa. Ore pooki ng'ae lemeyanyit Enkerai, nemeyanyit Papa oirriwua ninye.

English: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
Masaai: Naa te na kintadedeyie nchere eikiyiolo ninye, ti nikimbung nkitanapat enyena.

English: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
Masaai: Entadamu lelo ootii korokoroni, anaa eitii korokoroni te nebo ninche, o lelo ooinyali, amu itii sii intae atua ilo sesen.

English: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
Masaai: Mme Enkai neme asipani metaa kerikino enkisiaayiare inyi enyorrata nintoduaaitie ti alo lelo sinyat ooisiaaisho, neton ake isiaaitata.

English: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
Masaai: lelo tung'ana torrok likikeshare iyie, lelo ooilepie ate te ntorroni likigilunore te ntorroni!

English: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
Masaai: Nelo ninye ajurru ina keeya, naa tenetii enkeeya isunta eina aji etii iltipot oo nyori o loonyokie, naa tenelioo aa eijo kegut aalang esuntai,

English: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening Musa; etelekutua embata o mekenyiki neiu ilkuru neng'ueyu; negorokino Musa ninche.

English: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
Masaai: mishetishete intae enkaji; misampumpu intae olantererai, miunuunu intae aashu itumutumu enkurma oo sabibu; kake itonini intae too lng'oborri too nkolong'i inyi pooki, pee itumutumu aatobikoi nkolong'i kumok teina kop nimanyimanya.’

English: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kohat naa: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron o Usiel.

English: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
Masaai: Keoru sii intae inkilani inyi neya te intae isoito linyi gelunot.

English: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaitame nanu ninye te nkaraki nena olong'i o sirua le Baal ina kata apa pee epejoki enkorropil ninche, nekuso ninye too lgiso o too masaa, nelo asujaa isintan lenyena, nemaadamu ninye nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
Masaai: Neipang'u apuku too lng'oborri loo Lfilisti oloing'oni oji Goliat, le Gas, laa ore enkadoro enye negiroo ntemat e nkaina ile,

English: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
Masaai: Etur ineeimi too nong'ot nemetaaniki iltung'ana; meekure edamu ninche lelo apuayak. Eililio ninche too neelakuaniki iltung'ana neyuko inkaloli pooki.

English: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
Masaai: Anaa orrindik oyieu oleng oloip, anaa etiu anaa oltung'ani oigero oing'oru olekoisiayio lenye?

English: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yakobo papaai lenye ninche, “Kinchirie intae to sina sapuk aaiturrarrie inkera aainei: Meekure eetae Yosef, nemeekure eetae Simon, ore tena kata naa intokiki aaya Benchamen, ore kuna pooki naa inaanoto nanu.”

English: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
Masaai: Emining intae Hesekia, amu nji ejo olaiguanani le Asiria; ‘Ntobira olning'o o nanu, nilotu enatii; ore pooki ng'ae te intae, neinos enkurma enye oo sabibu, neinos pooki ng'ae ilng'anayio lo lng'aboli lenye; neok pooki ng'ae enkare olchorro lenye;

English: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
Masaai: Neiteneneng nkejek aainei anaa entarakuet, naaitaserian ninye nanu too neeika.

English: And Benhadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
Masaai: Nejoki Benhadad ninye, “Ore nkanasa natooruo papaai, papaai lino kaarrinyoki nanu; nindim iyie atasheta iwuejitin neemirishoreki te Dameski, anaa apa enataasa papaai te Samaria.” Nejo Ahab, “Kaaisho nanu iyie shomo te kulo rorei.” Kaae neitobir olning'o o ninye neisho meshomo.

English: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
Masaai: “Wooi wooi ena kito anasa naishopo apa too nkilani naapuyiapui o morijo o naanyokie, neikodi, te sahabu o too soito oogol enkinyang'a o too lului.

English: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu ina, nejoki, “Kitong'orikia nabo toki. Timira pooki toki niaata tooriki laisinak, naa itum olchumati te shumata; wou taa tusujuaki.”

English: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Tapala; aaitobiraka ena te nkaraki enkolong enukaroto ai;

English: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
Masaai: Kake eitu hoo ening'u embae nabo e kuna; keisudoro ena bae te ninche, neaku eitu ening'u enajoki.

English: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
Masaai: Ayiolo ajo meisho ntae olaiguanani le Misiri ipuopuo meteleku ake te nkaraki enkaina naata enkidimata naas ti atua ninye; ore te siadi ina niyaya karsisisho e Misiri.

English: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
Masaai: Neitoki ake Yesu ajoki, “Ainyoo pasa aitanyaanyukie enkitoria e Nkai?

English: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Neitu ayiolou nanu ninye, kake ilo laairriwua maibatishisho te nkare, ninye laatiaaka nanu, ‘Ore olidol edoiki Enkiyang'et netonie, ninye oibatisisho te Nkiyang'et Sinyati.’

English: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
Masaai: Neitayu Saul olg'obor to ldoinyo le Hikila, otii embata enkoitoi nalala te nkalo o loo saen le Yesimon. Kake etotona Daudi to lpurkel; ore ake pee edol ajo eewuo Saul asuju ninye atua olpurkel,

English: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Adolita taata ajo meekure aanyor papaai linyi anaa apa. Kake etii Enkai e papaai lai tenebo nanu.

English: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and PrAzareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
Masaai: o Elkana, o Ishia, o Asarel, o Yoeser, o Yashobeam, le Kora;

English: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
Masaai: Kaji eikuna olnyuntu le nkop pooki pee etudung'oki aagil! Kaji eikuna pee etaa Babilon entoki naitureisho tiatua iloreren!

English: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
Masaai: Mipikipiki intae eng'ape naiba Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Daudi ina, neirriwaa enjore pooki oo ltung'ana magil.

English: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
Masaai: Nelotu Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon agilunore ninye, neen ninye too lpisia neya ninye Babilon.

English: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
Masaai: Ore etii ine nedol Yuda entito e likae tung'ani loo Lkanaan neji enkarna enye Shua; neyam ninye nelo aboitare.

English: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Yoel: Shemia olayioni lenye, o Gog olayioni lenye, o Shimei olayioni lenye,

English: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
Masaai: La alem lo Laitoriani! kanu kenya intirring'a? Tipika kewan atua enchashur ino, iyeng'iyeng'ayu nintirring'a!

English: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
Masaai: Shomo intare, niking'uraki ilbalelon aare sidain, peyie aitobirie endaa namelok sidai naaijo enoshi nanyor papaai lino.

English: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ilo barnoti otiaka ninye, “Kainyoo nikintayiolo iyie nchere etua Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye?”

English: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ejo Ilmisiri, e ntorroni apake eyiaraki ninche, pee eitupukuo alotu aar metuata too ldoinyo, nemut ninche aiwuang'ie ti oriong e nkop? Mbelekenyayu tapala engoro ino napi, nirridutena torroni te nkaraki iltung'ana linono.

English: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Masaai: miureishoyu, amu atii nanu te nebo iyie, ming'aeng'ae, amu ara nanu Enkai ino; kaaitagol nanu iyie, kaaretu nanu iyie, kaaibung nanu iyie te nkaina ai e tatene naata engolon.

English: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
Masaai: Ore anaa enailepie Musa olasurai ti ong'ata meeta nchere pee eitu eilepieki Enkerai e Tung'ani aaiko neijia,

English: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
Masaai: Ore eirishisho ajo neijia, nejo Festo to ltoilo sapuk, “Paulo, oloirirua iata, eng'eno ino kitok nikioshoo elukunya.”

English: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
Masaai: Amu eeta Olaitoriani loo lororani enkolong nagilunore ilo pooki owuasa neitokoos, agilunore ina pooki nailepieki aadumu;

English: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, etii kulikae ooitashe te ne, lemeinyorrinyor keeya katukul metaba anaa nedol Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu te nkitoria enye.”

English: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kenyor apa Olaitoriani ninye neirriwaa olkilikuai te Natan ilo oiboni, neaku etejo ninye enkarna enye Yedidia, te nkaraki Olaitoriani.

English: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Farao ina, neing'oru pee ear Musa metua. Kake eisika Musa ailany Farao, nebik te nkop e Midian neton te mbata e nchorro.

English: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
Masaai: ore pee intoki aosh abuaku e niare, ore lelo ng'oborri ootii enkalo e kopikop nedumunye aaidur. Embuakunoto eoshi enkata naba anaa enadumunye ninche.

English: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
Masaai: o le Shemida, olmarei loo le Shemida; o le Heper, olmarei loo le Heper.

English: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
Masaai: Ore eloito ninye ekedito osikiria nedou alotu abori olmelil lo ldoinyo, ng'ura, nelotu Daudi, o ltung'ana lenyena aadou aanang'are ninye; nenang'are ninye ninche.

English: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
Masaai: Kekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkitorogonyata o entorroni; naa eikirotet osarge lenye too nkonyek enyena.

English: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
Masaai: Nelo ninye aas anaa enatejo Eliya; ore ninye o Eliya olmarei lenye neinos endaa nkolong'i kumok.

English: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
Masaai: Naitoki agil eng'udi ai e are naji “Naboisho.” Neaku etaraki Naboisho oo lalashera, Yuda o Israel.

English: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki ninche, “Idolitata ena nyamali nikitii iyiook atua, entodol aajo eirragita Yerusalem aa olmuate, netapejoki nchomito enyena. Wootu mateshet iyiook esuntai e Yerusalem, peemikingil aata esulare.”

English: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.
Masaai: Neisho ninche metookisho too nkikompeni e sahabu oo mpukunot kumok, naa eisapuk oleng enaisho oo sabibu anaa enaikununo enkaminino o laiguanani.

English: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
Masaai: peyie atum aibung'a lelo tauja leina aji e Israel, lelo pooki ootapong'ori te nanu too nkitayaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
Masaai: ‘Keidim oltung'ani oye ataa sinyati te dukuya Enkai? Keidim oltung'ani ataa sinyati te dukuya Olaitobirani lenye?

English: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
Masaai: Ore ilo oloolo ainosaa imbaa olmarenke nebolu imbaa naaisudoro, kake ore ilo oisiligayu to ltau neshum embae aisudoo.

English: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kigira iyiook aaen irridat le enkano tiatua enkurma naa ng'ura, ore orridati lai etudumunye aitashe, aitoriori naa ng'ura, ore irridat linyi pooki eetuo pooki aiturrurrokino aaman ninye, neirrugokino pooki orridati lai.”

English: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
Masaai: neitoki adoyio aing'or enkalo oloo ntoluo o metabaiki enkop oo Lyafelet o metabaiki ina kop e Bet-horon ti abori, neitoki alo Geser nelo aiting te naiposha.

English: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
Masaai: Milimu ena te Gat minchir aitasim ore tiatua Betlefara mperiperayu te nterit.

English: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
Masaai: Naning nanu oltoilo lo Laitoriani ejo, “Kaing'ae nanu airriwaa, naa kaing'ae olo te nkaraki iyiook?” Najo nanu, “Nele nanu! Irriwayioki.”

English: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
Masaai: nimpotu enjore naikununo anaa enapa natimiraki. Aipirakinye embarta enkae barta o engarri oo mbartan enkae garri oo mbartan; nikipuo iyiook aarare ninche te nkop naisiaja nemeeta nchere pee eitu iyiook kigolu aalang ninche.” Nening ninye enatejo ninche, neas ina.

English: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
Masaai: Ore imiet nemoda, ore inkulie imiet naa ng'eni.

English: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
Masaai: Neyieng ninche olkuoo le pasaka neisuaaya ilapolosak ilo sarge otang'amutua too Lawi, ore Ilawi neibung ina nateyieng'aki aapolos.

English: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
Masaai: Itoning'uo iyie asipu endapasho enkop? Imbalunye tiniyiolo kuna pooki.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Etimiraki apa intae pesho, naa kepuoi sii aakordu intae metii enkinyang'a.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake mme sidai ake oltau lenye.

English: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
Masaai: Kake te naing'orisho nanu metii hoo obo, ore atua kulo metii olaikooni, laa te naikilikuanisho newalu.

English: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Tolikioki sii iyie, amaa, kena siana inosie enkurma inyi? Ei mpesai esiana naje ake inosie?” Nejoki, “Ee esiana naje ake.”

English: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
Masaai: Eitorogonyaki apa ninye neisilisili, kake eitu ebol enkutuk enye; ore anaa olkuo le ker opuoi aayieng, o anaa enker natii dukuya lelo oodung ilpapit lenyena, mebol enkutuk, neijia sii apa eikuna ninye, eitu ebol enkutuk.

English: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
Masaai: Kake te naiguanare, nesipa enkiguana ai, amu mme nanu ake, kake nanu o ilo laairriwua.

English: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
Masaai: Te neany menye eisho ninye meyama, nelaaki impisai naarisiore ine nkiyama oo ntoyie neitu ae kata eyiolou olee.

English: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
Masaai: Mipik kewan dukuya ine netii olaiguanani arashu doi intashe te ine wueji olkitok.

English: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
Masaai: Meetae hoo olopi oleng oidim atuputu ninye aing'ae naa doi ilo oidim aitasho te dukuya nanu?

English: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
Masaai: Ore ina kata dol lelo oreren ootung'uayioki oomanita iyie neyiolou aajo nanu, Olaitoriani, otesheta nenen wuejitin apa neeidaitie, naun ine apa netung'uayioki aa olmuaate; Nanu, Olaitoriani oiroro, naa kaas ina.

English: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
Masaai: Ore peyie eitupuku ninche ninye, etiakita, “Isikie enkishui ino, niminang ake silig, nimintashe ake te dikae to yarata isikaki indoinyo pee mindaaya.”

English: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu inkejek olmaima eililio pesho, neijia etiu endung'et e rashe te nkutuk olmodai.

English: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
Masaai: Shomo iyie tiaaki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Itara iyie oltung'ani metua niya ntokitin enyena?” ’ Nintoki ajoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore ine wueji apa nemejie ildiain osarge le Nabot, teine epuo ildiain aamej osarge lino.” ’ ”

English: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Ore enkop pooki, Olaitoriani, ebore enyorrata ino nauno; nteng'enaki nanu nkikuanat inono!

English: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from  Jabeshgilead to the assembly.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Kalo osho ilo too loshon le Israel leitu elotu enetii Olaitoriani te Mispa?” Naa ng'ura, meetae hoo obo ebaiki Yabesh-gilead oshomo ina umata.

English: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Na kitok, aainyoo pee inchirita?” Nejoki ninche, “Amu ewaita ninche Olaitoriani lai, nemayiolo nanu eneshomo aapik ninye.”

English: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, terretena empolos ino; tudumunye tiaaki ninche pooki toki naba anaa enaaitanap iyie. Mincho kinture ninche maaiture ake nanu iyie te dukuya ninche.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Miureyu iyie ninye; amu aishorua nanu ninye apik atua nkaik inono, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, o enkop enye; naa ilo iyie aitaas ninye anaa enintaasa Sihon olaiguanani le Amori, apa omanya Heshbon.”

English: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
Masaai: Neitamany ninye ine ilo oaata esumash, neshetu ninche enkanasa nabikie;

English: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
Masaai: too ntonat oo ldoinyo. Nadoyio nanu alo ina kop naaikenorieki nanu ntarasi; ore ake eyia, niyaua iyie enkishui ai ailepunye ti atua engumoto, Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai.

English: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
Masaai: te nepaashare ninche nkikoot aainei, nemeibung nkitanapat aainei,

English: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
Masaai: ore ine wueji apa oltudutai nejing ewueji naibor neteijia aashu ewueji oo ltipot ooibor o loo nyokie, nepuoi aaitodol olapolosani;

English: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Masaai: Neaku aatalaakitia ninche enkiba te nyorrata, o mang'atisho te nyorrata ai.

English: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
Masaai: amu kintanyamala ninche iyie te nkeleekisho enye, amu ninye etelejie intae te ina bae e Peor, o te ina bae e Kosbi, ina tito o lkitok le Midian, ina anashe enye apa nataraki metua te nkolong o lmeitai te mbae e Peor.”

English: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
Masaai: Amu esipa nchere mme lmalaika doi eimaki kake eishoi e Abraham.

English: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
Masaai: Eeta ninche engolon naikenie oloing'ang'e pee meshau enchan te nena olong'i e naibon enye. Neeta ninche engolon naitoreyie nkariak o enaibelekenyie metaa osarge. Near enkop to lmeitai ake pooki naaba anaa enayieu ninche.

English: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
Masaai: Neinyototo nabo kata te dukuya ninche, nedumu enaduoo rruat napetita, nelo ang eisisita Enkai.

English: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Ilootemieki Israel apa ninche, pee eyiolouni tenaa keidim Israel aibung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani apa naaitanapa ninye loo menye te Musa.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Eibookoki iltung'ana le Israel enkop o ltung'ana le Yuda tenebo ninche, ore lelo pooki apa ootaraitie ninche neibung'a ninche aakurraki, etanyaita ninche eisho ninche meshomo.

English: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
Masaai: Omaa kenya te mpiunoto oo lootuata, keaku ene ng'ae ina kitok? Amu eyama naa pokira oopishana?”

English: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
Masaai: Amu eibalunye oltoilo oing'uaa Dan neitudupaa entorroni ebaiki oldoinyo le Efraim.

English: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, nchoo pooki ng'ae lo rrekie le Nkai, kiomon iyie. Ore te nkata o sina, o enang'unoto oo nkariak kituaak, nemebaiki ninye.

English: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
Masaai: Eikash eng'eno nagut alang imasaa o larrabal, kake ore olaing'okoni obo nemut intokitin sidain kumok.

English: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
Masaai: Naiger te nkarna ai teina palai enkurma, nemisir neyau ilchakenini, neipim mpisai to rratili.

English: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
Masaai: Ore nanu, o ltung'ana pooki ootii te nebo nanu, nikipuo aanyikaki ina anasa. Naa ore te neipang'u ninche aapuonu aarare iyiook, anaa apa, nikimpirri aailanyisho te dukuya ninche;

English: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni naa Eliabu olayioni le Helon, ilo arikoni loo ltung'ana le Sebulon:

English: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
Masaai: neaku ng'eni neisosion, neramatisho ti ang, naa supati, nening ilpayiani lenye pee memenuni ake ororei le Enkai.

English: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
Masaai: Ore pee ebau ina kata, aibonisho nanu, neye Peletia olayioni le Benaia. Nabatata te nkomom ai, naishir to ltoilo sapuk najo, “Aha Olaitoriani Enkai! Inting'ie aishu lelo lekunot le Israel?”

English: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
Masaai: ore naa entemata e nkinyiang'a ino olee ebaiki ilarin tikitam omeitabaiki ilarin ntomoni ile naa keaku shekeli onom e nkosholai, te risioroto eina shekeli e wueji sinyati.

English: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
Masaai: Naa te neoro enkaji ti atua kewan, nemeidim ina aji aitasho.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

English: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

English: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
Masaai: Aimetii enkop pooki dukuya iyie? Toorori te nanu. Teniito iyie enkaina e kedienye, naito ene tatene naa tiniito iyie ene tatene, naito nanu ene kedienye.”

English: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
Masaai: Amu eitaa olom oltung'ani oloarisho, nemepalaki te nelo neitalakisho elap.

English: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

English: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
Masaai: Kake etejo ilo kitok le njore, “Kaairriwua nanu olkitok lai maeu airorie olkitok linyi, o intae, nemairorie lelo ootoni te suntai, laa ore ninche te nebo nipuopuo aainos nkik inyi niokioko nkulak inyi?”

English: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
Masaai: “Te neisho oltung'ani inkishu edaa te nkurma anaa te nkurma oo sabibu anaa epalaa enkiteng meshomo ainos enkurma e likae tung'ani meeta nchere pee meitalakuni teina naisul naing'uaa enkurma enye oo sabibu.

English: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
Masaai: Eirorie intae Olaitoriani nchororo nkomomi to ldoinyo, te mpolos eina kima,

English: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

English: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
Masaai: Eng'orutu isidain, mme ntorrok, pee ipokipoko; pee etum Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani ataa te nebo intae, anaa enitejo intae.

English: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.
Masaai: Ore apa Absalom eton eishu neitobiraka kewan eng'ape osoit natii atua oerata lo Laiguanani, amu etejo ninye, “Maata nanu olayioni oshum enkarna ai metadamuni.” Neipotie ina ng'ape kewan, naa keji enadamunyeki Absalom o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
Masaai: Ore teine nipuopuo aaisiaai nkaitin oo nkeek o noo soito, ina siaai oo nkaik e tung'ana, ina nemedolisho, nemening'isho nemenya endaa, nemeing'uaya toki.

English: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Ore pooki oning intae, nanu ening, ore oloany intae, nanu eany, ore olaany nanu, naa ilo laairriwua etanya.”

English: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
Masaai: Nesurdaany sii ninche isikarini, epuonu aayaki enaisho naisuijo

English: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
Masaai: Amu ore ine nijing'itata aaya nemetiu anaa enkop e Misiri ning'uaa, ina kop nituunie intae ilanterera linyi nipikipiki enkare too nkejek inyi, anaa olchampa loo mpogai;

English: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata neing'oru erishata nakaldare ninye.

English: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Eming'am iseseni linyi te nkaraki iloo tuata aashu imishiriri ate: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

English: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
Masaai: Ore te nkata e siadi e nkitoria enye, eidipa ilaitarruorrok aatimitunye, nelotu olaiguanani ogogong netolo oyiolo oleng ndung'eta e rashe.

English: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
Masaai: Amu eitu eitoki aaitieu aaikilikuana ae bae.

English: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
Masaai: “Neitoki olapolosani aiger kulo deketa ti atua embuku, nejut ninche te ina are e nduaran,

English: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
Masaai: Ore pee elo ilo malaika aing'uaa ninye, neipot ilaisiaayiak aare le nkaji enye, o sikari obo oserem Enkai, oisiritore ninye anaa ake.

English: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife, and hath not taken her? let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.
Masaai: Naa kalo tung'ani tene otasayia entito neton eitu eyam? Nchoo ninye errinyo alo enkaji enye melo ake aye to larrabal neya likae tung'ani ina tito.’

English: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
Masaai: Neiki Naara ninye Ahusum, o Hefer, o Temeni, O Haashatari. Kulo ninche apa ilayiok le Naara.

English: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
Masaai: emintagol iltauja linyi anaa te napa gogong'i, te napa olong e ntemata ti ong'ata,

English: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
Masaai: Mishipa te nebatata o lmang'atinta lino, nimincho oltau lino eshipa te nebatata ninye;

English: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi: netumi Yosabad o Shimei o Kelaia, (aa taa Kelita) o Petahia, o Yuda, O Eliesa.

English: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
Masaai: Ore emion nainyiaaya oltung'ani enkalo nanyor Enkai naa keyau enkirridunoto nabaiki enjeunoto nemeitoki aata enkusaka, kake ore emion e nkop keeya eyau.

English: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
Masaai: Iton iyie airo entorroni tialo olalashe lino, ninteeniki enkerai ning'arie kina.

English: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oare le nkitoria e Ahas olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Hosea olayioni le Elan aitoreisho te Samaria, neitore ninye Isiraeli. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin ooudo.

English: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
Masaai: Mincho enkong'u ino meing'urrie ninye, kake iwuang'ie ena torroni e nkibukoroto osarge tiatua Israel, pee itum ataseriana.

English: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
Masaai: Neipot ninche Rebeka, nejoki ninye, “Amaa airiamariyie ele tung'ani?” Newal ajo, “Ekalo.”

English: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie larin tomon o oong'uan nanyaaka alo Yerusalem kiboita o Barnabas, narikito sii Tito.

English: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.
Masaai: Ore nena mowuarak tomon, ore ti atua ena kitoria neipang'u ilaiguanak tomon, naa kedumunye likae te siadi ninche; naa kepaashari ninye te kuldo le ndukuya, naa keiwuang'ie ninye ilaiguanak okuni.

English: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
Masaai: Eibelekenya entorroni inyi kuna aiwuang'ie, neitalamaitie ing'ok inyi mbaa supati aitung'uaa intae.

English: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
Masaai: Nelotu enkima naing'uaa dukuya Olaitoriani nemut ilo asar opejori oina kurriny natii shumata olperere lo lasar; ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki ina, nebuaku ninche nebatata too nkomomi enye.

English: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
Masaai: Nedamu Yosef inapa kidetidetat naaidetideta naipirta ninche; nejoki ninche, “Irara ilaikitalak, iyietuo aajur enchalan oo itung'ana lena kop.”

English: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
Masaai: Neiganya Yesu Enkiyang'et Sinyati apa pee errinyunye eing'uaa olkeju le Yordan, Nerik Enkiyang'et ninye ong'ata,

English: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
