English: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
Masaai: Ore te ina nintaa pesho ororei le Nkai te nena koon inyi nintarasakinono. Niasiasa doi kulie kumok neeijo nena.”

English: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Shomo shetani amu, etisiraki aajo, ‘Teserema Olaitoriani Enkai ino naa ninye ake openy isiaai.’ ”

English: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
Masaai: Neim Olaitoriani dukuya Musa nejo, “Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani, Enkai o lng'ur o empiris nemesioki agoro, nebore enyorrata nauno enkisiligata

English: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
Masaai: Iyiook etaboloko Enkai kuna baa te Nkiyang'et. Enkiyang'et najur pooki toki, o metabaiki enguton e Nkai.

English: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
Masaai: Naa tenadumu kewan ailepie, niking'oru nanu anaa olng'atuny ore ake sii nias inenking'asia enkaraki nanu;

English: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kairriwu nanu ilarreshok kumok loo sinkir, Olaitoriani ojo naa kerresh ninche; ore te siadi nairriu ilang'orok kumok loo ng'uesi, naa keng'or ninche te pooki doinyo o te pooki oigululu, o too nchumat oo ndapidapo.

English: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
Masaai: Entiaaki Enkai, “Kebaa eitureisho nkiaasin inono! Naa kitok engolon ino, o metaa kepuonu ilmang'ati linono aaborru te dukuya iyie.

English: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
Masaai: Ore inkolong'i pooki e lelo ooisilisili naa torrok, kake ore oltau oshipa neeta osirua anaake.

English: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye meishoo eseder enye ilo ooshisho; neiputi ninye imorot.

English: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;

Masaai: Ore ina kata ake neshipayu Yesu eiganya Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nejo, “Ashe Papa Olaitoriani le keper o enkop! Amu isudorie kuna baa ilang'eni o looata eyiolounoto niboloki inkera naanana, amu ina eyieunoto e mpiris ino.

English: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

English: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

English: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

English: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it.
Masaai: Neyiolou ilkeek pooki liong'ota aajo nanu Olaitoriani oitadoyio lelo keek adoru, naitubulu aitoodor lelo keek dorropu, naitoi lelo keek oonyori, naitonyorij lelo keek ootoito. nanu Olaitoriani oiroro naa kaas ina.

English: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

English: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak o lfarisayo isunkuro! amu intayuyu ematua e tomon oe nkorropil o sinantei o empeu naitorropil endaa, nitapalaitie mbaa kituaak oo nkitanapat, aa isipat e nkiguana, o lng'ur o enkirukoto; kuna eishiaakino nitaasa nimipalipala nena kulie.

English: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

English: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

English: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
Masaai: Ore ilo orika lino le nkitoo, Enkai, nebikoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Ore ina ng'udi ino e nkitoria naa eng'udi oo sipat;

English: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
Masaai: Ti niyiololo kuna baa, imayianana ti niaasiasa.

English: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

English: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.
Masaai: “Teninturrur enkurma ino aisampu, nikirikino ilkuti ng'osil loo lukuny tiatua enkurma mirrinyo alo ayau; nchoo eaku oleilo tung'ani omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai; pee kitum Olaitoriani Enkai ino atamayiana te siaai pooki oo nkaik inono.

English: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

English: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.

English: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

English: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani eidipa Nebusaradan olkitok le rripore aishoo ninye meshomo aing'uaa Rama, ina kata apa pee eya ninye eena too lpisia tenebo lelo pooki apa le Yerusalem o Yuda ootarayioki meshomo Babilon.

English: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
Masaai: netabolokoki taata, ore tiatua ilkigerot le naibon, neitayioloki iloreren, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Nkai oo ntarasi pee eyau e nkanyit e nkirukoto

English: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani le kopikop etagore oleng keipang'u alotu aarare ilo aiguanani le moikuape; naa kedumu ninye olorora kitok, kake keishoori ilo orora aapik atua enkaina o lmang'atinta lenye.

English: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, aatoomono nanu, tapalakaki eng'oki ai, nirrinyo te nebo nanu, pee atum nanu ateserema Olaitoriani.”

English: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?
Masaai: Kake kaa tiatua nkaitin pooki e lelo oshon apa ooidaikie papa lai tukul naidima atokordu iltung'ana lenyena te nkaina ai, eji metaa keidim Enkai inyi atokordu intae te nkaina ai?

English: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
Masaai: Tinishukokino ilo Magilani nintobor kewan, tiniwuang'ie ntorrok pooki aitalam olng'obor lino,

English: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
Masaai: Na kera kutiti, emincho elej intae oltung'ani. Ore ilo oas esidai naa olasipani, anaa paa asipani ninye.

English: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika. Eton ake epolosisho iltung'ana nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika. Etesheta apa ninye kishomi e shumata e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
Masaai: Amu inji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani, “Ore te rishata olari obo, te risioroto oo larin le nkigeroto, ore ina kitoo pooki e Kedar naa keiting;

English: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
Masaai: Amaa tenegira, aing'ae oidim aiguanare? Amaa teneisudoo enkomom enye, aing'ae oidim atoduaa ninye, aa olorere anaa tung'ani?

English: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
Masaai: Ore to lari le dukuya le Darias olayioni le Ahaseuro, laa ore te inoto naa Olmedei, ilo otaa olaiguanani le nkitoria oo Lkaldayo

English: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
Masaai: Indung'eta e rashe kuna e Solomon, olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani le Israel.

English: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
Masaai: Nchoo irorei le nkutuk ai, o nkibirribirrat o ltau lai, eng'amaroyu too nkonyek inono, iyie Olaitoriani, endapidapoi ai, naa olakordunoni lai.

English: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam ookuni le nkitoria e Yoash olayioni le Ahasia, olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Yehoahas olayioni le Yehu aitoreisho te Israel o te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oopishana.

English: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
Masaai: Nejo apa Kaleb, “Ore Oltung'ani oar Kiriat-seper, neya ninye, naisho nanu ninye Aksa entito ai meyama.”

English: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
Masaai: Ore pooki naiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani ti atua Siraeli naa keaku eninyi.

English: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
Masaai: Ore kitii Mileto, neirriwaa Paulo olkilikuai Efeso, aipot ilpayiani le ina sirit.

English: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
Masaai: Ore oloata ina Kerai neeta enkishui; ore olemeeta ina Kerai e Nkai nemeeta enkishui.

English: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
Masaai: “Ore nanu Artaseses olaiguanani, naitobira enkitanapata too lashumak pooki lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju. Ore pooki nayieu Esra, ilo apolosani, aigeroni loo nkitanapat e Nkai e keper, nchoo easi aakurraki,

English: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oare le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neitaae Ahasia olayioni le Yoram olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru aitoreisho.

English: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
Masaai: Kake etupukuo ake neiteru ainosaa, aibalie ilo omoni, neaku eitu eitoki Yesu aidim atijing'a enkang eduaakini, neaku ti ong'ata eton; nepuonu ltung'ana aayiaya eing'uaa nkaloli pooki.

English: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?
Masaai: Kake etagorokinote ilkituaak le njore oo lfilisti ninye; nejoki ninye ilkituaak le njore oo lfilisti, “Tushuko ele tung'ani, pee etum atorrinyoyu ashomo ewueji apa nitiaaka ninye; medoyio ninye alo te nebo iyiook olarrabal, meaku ake to larrabal olmang'atinta te iyiook. amu kaji eiko ele tung'ani te neitayu osotua o lkitok lenye. Aime too lukuny e kulo tung'ana tene?

English: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
Masaai: Nengoroo inkariak o metabaiki olapa le tomon. Ore peyie ebau enkiting'oto o lapa le tomon, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelioyu inchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
Masaai: Iyie nanu aipoto Olaitoriani; endapidapoi ai, mikigirare nanu, amu ti nikigirare iyie nanu natiu anaa lelo oopuo aadoiki Engumoto.

English: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore lelo ooitukuo neitisiny ate pee etum aashom atua enkurma esujaa ilo otii empolos enye, neinos nkiri oo lbitiro, neinos olming, neinos ilkirrumun, kelotu enkiting'oto enye nabo kata, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
Masaai: Oo te naa Enkai nayieu, ejo pee etumoki aitoduaai engoro enye neyiolouni sii engolon enye, netang'asa ang'iriaki oleng lelo oora ile ngoro laa enkitarruorroto ake eitobirakaki,

English: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
Masaai: Nejur olapolosani ine neiwotiote, neibalunye ninye ajo keiduruk, ore ewueji neiwotiote to sesen naa keiduruk; amu enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani, esisa enkarna enye; entolimu enjeunoto enye nkolong'i pooki.

English: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
Masaai: Neinyototo nedumu enkerai o ng'otonye arik kewarie Misiri;

English: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
Masaai: o Mika olayioni lenye, o Reaia olayioni lenye, o Baal olayioni lenye,

English: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
Masaai: “Kaing'ae liking'urrie iyie oo Yerusalem, arashu kaing'ae likinchiraki iyie? Kaing'ae oibelekenya aikilikuanu olmabarishoi lino?

English: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
Masaai: Teneibooyo inkariak, netoyu pooki; teneirriwaa aipang'ie, nenum enkop.

English: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
Masaai: niking'uaa Frigia o Pamfiliam niking'uaa Misiri o lkirinen le Libya o Kirene, neing'uaa kulikae lang Roma,

English: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
Masaai: Ore kuna najoito taata naitieu atawuasare, neme nkirorot oo Lkiristiano, emodai nabaraki.

English: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
Masaai: Amu meyiolo oltung'ani enkata enye. Anaa isinkir ooibung'aki to rreshet torrono, anaa imotonyi naaibung'aki tiatua orreshet neija etiu nkera oo ltung'ana eibung'i to rreshet te nkata torrono, ina kata napulusokino adoiki ninche.

English: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
Masaai: Amu mikiindim ake iyiook aatapal mikilimu inikitoduaa o nikitoning'o.”

English: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
Masaai: Nejo Abimelek, “Ainyoo ena nintaasa iyiook? Eidim obo loo ltung'ana ashomo enetii enkitok ino, nipik iyiook entaboi te sunkureisho.”

English: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika. Ore ake eyia, keitoriori apa oltau le Asa tialo Olaitoriani katukul, nkolong'i pooki enkishiu enye.

English: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
Masaai: Naa ninye olo aaku enkitashoto too nkatitin inyi, neaku kitok enjeunoto, o eng'eno o eyiolounoto; naa euriata o Laitoriani ninye olchumati lenye.

English: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
Masaai: ina natubukoko ninye iyiook te nkiputakinoto ti atua Yesu Kristo Olaitajeunoni lang,

English: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee midamu iyiook ntarasi, kainyoo iyie pee inturraa iyiook te nkata naado?

English: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
Masaai: eeta enkarsisisho oo mpukunot pooki. Eikodoki entito o laiguanani to lgilata lenye te nkaji e nkitoo, too ilkilani lenyena ooripuno too usin e sahabu;

English: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
Masaai: Te naa koloirirua kiaata iyiook naa enkaraki Enkai naa tenelulung'a iyiook ilukuny naa enkaraki intae.

English: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
Masaai: “Empang'a enchom te mpolos enye, lo tung'ana laainei! Nchoo pooki tung'ani eitajeu enkishui enye teina goro napi o Laitoriani!

English: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Isaya, “Shomo tanang'are Ahas, iyie o Shearyashub olayioni lino, amu inang'arere ninye, te nkiting'oto o lkiperrata le nkare o lchorro le shumata, te wueji oo laitobirak loonkilani,

English: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani lo lorok neinyeyie olarrabal, kake ore ilo oisilig Olaitoriani naa keitaae karsis.

English: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Sekaria olayioni le Meshelemia apa olaing'urani le kishomi eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
Masaai: Neishakenoki Yohana ejo, “Atoduaa Enkiyang'et edou anaa enturkulu eing'uaa shumata netonie shumata ninye.

English: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
Masaai: Itusuja iyie ina oitoi enkanashe ino; metaa kapik enkikompe enye enkaina ino.

English: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee anyokita; nanyamaliki te ngolon pooki e nkidimata e ilo oisiaaisho ti atua nanu.

English: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
Masaai: “Kaipot iltung'ana laainei aiturrurr tenebo, amu atokordua nanu ninche, naa keaku ninche kumok anaa apa te moitie.

English: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisiaai Kristo aiko neijia neng'amunoyu te Nkai nenyorrarri sii too ltung'ana.

English: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
Masaai: Neitoki ake anutayu, neiu enkayioni, nejo, “Enkaraki natoningo Olaitoriani ajo kaaibai naaisho ena ayioni aigil.” Neipot enkarna enye ajo Simon.

English: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
Masaai: Meigili ae kata aamany ninye aashu aatoni ti atua ninye too ishoritin pooki; meetae Olmarabui oigil aun olng'obor lenye te ine; nemeetae ilairritak loo ntare ooigil aairragie nkerrai enye te ine.

English: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
Masaai: Kake eitamio Olaitoriani Farao o enkaji enye to lmeitai kitok te nkaraki Sarai enkitok e Abram.

English: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tikitam oobo, nedoiki Hatir, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
Masaai: Nedung ninye iltarakua; anaa egelu ilkulikae keek, neisho ninche metubulu ti atua ilkeek le ntim, neun ninye iltarakua neitubulu enchan.

English: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
Masaai: Neitobiru ninye engumoto aturu, nedoiki atua ina gumoto natuturuo.

English: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
Masaai: “Naa teneaku olalashe lino aisinani, neaku meidim ataretu kewan tenebo iyie, tareto iyie ninye, anaa olomoni anaa olamutanani likiewuo ashulare.

English: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
Masaai: “Teneitayu oltung'ani enkaji enye metaa sinyati to Laitoriani, nelo olapolosani atem tenaa aisidai aashu torrono; ore anaa enatem olapolosani naa neijia etiu enkinyiang'a.

English: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD'S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oidim aitayu enkishoroto e nkosholai arashu osuyai neyau anaa enkishoroto o Laitoriani; ore pooki tung'ani oinepuni eeta enchata o lerai naata tipat te siaai, neyau ninye.

English: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
Masaai: “Tenintarasaa olasar loo nkishorot e seriani aaisho Olaitoriani, entarasai intae pee etumi aatang'amai intae.

English: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
Masaai: Nesesekuan Israel ninye te nepi o lalem, neya enkop enye ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok, o meshomo abaiki ile Amori; amu Yaser apa olpolosie loo le Amori.

English: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki ninkilikuanunu te nkomono te nkirukoto nitumutumu.”

English: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
Masaai: Eetae apa enkolong natotona ilayiok le Yoab o ntoyie enyena aadaa neok enaisho oo lsabibu te nkaji olalashe lenye botor;

English: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
Masaai: Ore peyie eraposhu Esau nkonyek enyena, etodua inkituaak o nkera, nejo ninye, “Kakua kuna nikiboitare?” Nejo Yakobo, “Inkera naaishoo Enkai to lng'ur osinka lino.”

English: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
Masaai: Neisho ilo kitok loo sikarini olbarnoti elo neitirrishaki ajo, “Nimiliki ake likae tung'ani ajo kitolikio ena bae.”

English: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
Masaai: Ruben ilo kikau le Israel; ilayiok le Ruben, ile Hanok, ilo marei loo le Hanok; le Palu, olmarei loo le Palu;

English: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
Masaai: o Hanania, o Elam, o Antotija,

English: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
Masaai: Ore taata kulo ilomon le nkiting'oto le Daudi: Enkitanapata e Daudi, olayioni le Yese, enkitanapata e ilo tung'ani oilepieki aaya shumata, ilo obukokino eilata te Nkai e Yakobo, ilo oranyu isinkolioitin oomelok le Israel:

English: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo aisiaaiyia papaai linyi te ngolon ai pooki;

English: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
Masaai: Pee meaku ake, ore eidipa aitamanyu nelaikino aidipa, nesukeny pooki ng'ae odol,

English: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
Masaai: neishop Aron o layiok lenyena te nepuonu aanyikaki olperere lo lasar aaisiaisho te wueji sinyati, meyaki ake ate entorroni meye. Naa keaku ena enkitanapata nauno te ninye o too ishoritin enyena te siadi ninye.

English: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
Masaai: Neitoki arik o metabaiki Betania, neilepie nkaik enyena nemayian.

English: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e ong'uan naa iloing'ok tomon, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,

English: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
Masaai: Neikilikuan aajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kanu eaku kuna baa, naa ainyoo olmonekie outu ajo etaa ebau?”

English: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
Masaai: nemeetae obo lenye oleku. Amu kayau nanu entorroni shumata iltung'ana le Anatot, teilo ari le nkitamioto enye.”

English: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
Masaai: olayioni le Mahali, olayioni le Mushi, olayioni le Merari, olayioni le Lawi;

English: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Koree ninye?” Nejoki Siba olaiguanani, “Etii atua enkaji e Makir olayioni le Amiel te Lo-debar.”

English: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
Masaai: “Kake tenimikining'ining'i intae nanu, nimiasiasa kuna kitanapat pooki.

English: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
Masaai: Te na bae eitodolu Enkiyang'et Sinyati inchere eton mebolo enkoitoi najing'ieki ine wueji sinyati eton ake eitashe ilo ng'obor lioriong,

English: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
Masaai: Neen ninye nerik aaitarasaki olbalusui oji Pilato.

English: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
Masaai: niyiololo aajo ore te sujata oo lkerreti lang nanu oisul to lporror lang aitirrish nkoon oo loo papa.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ore olong'amu pooki ng'ae lairriwaa, nanu eng'amu, ore olaang'amu naa ilo laairriwua eng'amu.”

English: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.
Masaai: Ore eishoi enye naa kepuo aayiolou ti atua loshon, neyiolouni nkera enye ti atua iloreren; ore pooki oodol ninche neyiolou ninche. nchere olorere ele otamayiana Olaitoriani.

English: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooiteng'enuo too nkonyek enye maate, lelo ooitaa ate kalamasi!

English: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, eponari esiana oo looiteng'eni abul nejing olong'unyung'unyi erishata oo Lyahudi ooiro enkutuk oo Lgiriki o Lyahudi ooikini enkop enye. Ejo lelo loo Lgiriki eji eitololoikiaki inkolia enye te ndaa naorikini anaa ake.

English: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Yesu le Nasaret.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ara ninye.” Ore sii Yudas ilo otakaldayie ninye neitashe te nebo ninche.

English: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
Masaai: Ore te nilotu iyie nishoru olkila apa latung'ueikia Karpo te Troas o mbukui sii neisulaki nena oo ndapan.

English: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
Masaai: Nimiaasiasa esiaai teina olong; amu enkolong o lning'o lo sotua, pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies, and the LORD thy God hath delivered them into thine hands, and thou hast taken them captive,
Masaai: “Tenilo iyie olarrabal aarare ilmang'ati linono, neishoru Olaitoriani Enkai ino ninche apik nkaik inono, nimbung iyie ninche araya,

English: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
Masaai: Neitanap Musa iltung'ana le Israel ejo, “Ena kop intae ipuopuo aajung te oshoto e nkukuo, naa ninye eitanapishe Olaitoriani pee eisho iloshon ooudo o lpisiai lo losho;

English: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
Masaai: Einyal ninche enkoitoi ai, neitubulaa ninche engolikinoto ai, metii hoo obo omitiki ninche.

English: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
Masaai: Naa teneisudoo iltung'ana leina kop ilo tung'ani ina kata eishooyo nabo oo nkera enyena aisho Molek, neany ear ninye metua,

English: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ina, nejoki ninche, “Ainyoo pee ijokinono eji miatata mukateni? Keton ake mejing'aa intae naa aimining'ung'u? Kaji etiu pee egol intae ilukuny?

English: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
Masaai: Ore apa ina olong neilepie Olaitoriani Yoshua too nkonyek e Israel pooki; neyanyitu ninche ninye anaa apa enayanyit Musa, nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.

English: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltimito le njore Edom; neaku lelo pooki le Edom isinkan le Daudi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi enkisulata te pooki wueji neshomo.

English: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
Masaai: “Naa keaku ena enkitanapata te intae ntarasi nchere ore to lapa liopishana, te nkolong e tomon o lapa nieniene ate aapukoo, nimiasiasa esiaai, aa oinoti aashu oldokunoti oewuo aton tiatua intae;

English: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
Masaai: Kake te naa ai to lkimojino le Nkai aaraa loiriruani, enkitoria e Nkai naewuo atua ntae.

English: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa kulo rorei iltung'ana pooki le Israel neishir iltung'ana eisinanuo oleng.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Mintanyamal iltung'ana le Moab aashu intayunye ninche olarrabal, amu maisho nanu intae erubata ninye nabo enkop enye metaa eninyi, amu aishoo nanu Ari ilayiok le Lutu meitaa enenye.’

English: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
Masaai: Wootu enetii ninye, osoit otanyaita iltung'ana, kake etegeluaki, neeta tipat too nkonyek e Enkai.

English: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
Masaai: Kake ore ejo Paulo abol enkutuk, nejoki Galio Lyahudi, “Te nesipa naaji ajo kembae e ntorroni aashu ene karrueisho, lo Yahudi, naa anaata iatata esipata nang'iri ainining intae.

English: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
Masaai: “Katitin uni to lari kintobiraki nanu osirua.

English: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
Masaai: Pesho osiligi le mbarta o larrabal te nkisulata, ore te ngolon enye kitok nemeitajeusho.

English: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eikilikuan olaiguanani ina kitok, neliki ninye. Negelu olaiguanani oltung'ani kitok tenkaraki ina kitok, ejo, “Torrinyoki ninye entoki pooki nara enenye, tenebo endaa pooki naing'uaa enkurma enye, ebaiki enkolong apa nashomo tena kop o metabaiki taata.”

English: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
Masaai: Te nemegiroo osiligi lang likisilig Kristo ena kishui nikiaata taata, nemeetae naa too ltung'ana pooki iltoluti oolang iyiook.

English: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie eserem enkop pooki; nikiranyaki iyie isinkolioitin le nkisisa, nerany enkisisa te nkaraki enkarna ino.”

English: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
Masaai: Neipang'u iltung'ana le nkanasa aapuonu aarare Yoab, ore embata oo ltung'ana le Daudi ti atua iltung'ana neurori. Ore Uria ilo Hiti nesesekuani sii ninye.

English: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
Masaai: Naa karany enkisisa e nkarna ino anaake.

English: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
Masaai: Metaa kenya iloomenye ilayiok lenye tiatua intae, nenya ilayiok iloomenye, naa kadung'oki intae enkiguana, ore pooki ng'ae linyi oleku naidapashaki inkaloli pooki enkijape.

English: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
Masaai: Ore ninye eitu iyie iyau iyiook ina kop naruko kule o naishi, neitu incho iyiook enjung'ore e nkop o nkurman oo lng'anayio. Ikurtu iyie nkonyek e kulo tung'ana? Mikipuonu iyiook.”

English: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
Masaai: Neitadedeyie ina naairoro iloibonok le Nkai anaa enatisiraki nchere,

English: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
Masaai: Ore nkirorot o ndamunot oo lmang'ati laainei, naa nanu egilunore endama pooki.

English: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
Masaai: “Ko rrindik Israel? Kosinka oino liang? Kainyoo naa pee etaa ninye olorreshitoi?

English: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
Masaai: “Ore laisiaayiak pooki lo laiguanani o ltung'ana loo lkerenketi pooki lo laiguanani neyiolo aajo te nelo olee arashu enkitok ajing'aki olaiguanani ti atua ine netonie eitu eipoti, naa enkitanapata nabo ake natii, ore pooki te risioroto naa keari metuata meteleku ilo oitorioki olaiguanani eng'udi enye e sahabu pee epok. Naa eitu nanu aaipoti maeu atua enetii olaiguanani kuna olong'i tomoni uni.”

English: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu ninche entoki naitureisho too nkitoriat pooki enkop tenkaraki ina nataasa Manase olayioni le Hesekia, olaiguanani le Yuda tiatua Yerusalem.

English: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki osinka lino Daudi mimbelekeny enkomom e ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput.

English: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
Masaai: Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo oitashe te dukuya iyie, ninye olo ajing; ntagolo ninye oshoke, amu ninye olo aidimie Israel metujung'o ina kop.

English: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
Masaai: Neeta nena pooki enagut nalimu ninche, ore nena kituaak pokira are naa sotuaitin pokira aare eutu. Oldoinyo le Sinai eimua obo, are nkera naaiu naa nkera e sinkaisho eiting'oki; naa Hagar eimaka ina.

English: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki Seba o Salmuna, “Koree apa iltung'ana litasesekuana te Tabor?” Newal ninche, “Anaa eninkununo iyie, neijia apa eikununo ninche, oltung'ani ake te ninche; kenyaanyukie apa ninche ilayiok lo laiguanani.”

English: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
Masaai: Eeta enkolong enkishiaa enye neeta olapa enenye; keeta doi ninye olakira obo enkishiaa e wang'an nalang eno likae.

English: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eeta oltau lai osina kitok o metaa kaye; entotoni te ne enchololoto te nebo nanu.”

English: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
Masaai: Eii esekenkei aitipij esekenkei, neitipij oltung'ani o likae tung'ani.

English: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
Masaai: Ore lelo ng'anayio oong'as ooku te pooki natii atua ina kop, ooyaki ninche Olaitoriani, naa keaku ilkulinyi; ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta entioto otii atua enkaji ino neidim ainosa.

English: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
Masaai: Sidai emunyan; kake amaa te nelau emunyan enkisukut enye, kaji eikoni pee eitokini aaisukutie? Enoto emunyan ti atua ate, nitonini te seriani intae maate.”

English: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
Masaai: “Ore karsisisho ino o lchumati lino naa kaisho metarari, metii enkinyang'a, tenkaraki ing'ok inono pooki, tiatua enkop ino pooki.

English: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Daudi amir Hadadesa olayioni le Rehob, olaiguanani le Soba, eloito arrinyu enkitoo enye to lkeju le Frati.

English: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
Masaai: Neliki Samuel iltung'ana enkitoo nairirikino olaiguanani isiaaitin enyena; neiger ti atua embuku neirragie te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neisho Samuel iltung'ana pooki meshomo, oltung'ani ake nelo enkang enye.

English: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
Masaai: Naa ore te neinok Aron iltaai teipa nepej, enkorropil oo nkolong'i pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip ninche aatulusoi, neilepu lelo tung'ana te nchorro, nepuo aaliki Olaiguanani Daudi. Nejoki ninche Daudi, “Tudumunye, nilo asiooyo alang enkare; amu nji o nji eikoo Ahitofel te iyie.”

English: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
Masaai: Eitu ninye ining'ining'i neitu irugugu nkiyiaa inyi aaning, hoo neirriwaka intae Olaitoriani akurraki sinkan lenyena iloibonok,

English: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
Masaai: Ore te kuna nenyorraa olaiguanani Ilyahudi ootii nkanas pooki meiturrurroto pee emitu ate, nemut near metuata, neidaikie pooki jore e pooki tung'ani o pooki osho oidim atarasaki ninche, o nkera enye o nkituaak, neya masaa enye,

English: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, ‘Ekaadung'oki naa enkiguana te nkiroroto ino makewan, lo sinka torrono! Iyiolo apa ajo kara oltung'ani ogol pukunoto, odumu ineitu airragie, nasotu ineitu aun?

English: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
Masaai: “Te near olkiteng le likae tung'ani olkiteng le likae metua nemir ninche ilo kiteng oishu neor impisai enyena. Neor sii ina ng'ues natua.

English: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: “Mme pooki tung'ani laajo ‘Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani,’ ojing enkitoria e Nkai, kake ilo oas enayieu Papa lai otii shumata.

English: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
Masaai: Ore enkitamioto e ng'oki ino, na tito e Sion neitabayioki, meekure ninye kingil aibok te eyararoto ae kata, kake ore eng'oki ino naa tito e Edom, ninye eitamei, kebolu ninye ing'ok inono.

English: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Daudi Rekab o Baana olalashe lenye, lelo ayiok le Rimon ilo le Be-erot ajoki, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, otokordua enkishui ai aitayu ti atua embatisho pooki,

English: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata neiteng'el Olaitoriani olosho le Lawi pee enap ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua le Nkai, neitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani aaisiaai ninye nemayianisho te nkarna enye o taata.

English: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
Masaai: Nerrinyo ninye alo enetii ninye, naa ng'ura, eitashe ninye te nebo ilkituaak pooki le Moab te mbata e ilo asar lenye opejori.

English: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
Masaai: amu imiet ilpayiani likiwaita, neme olino olikiaata taata. Ore tena iroro esipata.”

English: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
Masaai: Amu to rorei lino kinkenakini isupati, naa to rorei lino kinkenakini ntorrok.”

English: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
Masaai: Nepuku sii enchankar ti atua ninche eji kalo lenye oaku olkitok aisul te ninche.

English: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
Masaai: “Eitu nanu airriwaa iloibonok, kake ekueta ninche, eitu nanu airorie ninche, kake eibonishote ninche.

English: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
Masaai: Ore ewang'an naa kemisimis to lng'obor lenye, ore oltaa otii shumata enye neari.

English: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
Masaai: Ore iasat enyena pooki o engolon o enkidimata, o lomon pooki le nkitoo e Mordekai, naishoo olaiguanani ninye, aimeigero kuna te mbuku oo nkoon oo laiguanak le Media o Parsia?

English: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
Masaai: Amu ore iyie, Olaitoriani, itii shumata aisul te nkop pooki; nikilepieki aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.

English: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
Masaai: “Te neisho oltung'ani ole latia enye impisai arashu ntokitin metushuma, nepurrorri te nkaji enye, ore te netumi olapurroni, nelak ninye katitin are.

English: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?
Masaai: Naa tenijo iyie to ltau lino, ‘Kaji iyiook kinko pee kiyiolou ororei leitu eiro Olaitoriani?’

English: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
Masaai: Amu inkiyang'eta oo loiriruani ninche naas inkitoduaat, nepuaya enetii ilaiguanak le nkop pooki pee eiturrurru ninche te njore ena olong kitok e Enkai Magilani.

English: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
Masaai: Neaku eewa Hanan isinkan le Daudi, nebarn ake enchoto o lmunyei lo ltung'ani nedung nkilani enye too mpolosi enye neisho ninche meshomo.

English: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
Masaai: Ore naa, enkaraki ina, naikenakini taata iyiook isipat to sarge lenye, neisul naa eyooki ninye aitajeu iyiook te ngoro e Nkai.

English: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu tenaitaas ninche esidai, naa kaun nanu ninche tiatua ena kop naitubulu to ltau lai pooki o te nkishui ai pooki.

English: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
Masaai: “Tadamu Abraham, o Isaak, o Isirael, isinkan linono, laa te ninche inosa olmumai te kewan ino, nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Kaponaa nanu eishoi ino anaa ilakir le shumata; ore ena kop pooki natonyorra aishoru, naa kaisho nanu eishoi ino nejung ninche ntarasi.’ ”

English: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
Masaai: Tadamu Olaitoriani eneba entemata e nkishui, ae te nyoo iyie intobira nkera pooki e tung'ana!

English: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
Masaai: neitobir tenebo ilkituaak lenyena o ltung'ana lenyena magil, pee eibooyo enkare e nena shorroi naatii auluo enkanasa. Neret ninche ninye.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ekaairriwaa iyie airriwaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ilo orere ogolong'u; laatogolong'akita nanu; ore ninche o loo menye netaasa eng'oki te nanu o ena olong.

English: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oisikong oltorrono naa ketum enchipai, naa kelotu emayianata sidai shumata ninye.

English: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
Masaai: atolimuo apa nanu aibalunye te musano, ore eton eitu ebaya, naaitoning'o iyie aibalakinye, pee milo ake ajo, ‘Enkitanyaanyukoto ai nataasa kuna, ina kitanyaanyukoto ai naguetuni, o ina naipurjuno nayaua kuna.’

English: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
Masaai: “Entiaki entito e Sion, ng'ura, elotu enitii iyie olaiguanani lino, nebor nekedito esikiria, akedito olkurrarru le sikiria.”

English: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
Masaai: Amu te ina eipotoki intae, amu eisilisiloki sii ninye Kristo te nkaraki intae, neing'ueki intae enkitanyaanyukoto, pee isujusuju iroruat enyena.

English: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Idung'okiki ate metaa enjung'ore te ntae o tenebo ilomon oomanya atua intae netoiutuo nkera tiatua intae. Keaku ninche te intae olayioni oino loo layiok le Israel; ore tenebo intae naa keishori enjung'ore tiatua iloshon le Israel.

English: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

English: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
Masaai: Ekaitaa oldoinyo le Seir olemetii toki, naitaa mitil; naa kadung'oo te ninye lelo pooki oopuonu atua aaparan nepuo.

English: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo apa ooikenaki too lmareita loo layiok le Merari, ooikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore ake peyie eitalioo inkiyiaa pokira naapishana, neitoki kulie kiyiaa naapishana aaliooyu naa sasin naaitoiyito enkijape naing'uaa enkalo oloosaen.

English: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
Masaai: Ore oltiren le nkaji nemur te sahabu tiatua o tioriong.

English: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninye, “Olkitok, iyiolo iyie.” Naaitoki aajoki, “Kulo ninche lelo ooiturukutuo aaing'uaa ilo sina kitok neitukuo ilkilani lenye neiborrie to sarge lo Lkuoo le Ker.”

English: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
Masaai: Keitaa ninche iyarunot e karsisisho inyi imasaa enye; anaa eng'ues entim imasaa inyi e biashara naa kesulaa ninche isunta inyi neinyal inkajijik inyi sidain; ore isoito linyi o mbaoi o enterit naa kenang'akini empolos oo nkariak.

English: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
Masaai: Ore amu meekure adolisho te nkaraki ina wang'an, naariki aaibung enkaina lelo ootii te nebo nanu, o maetu Dameski.

English: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
Masaai: Neidapash intae Olaitoriani tiatua iloreren pooki ebaiki eluboto nabo enkop ometabaiki enkae. Ore teine nilo aisiaai kulie aitin, oo nkeek o noo soito apa neitu aekata iyiolou neitu eyiolou loo papaai linyi.

English: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.
Masaai: kake eshomo apa, Daudi ailoiki enetii, o Betlehem alo airrita ntare e menye.

English: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
Masaai: oilepa alo shumata, neton te nkaina e tatene e Enkai, netipikaki te nebo ilmalaika, o enkitoria e ngolon meetu abori ninye.

English: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
Masaai: Nejoki Farao ninye, “Shomo tung'uayioki, toduaa kewan miking'il ae kata adol enkomom ai; amu ore akenya enkolong nidol enkomom ai niye.”

English: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
Masaai: “Itoning'o iyie imorot enye, Olaitoriani nena kitobirat enye pooki te nkaraki nanu.

English: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
Masaai: o Hadid, o Seboim, o Nebalot,

English: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
Masaai: Neidapashakino iltung'ana enkop pooki e Misiri aasotu suut aaitaa olkujita.

English: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
Masaai: neitoki alotu enkiting'oto, ina kata elotu aitarasaki Enkai Papa enkitoria, eidipa ninye aishie nkitoriat pooki, o nkidimat pooki o engolon.

English: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
Masaai: o Maluk, o Harim o Baana.

English: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
Masaai: ‘Tenaa napaji ninye kaaisho Balak enkaji enye ebore enkosholai o sahabu, nemaidim ake ashomo atapaasha ororei lo Laitoriani, aas esidai aashu entorrono te yieunoto ai makewan, ore ina najo Olaitoriani naa ina nanu airo?’

English: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu nkoitoi enyena, kake kaishiunye nanu ninye; karikoo nanu ninye naitagol ninye, naitigir lelo ooishir.

English: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: nepolos ninye ina motonyi too naipuko enyena kake meor aitaa are. Nepejoo olapolosani te nchumata olperere lo lasar, te nchumata e lelo keek ootii enkima; olasar opejori ninye, olasar le nkima esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
Masaai: neitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ina aji e Enkai, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki olng'obor le ntumo o te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, neitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ilapolosak o te nkaraki iltung'ana pooki leina umata.

English: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
Masaai: Naa kalo likae osho kitok oata nkikoot o nkiguanat naasipa anaa ena kitanapata nairragie nanu te dukuya intae ena olong?

English: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake ore etiu neijia enkoitoi ai ake asuj taata o taaisere o idia olong; amu meidimayu metaa kenang oloiboni le Nkai dikae neme Yerusalem.’

English: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, negiroo alo ailepaki Yerusalem.

English: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
Masaai: o Sanoa, o Adulam nkang'itie enyena, o Lakish o nkong'at enyena, a Aseka o nkong'at enyena. Neaku etipika apa ninche ilng'oborri ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki oerata le Hinom.

English: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
Masaai: Neipang Haman ina olong alo eng'ida neshipa to ltau. Kake ore ake pee edol Haman Mordekai te nkishomi o laiguanani, nchere eitu eitashe neitu eikirikira te dukuya ninye neiput engoro te nkaraki Mordekai.

English: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Ore pee eaku Musa oloo larin artam nejo kelo abaiki ilalashera lenyena.

English: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu Isamaria enetii Yesu, nesai metotona te nebo ninche, nebik inkolong'i are te ine.

English: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
Masaai: Ore enkop e Manase nelo abaiki Asheri o metabaiki Mikmetat apa naa enkalo o loo saen le Shekem; nelo olpolosie enkalo e moikuape o metabaiki lelo oomanya Entapua.

English: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak loo Lfilisti nepuo te maa iip o too nkalifuni, ore Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena nepuo ninche te siadi te nebo Akish,

English: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
Masaai: “Toriku olosho le Lawi ntinyiku, nipik ninche dukuya Aron ilo apolosani, pee etum ninche aaisiaayia ninye.

English: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
Masaai: Nelotu Olaitoriani te nkatampoi airorie ninye, neya embata e ina kiyang'et natii shumata ninye nepik shumata lelo payiani ntomoni naapishana; ore pee eirrag ina kiyang'et te shumata ninche, neibonisho ninche. Kake eitu eitoki aaiko neijia.

English: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie endapash enye nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Eyieu kulo tung'ana lena kata torrok oololoito olmonekie nemeishori, pooki o lmonekie oishori naa olo loiboni le Nkai oji Yona.

English: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa ina kop mitil naidaayie, ore ina golon enye nawuasare nebaiki enkiting'oto; ore lelo doinyo le Israel neaku mitili oleng metaa meetae hoo oloim empolos enye.

English: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
Masaai: Ore ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ngoki o ina kine o lasar le ngoki apa ooyawuaki o sargeta lenye pee eitainyeki olning'o lo sotua tiatua ine wueji sinyati, nenapi aaitupuku aayau auluo ilng'oborri; ore endapana olchoni o nkiri enye o moyok enye nepejori te nkima.

English: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
Masaai: Amu lelo ooitashe too sipat oomany ena kop, ore iltung'ana oobor naa kebikoo tiatua,

English: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
Masaai: Ore tiabori intokitin uni eikirikira enkop; ore tiabori ong'uan nemeidim ating'iria:

English: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
Masaai: Kake enchololoto intae inkatitin pooki, niomonunu meishori intae engolon nipaashieshie nena naapuonu, pee intasheshe te dukuya Enkerai e Tung'ani.”

English: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Etapejoyie sii apa iloik le lelo apolosak too nchumat e lelo pereren lenye, neituku Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
Masaai: Metaa kaitame te ngoro napi; meitoki enkong'u ai aleku, nemaitoki aata nanu olng'ur; ore hoo neishir too nkiyiaa aainei to ltoilo sapuk, mainining'u ninche.”

English: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
Masaai: Enaikash tininang'are olng'arurumi otooruoki inkiyoitin enyena, alang tininang'are olmodai oreuta emodai enye.

English: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani naa Elimelek, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Naomi. Ore nkarn oo layiok lenyena pokira oare naa Mahalon o Kilion. Ile Frati apa ninche ooing'uaa Betlehem ti atua enkop e Yuda. Eshomo apa ninche enkop e Moab nepuo aabik te ine.

English: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
Masaai: “Kaa retoto eeta keeya ai, te nadoyio ajing Engumoto? Eikisis iyie enterit? Kelimu ninye esupatisho ino?

English: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, ‘Amu eitu kitum oltung'ani oishoo iyiook esiaai.’ Nejoki, ‘Enchom sii intae enkurma oo sabibu.’

English: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
Masaai: Mijeu iyie te nkaina enye, kake meeta nchere mikimbung'i nikiyauni aapik atua enkaina enye; ingurara intae too nkonyek o le Babilon nirorie ninye inchororo nkomomi, naa ilo iyie Babilon.’

English: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
Masaai: Kake ore eitu ebau ine eng'asi ake aainyal too nkumok neany iltung'ana le na kata.

English: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
Masaai: Naa entito sidai oleng tiong'u, eselenkei neitu aikata eyiolou olee, nedoiki enchorro, neigany emoti enye, neilepu.

English: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
Masaai: te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa, to lapa le ile.

English: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
Masaai: Amu ore enamuke ake pooki e ilo otii enjore naa kemut enkima, ore pooki kila oata oltipoti lo sarge naa kepejori anaa ilkeek le nkima.

English: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
Masaai: Nerik nabo kata lelo alashera Paulo meshomo o meitabaiki enaiposha: neng'as ninche Silas o Timoteo aabik te ine.

English: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
Masaai: neyau ninche Uria aaitung'uaa Misiri neyaki ninye olaiguanani Yehoiakim, laa ninye otaara ninye to lalem nenang'aki empopok enye atua ewueji e nkurare oo ltung'ana pooki.

English: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
Masaai: Eigorokino iyie iyiook ntarasi? Eintoodor iyie engoro ino aitabaiki iishoritin pooki?

English: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
Masaai: Eidip oloiteng'eni te netiu anaa oloiteng'en ninye, netiu osinka anaa oloitore ninye. Asa taa etejo olopeny enkaji Beelsebul, kebaa eitulusoo aajo neijia lootii enkaji enye!

English: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
Masaai: “Ore etulusoitie larin artam, neipang'aki olmalaika ti ong'ata o ldoinyo le Sinai, te nchani nayupuyup.

English: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Besai, naa iip uni o tikitam o ong'uan.

English: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?
Masaai: Neitoki Saul ajoki ilo sinka lenye, “Kake amaa ti nikipuo, kainyoo iyiook kiyaki ilo tung'ani? Amu eishunye imukateni naatii atua ilbenia lang, nemetii enkishoroto nikiyaki ilo tung'ani le Nkai. Kainyoo kiata iyiook?”

English: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
Masaai: Meetae osikari otii enjore oisho metarruesha mbaa neme ne njore, amu ore enayieu ninye naa pe eitiship ilo oigero.

English: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
Masaai: Amu ore endama pooki naatooshoki nanu, naaitamei nkakeny pooki.

English: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
Masaai: Kake eitirrishakita ejo, “Keing'oling'ol olorere, eiteng'enita te Yudea pooki, ebaiki Galilaya o meeu ene.”

English: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
Masaai: ore kuldo tung'ana torrok o lalejak neponari aaku torrok, elejisho neleji sii ninche.

English: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
Masaai: Kake keitajeu lelo okishin too nkutukie enye; ore iloomena neitajeu te nkaina eilo magilani.

English: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
Masaai: Ore hoo nemaata entorroni, mawaliki ninye; ekaomonu olng'ur to Laitang'oroni lai.

English: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
Masaai: Neye Sara te Keriath-arba (aa ninye Hebron), te nkop e Kanaan. Nelotu Abraham aishiraki to sina Sara, neishir oleng.

English: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo pooki laa Enkiyang'et e Nkai narikito, ninche nkera e Nkai.

English: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Kepiu olalashe lino aitoki.”

English: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
Masaai: Tialo iyie ake ataasa nanu eng'oki, naas ina torrono too nkonyek inono, metaa ira iyie asipani te nkiguana ino, nimiaata entioto te nkiguana ino.

English: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
Masaai: Neibung ninye nearaa aaipung'ie oriong enkurma oo lng'anayio near metua.

English: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye aitorioo nkaik enyena te neitorit ninye, anaa enaitorioo nkaik o ltung'ani oisompira te nkare, kake kelo Olaitoriani airragie ilo wuasa lenye te nebo ina arriyiano oo nkaik enyena.

English: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
Masaai: Ore ilo malaika laairorie nanu, enyaaka arrinyunye, naainyoyie nanu, anaa oltung'ani otuputuoki too njo.

English: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.
Masaai: Nedumunye Daudi nelo te nebo iltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye ebaiki Baale-Yuda, pee eyau aailepunye aaitung'uaa ine osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye eipotieki enkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani oton ninye te nkitoo te nchumata oo lkerubi.

English: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
Masaai: Neirrag ninche enyaanyuk tiatua enterit, neiruj ninche olkurto.

English: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
Masaai: Eyau enkarsisisho ilchoreta kumok ng'ejuko, kake ore oltung'ani aisinani nepuo aaing'uaa ilchoreta lenyena.

English: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
Masaai: te nebo sii nena ng'apeta o lgoriet naamanaa, o nkitotoneta enye, o ncheito enye o nkeenta.

English: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
Masaai: Neaku ore iltung'ana pooki apa ootaarayie Ishmael aitung'uaa Mispa neibelekenya aashukunye, nepuo enetii Yohanan olayioni le Karea.

English: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
Masaai: meteleku ake Enkiyang'et Sinyati ake naaishakenoki nanu te pooki anasa inchere inkeenta naanyita o inkitamiot.

English: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
Masaai: Nerrinyunye ninche aapuonu enetii ninye etonita te Yeriko, nejoki ninye ninche, “Keitu nanu ajoki intae emipuopuo?”

English: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
Masaai: Amu kaaitushur ninye nanu ti atua olng'obor lenye, te nkolong e nyamali; naaikenoo ninye nanu ti abori o lng'obor lenye, naailepie ninye nanu apik shumata endapidapoi.

English: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
Masaai: Amu nji eiroro Olaitoriani ajoki, eiteleikia ina aina enye nagol shumata nanu, naaikok pee maibung orrekie le kulo tung'ana, ajoki:

English: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
Masaai: Ilkituaak le Yuda, o ilkituaak le Yerusalem o sunaishi oogelema, o ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki leina kop ooima erishata oo matuan eilo ashe

English: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
Masaai: Ore inkoitoi enyena naa inaaitishipisho, ore nkoitoi enyena pooki naa eseriani.

English: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena naing'orisho nanu, naa ng'ura, enkae, nanyaanyukie olowuaru keri, neeta inaipuko ong'uan e motonyi te nkoriong enye; neeta ina ng'ues ilukuny ong'uan neishori ninye enkitoria.

English: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eitu ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani? Kainyoo pee ikuetikia nena tokitin nitaarutua, niaas embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani.”

English: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
Masaai: Nelotu enetii Simon Petero. Nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, aa inkejek aainei intuku?”

English: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
Masaai: Aatang'adua nanu Efraim te lejare, naang'adu enkaji e Israel too monko; kake eton eyioloi Yuda te Nkai, naa keisiligayu ninye te ilo Osinya.

English: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
